author: Inneke Ficianirum
review_text:
Naughty Nuri’s has been my all-time favorite since 2015, and honestly, it has never changed — in the best way possible. Every visit feels like coming back to an old friend. The flavors are always consistent, bold, and absolutely delicious. From the first bite to the last, the food is just as yummy as I remember years ago.

What I truly appreciate is how they’ve managed to maintain the same quality and taste over time. No shortcuts, no disappointment — just solid, satisfying food every single time. On top of that, the staff are always friendly, welcoming, and attentive, which makes the whole experience even better. You can really feel the warm, relaxed vibe that Naughty Nuri’s is known for.

It’s rare to find a place that stays this good for so many years, but Naughty Nuri’s does it effortlessly. If you’re looking for a place that’s reliable, flavorful, and full of good energy, this is it. Will always keep coming back. Highly recommended! 👌🔥

author: Sibyl Tate
review_text:
I booked my set meal thru pelago, and the manager acknowledged it at the reception.
They served our meal quite fast. But the drinks selection is very limited.
When we wanted to add a platter, the waitress advised us about the size of the platter and suggested us some other choices. I really appreciate that she wasn’t hard selling and think we wouldn’t able to finish our food. Thanks a lot 🫶🏻

author: Globe Walker
review_text:
Signature Pork ribs are soft n tender, easy to chew for the elderlies. The ribs are well marinated and the sweet spicy sauce placed at the table is delish!

Bacon bits on volcano potato are hard and dried, not complimenting the dish as should. The baked potato was only slightly warmed up , making the volcano experience less exciting. Flavour wise, it is alright.

Fried rice with ribs (iga) is a good option for pple who cant finish a portion of signature pork ribs.

Butterfly tea is yummy n refreshing. It's butterfly (pea flower) juice + mango juice + black tea.

Place has no aircon.

author: yf lim
review_text:
This is the best pork ribs I’ve tried in Bali so far! The meat was incredibly tender and well-marinated with delicious sauces. We also ordered the fried pork with a slightly sweet and spicy sauce — it was so good that I completely forgot to take photos 😅
The side dishes were tasty as well. The only downside is that the environment can be a bit hot if the fan isn’t blowing in your direction.
Will definitely come back again for the pork
ribs!

author: Petra Vrábková
review_text: We went here because we saw a lot of recommendations. Upon arrival, we had to register via a QR code and wait for a table to become available. There was a large selection of meat specialties, Balinese specialties, and various drinks. The service was very friendly. They asked us if we had everything we needed and if we were satisfied. The food tasted excellent. The food was ready quite quickly. The prices are high, but I understand that for such high-quality food.

author: Fenny Gosal
review_text:
I went here last December 2025. We ordered fried rice and the 1 kg US Premium Ribs. It was my first time trying their US Premium ribs. The taste was good, but I didn’t really like the texture, a bit hard to chew and not as soft compared to their signature ribs.

As for the fried rice, I think it needs some improvement, as it tasted quite plain. Overall, I’d still come back, but I’d definitely stick to ordering their signature ribs next time.

author: A K
review_text:
This is a very popular place, and we had to wait a bit to get in. They have an outdoor seating area at the front of the restaurant, and because the space is quite large, the turnover is fairly quick. The pork ribs and shrimp were really tasty, while the whole chicken was just okay.
We liked the vibrant atmosphere, and the serving staff were friendly and welcoming.
The customers are a mix of tourists and locals, which adds to the lively atmosphere.

author: Grace Kusen
review_text:
this place has been our go-to place in bali for years and it never disappoints. we ordered the pork knuckle, caesar salad, and truffle fries. everything was amazing and fulfilling!

satya, one of the staff members, was very helpful and friendly, which made the experience even better.

a true must-go in bali. as always, we’ll definitely be back!🫶

author: Hary Luo
review_text:
Had an amazing feast at Naughty Nuri’s! We ordered the 2kg BBQ pork ribs, fried pork, corn, and the signature volcano potato, and everything hit the spot. The ribs were the star of the meal—tender, smoky, and packed with flavour, easily one of the best I’ve had. The fried pork was crispy on the outside and juicy inside, a perfect companion to the hearty mains.

The corn was sweet and buttery, balancing out all the rich dishes, while the volcano potato was fun, indulgent, and full of cheesy goodness. Overall, it was a satisfying and memorable dining experience, perfect for sharing and definitely worth coming back for!

author: George Slavchev
review_text:
A local friend recommended this spot and, although I’m not a big fan of tourist traps, I really enjoyed Naughty Nuri’s!

The service was great and everything we ordered arrived very quickly!

The Babi Guling was pretty good! The nachos were very different to what I’ve had — very light and crispy — we really enjoyed them.

Note that the place gets very busy at night and there’s a reasonably long wait.

Overall a great spot if you’re in Bali for the first time.

author: Matthew Ng
review_text:
Amazing joint from the original one in Ubud. This place ticked all the boxes for me but with an upgrade on the environment from the original.

Think modern sleek woodwork still reminiscent of Bali but in a Texan-Saloon setting. Pictures of old cartoon, paraphernalia & records hung on the walls. A semi-open kitchen gives you a peering insight into the wonders of the flaming grill. A large pot of the signature sauce next to it while the chefs lathers on the sticky-sweet-savoury liquid onto the ribs.

The grilled prawns as a starter were an absolute gem. Succulent, plump & sweet (not to mentioned well cleaned which is a big plus). The garlic butter brushed on had the right twang to it and made it even more moorish.

Then came the main star. A half rack of ribs weighing in at 600g (bone-in). The steaming aroma was hard to miss and a quick squeeze of lime made my mouth salivate. Even now writing this makes me crave it despite having dinner already. The bones fall apart and the meat just melts over. Sticky, gnarly and downright dirty, this isn’t a first-date meal but boy does it make for one heck of a dinner. Washed it down with their homemade ice tea to cool the palate.

I skipped the sides to keep space for the ribs but the patrons around who had them seemed to enjoy it.
Do come by & try it when in Seminyak!

author: Eddi3 Selph
review_text:
Thanks to Mr Satya for serving us! We came around 4pm and got a table in under 5 minutes.

Food and service were great, and the prices were pretty decent for a touristy area. Portions were big too.

We ordered the pork ribs, pork belly satay, roasted pork, and Crazy Corn.

Will definitely come again!

author: Krishna Wiharsa
review_text:
Great ribs, vibrant atmosphere and good service!  Nothing beats them for a perfect dine-in around Bali.  The premium ribs are so tender and juicy.
We were served by Eka, very helpful and friendly, making sure everything served well for us 👍🏼
Definitely a must-go place if you're in Bali.

author: Paul Buckman
review_text:
What a great place to eat local.

The venue is clean and large, with a good atmosphere. Vibrant yet you can still talk, and eat great food.

Waitstaff are attentive and very helpful.

Kitchen is fast.
Food size and quality of excellent.

Ribs were fall off the bone and melt in the mouth. Go big on these. Get more.

Satays was juicy, smokey and tasty. You need to order both pork and chicken.

We will be back
#breakfreefromthedesk
Mr B

author: Mikee
review_text:
Food was good and the portions were huge. The 1kg pork ribs were meaty and juicy, and are enough to share with around 4 people. And some of the drinks come in large 650ml sizes, also easy to share. The rib sauce leans sweet, so it’s great if you’re into that kind of flavor. French fries came with some sort of truffle sauce that was good, but it was spicy and wasn't to our liking.

Service was great and the atmosphere was fun, saw the staff do a fun dance when someone ordered a cocktail. Our waitress, Mbok Wiwin, did great. The place has gitten less crowded as of around this time (December 2025), since the government has been doing experimental one way road changes.

author: widhiari murti
review_text: Had dinner here tonight and had a really good experience. Food were quick to come out and everything we ordered tasted amazing. Ms Eka was super friendly and efficient. She’s really accommodating to the kid’s requests. Even the parking staff was extremely helpful. Very happy with tonight’s experience.

author: Michelle Budiali
review_text: Service by Kak Wiwin is excellent! Signature  pork ribs so delicious and yummy! The crispy pork belly just okay, you can find a better pork belly in another place. Since the place is outdoor, there's no non smoking area, so you can smell cigarette smoke from another guest.

author: Jolyn Lim
review_text: The food was enjoyable and well-prepared, with good quality ingredients. The service really stood out — Eka was very friendly, attentive, and made sure we were well taken care of throughout the meal. Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience and I would be happy to return.

author: Jessica Chin
review_text:
One of the best meals we had in Bali. The pork rib best to pair with their chill craft beer, you'll regret for not doing so. I had 2 glasses for a lunch session and I usually don't have beer during lunch.

It's very popular and crowded, best to reserve before coming.

author: Jack Lee
review_text: Definitely one of the best ribs I ever had! The servers Ayu and Satya were very friendly and helpful. It was my first time here, so I didn't know what to order. They recommended me what to eat and what portion should I have since there only one person eating. Will come another time when I'm back in Bali

author: Wisnu Jesika
review_text:
First, the waiting time was quite long we had to queue and wait for around one hour before getting a table. It was a bit tiring, but still understandable considering how popular this place is.

One thing we really appreciated was that they provide free mineral water refills, which is a very nice touch and not something you always get, especially in busy places like this.

The service was excellent all the staff were very friendly, polite, and attentive. They made us feel welcome and comfortable the entire time.

There is a time limit of 1.5 hours for dining, but honestly, it was more than enough for us. The time felt fair and well-managed, so it didn’t feel rushed at all.

For the food, we ordered the pork belly rice bowl and the ramen soup. Both dishes were good and enjoyable. In our personal opinion, we would rate the taste 8 out of 10 for both, not mind-blowing, but still tasty, well-prepared, and satisfying, matching our expectations.

One small area for improvement would be the toilet, which could be cleaner and less wet/slippery. With such a nice restaurant atmosphere, improving this would make the experience even better.

Overall, everything else was very good, and we left feeling very satisfied. We would definitely recommend Sensorium Canggu and would be happy to come back again.

author: Reyhwai WK
review_text:
Sensorium Bali is truly exceptional. The food is outstanding—every dish is delicious with beautifully complex flavors that show great creativity and precision.

The service is absolutely top-notch: attentive, warm, and professional without being intrusive.

The atmosphere is elegant and inviting, making the entire dining experience feel special from start to finish. I will definitely come back whenever I visit Bali again. Wishing continued success to Sensorium

well deserved!

author: Jessica S
review_text:
We had a wonderful dining experience here. Every dish we ordered was thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor.
The Crispy Quesadillas were perfectly golden and crunchy on the outside, with a rich and savory filling that made a great starter.
The Pork Belly Rice Bowl was a highlight—tender, juicy pork belly with a beautiful balance of richness and seasoning, served with fragrant rice that complemented the dish perfectly.
The Cold Rame Dry was refreshing and unique, with well-balanced flavors and a satisfying texture, making it a standout and memorable dish.
The atmosphere was stylish yet comfortable, and the service was attentive and friendly. Overall, Sensorium offers a creative menu, high-quality food, and a great dining experience. Highly recommended!

author: Ping Boon (Bingoh)
review_text:
The environment is really nice with a Muji-style vibe. Every dish is a delightful surprise to the taste buds 🥰

The staff there provide excellent and polite service. They ask if you have any food allergies and even guide you on how to enjoy each dish for the best taste. After the meal, they check if you’re satisfied with the food and end by sending you warm wishes for your journey💯

The waiting time was about 45 minutes. The tables are a bit close to each other, but it doesn’t affect the overall experience. The last row has a glass roof for natural lighting, but the sunlight can be a bit strong. Still, the staff were very kind and quickly brought us chairs so we could move to a shaded area👍

author: Tica Songrainy
review_text:
POV: you’re “just getting brunch” and suddenly it’s the best meal of your trip.

Tried the dry ramen, quesadilla, and pork belly rice bowl and honestly? No misses.
Every bite said “trust the chef.”

The vibe is cozy, chill, and always buzzing — which means yes, you might wait, but it’s part of the ✨experience✨. Staff are chill, helpful, and actually explain the menu instead of just nodding and disappearing. Prices are fair for the quality — this is not a scam brunch spot.

10/10 would come back.
10/10 would drag my friends here.
0/10 chance I stop thinking about that ramen.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: 032. Ananda Putri Sudarmawan
review_text:
I really enjoyed the service overall — it was especially nice to see the owner personally involved. The food was excellent; we ordered three dishes and every one of them was really good.

One small note regarding the security service: when we arrived, it was raining and we came by motorcycle, but only guests arriving by car were offered assistance with umbrellas. I hope this can be improved so all guests receive the same level of care.

Overall, it was a great experience and we will definitely be coming back.

author: Aida Anwar
review_text: The service is great, from the servers to the chef owner. All so friendly and look like they love what they do. Although, I feel the food can be improved. Ordered 3 mains and 1 side, the quesadillas is star of the show. The hummus dish lacked seasoning that is usually in a hummus, also I think the egg taste overpowers the overall dish. The fishbowl I was not a fan of as the rice is overcooked. I also wish there was less rice and more crunchy elements. I thought the food came really fast, good for sharing too. I would come back to try their other dishes!

author: Ahmad Fauzi
review_text: Love the positive environment around to dine in. All the staffs were attentive, and warm, plus the chef-owner being around and interacting with us- the guests. Foods were exceptional, and creatively driven, love the visuals, and this one actually tasted good in mouth too, not just in the eyes! Would recommend, and definitely coming back here in the future.

author: Eunice Chan
review_text:
Food here in INCREDIBLE!! Menu is all Asian-fusion style brunch dishes. We had:
- fishbowl: I absolutely loved this bowl, it’s like a poke bowl, but just so deliciously crafted
- dry ramen: this was soooo good! there isn’t a lot of toppings but the flavouring and noodle texture was just spot on
- miso pancakes: I was actually slightly disappointed in this given this seems to be super popular in the comments. The texture just wasn’t fluffy and the miso flavour didnt really come through

It is extremely busy though so expect to queue. Also if you come as a bigger group, note that seating is only allowed when everyone in the group is present

author: Jo&Co Wanderlust
review_text: Sensorium is one of the best Asian-fusion spots in Berawa. The food was truly amazing : creative, balanced and far above the usual café standards. There’s always a line of people waiting outside, which already tells you how popular it is, and most of the crowd is Asian, which says a lot about the quality and authenticity of the flavours. Vibrant atmosphere, great service and definitely worth the wait.

author: Jessica Rusli
review_text:
queue about 2 hrs! all the menu were very interesting. tried some asian fusion style dishes such as burgers, dry ramen, pancakes, salad etc.
every meal were so flavorful and well seasoned. the presentation was very appealing and beautifully prepared.
simply amazing!

author: Wil Budiharto
review_text: Foods are always good as usual. Love the ambience as well. The only downside is that they don't provide wifi for customers. Mobile Signal very sucks inside the restaurant. Limited to 1.5 hours (its okay) but No WiFi for customer is very harsh for Bali hospitality's standard...

author: Jun
review_text: Went at 12:30pm and waited around 30mins. Food was great, atmosphere was great. Service was good as well! The ice cream sandwich was so good that we forgot to take a picture! Note: there is a minimum spend of 150k per pax.

author: Resianing Marita
review_text:
All the menus are very interesting and unique, which you cannot find in other restaurants. Very delicious, a combination of flavors that I have never tasted before.

The staff is very friendly, the owner himself sometimes explains the food when it is delivered. For the price, it is very reasonable compare to what we get.

At first it was estimated to queue for about 1 hour, but it turned out that 20 minutes we already got the table. The food is served fast.

There is a little parking lot for motorbikes. it's better to drop off only by car or ride a motorbike. Overall will definitely come back again to try another menu 🥰

author: lydia aja
review_text:
First time trying it because of the hype.
Overall, the food was okay not amazing, but not bad either. If you’re curious, you can give it a try since everyone has different points of view and tastes. Just like hair color some people like blonde, some like black you can’t force taste, it’s subjective.
FYI, dining time is limited to 1 hour 30 minutes.
Since the seating is limited, it’s better to leave right after you finish eating because a lot of people are waiting to dine.

author: Sasha Octavian
review_text:
⭐ 9/10 – Unexpectedly amazing and definitely lives up to the hype

I kept seeing Sensorium all over TikTok, so many people raving about it and I finally decided to visit to see what the fuss was about.

Being the classic person that I am, I had to order the dish everyone mentions: the Brunch Dry Ramen. My French friend ordered the Okonomiyaki (didn’t take picture of it 😅) When I looked at the menu, I honestly became a bit skeptical. There were so many ingredients, textures, and elements in one dish that I started wondering how everything would come together. I was also slightly worried for my friend because he’s notoriously difficult to impress when it comes to food (blame the French palate 😂).

But damn, once the food arrived, we both had huge smiles on our faces. It was amazing. Surprisingly harmonious, balanced, and fun to eat. Every bite had something different: sometimes crunchy, sometimes creamy, but always delicious.

It turned out to be such an unexpected but wonderful experience. I’d easily give it a 9/10.

My friend loved it so much he even brought his cousin for a second visit. Sensorium definitely lives up to the hype.

author: S Tang
review_text:
Food this good is illegal. Impeccable flavour and friendly service. Will def come bk!!!

Better come before 11am otherwise u hv to queue, we got luck and got seated right away.

THE best scrambled eggs we ever had hands down.

There’s hand sanitizer offered by the table, rly convenient.

author: Jonathan Lim
review_text:
The greeter was very candid with the waiting time and our expectations were well managed. Was given menu while waiting outside.

Food was served quickly and I can understand why this place is so likeable and popular amongst locals and tourists. Flavors and textures are balanced. It was crowded but tables were spaced well to still have conversation without feeling like a shouting match. Good kind of lively.

Staff are friendly and accommodating too. Requested to have lettuce served separately for the beef quesadillas and waiter checked with the kitchen, and informed it is doable.

Recommended 👍🏼

author: Andres Varela
review_text: Can’t believe I haven’t been here before!  Yea, there was a bit of a wait (about 30 mins on Saturday at 2pm) so not too bad, but the food was 100% worth it!  From the orange juice to the ramen, everything we tried was 10/10.

author: Radhitia Pradana
review_text:
I think this is the 4th or 5th time we've treated our bellies here.
From the small original spot to their current location ,
from FOMO to sustenance must-visit whenever we're in Bali.

We always have a great time here. The food is consistently amazing, the staff are warm, friendly, and quick to respond, and the dogs are always adorable.

The highest throne this time (tahta tertinggi)  goes to the Crispy Quesadillas. The corn is still rockin', and the fish bowl is best enjoyed with nori — so we ordered extra nori to perfect every bite.

Pro Tips:

1. Arrive at 8:50 AM, wait 10 minutes, and be among the first guests there.

2. Order extra double ground beef for  Crispy Quesadillas.

3. Go to Sensorium on empty stomach.

4. Be kind and respectful.

author: David M
review_text: I asked my muay thai instructor where to get authentic Balinese food, and he recommended this place out in the sticks😁 I looked at the menu, and they asked do you want 1st or the special plate...what?!?! The food was pretty tasty! Would not come back again, but it was a memorable experience

author: Dor Nahum
review_text:
A classic roasted pig experience here in Bali, place was neat and organized.
Very clean, half indoors, half outdoors sitting while everything is covered to protect from the rain. The food was absolutely delicious. I ordered the large portion special which kind of gives you a mix of everything that you should have.
I also ordered pork belly, which was very good I tried to order some extra skin, but I think they were saving it for the specials aside from that. I had a great experience and would come back again.
Paid 110,000 rupiah

author: CLAUDIA
review_text:
I read many different comments here but for my taste it's already perfect. Although i can't give it a 5 because the  chicharron kerupuk isn't really tasty. But the other meatier taste so good! :)

And don't forget to ask for more of the sambal cause they will only give you a little. The rice portion here is also not so big, so if you need more just ask for rice cause they already give you lots of food on the menu.

It's a big place but after lunch time it get pretty crowded.
Parking lot is big but mainly for motorcycle only.
The toilet is just okay, but it's a wet toilet.

author: Lester Chong
review_text: Although it's a touristy joint and a little pricy compared to the more local ones. Would still recommend it. Friendly staff with fuss free ordering system. Delicious food with easy to choose options. Don't miss this Babi Guling when around here.

author: Brandon Matthew
review_text: Got their Nasi Campur. It’s 50.000 IDR, which is nearing the premium spectrum (for local food). Honestly, it’s worth it with the amount of pork that they give. Each portion gets two piece of the crispy skin, which is incredible. Got the balung soup as well, which includes a bit of meat. The chilli is a bit spicy, but still manageable. Also ordered the same-sam guling for 50.000 IDR too. Not quite as expected, the skin is not crispy. However, the meat is tender and the spices are great.

author: Katy Wang
review_text: The food taste good but not sure if it's traditional style, the dish was cold. But it's flavorful. But unfortunately my husband had small rock in his pork dish, we don't know where that from, so be careful when you put the food in mouth.

author: marina felizardo
review_text: food is nice but served a bit cold and could be a bit more flavourful. still really good local food for a really great price. If you can’t handle your spice make sure to order “no spice” because it will still come super spicy!

author: Yen Thung Tan
review_text: My first babi guling in Bali and it did not disappoint. The food was good but it was a bit too spicy for me. Overall, Babi guling is a food that you should try if you are in Bali.

author: Duy Hoang Quoc Dang
review_text: Best Babi Guling (Roasted Pork with rice) in Canggu. The staff felt a bit cold and unwelcoming, but the food definitely made up for it — every dish was a mood booster. Prices are local-friendly, the restroom is clean, and the seating area is spacious and comfortable.

author: Swiss
review_text: Here the menu is simple . They only serve bali guling with minimal variations and drink, crisps on the table . Babi guling was good but similar to other local Indonesian food, you got to enjoy this meal with open, adventurous mindset, to explore different taste profiles in food .

author: Christine Rumi
review_text:
A dish that combines white rice and suckling pig, flavored with spices. The price of the “paket hemat” is only Rp. 40.000,-

Btw, the staff doesn't smile enough, which makes the atmosphere feel unwelcoming.

author: Henry Gunawan
review_text: One of the best babi guling in Bali. If you have spent time to traverse Canggu traffic definitely eat here!!

author: Christopher Wu
review_text: Men Lari Babi Guling was my first ever babi guling experience and honestly, it was a solid intro to what to expect. It’s definitely a bit of a tourist-friendly spot, so I felt safe in terms of prep and hygiene, but the food still felt authentic and eye-opening. Coming from an Asian background, a lot of the flavours were familiar — I’m sure I’ve eaten similar things before without knowing exactly what they were — but here, it was clear it was all pork, just done in different styles. The pork skin wasn’t super crispy, more on the chewy side, but I didn’t mind it at all. Chewing through that and then sipping the hot broth after made me feel like I was doing it properly, local-style. The staff were super friendly and helped me order, and I went with the smaller portion since I wasn’t too hungry — even though it looks heavy, it actually sat really well. A great first taste of babi guling.

author: Sean Mitchell
review_text: Fantastic food, great prices, lovely people. I go here all the time, I choose the special.

author: Poh Zhi Nan
review_text: Needed a quick dinner fix and chanced upon this nearby store on Google. It’s my first time trying babi guling, and I was not quite sure what to expect. The pork skin was crispy but tough, and it was a little spicy. Overall I think it’s flavourful but nothing spectacular about it. It’s worth a try but I am sure there are even better ones out there in Bali.

author: Jonathan Setiawan
review_text: Men Lari bigul hits different, came back 3x in 3 days. Overall great food, quite pricey, but worth the money. Will definitely come back!

author: Shabrina
review_text: I’ve visited Babi Guling Men Lari several times, and it never disappoints. The babi guling is consistently flavorful, offering a delightful blend of spices that keeps me coming back. The restaurant maintains a clean and tidy environment, making dining here a pleasant experience. Additionally, they provide ample parking space, which is a significant convenience. For anyone seeking authentic Balinese cuisine in a comfortable setting, Babi Guling Men Lari is a must-visit.

author: zhou poa
review_text: The food and rice came out quickly but cold. Every piece of meat had pig hair and bristles that were not cleaned up, it looked disgusting. All the hot dishes were cold, the prices are expensive for Bali, and the portions are small. It's hard to get here, don't come here. We also read other people's recommendations, but we couldn't stand the cold dishes and the meat covered with pig hair. The meat looked like it had been sitting for a long time. There is no air conditioning, and the fan is off by default unless you ask the waiter to turn it on. It's a terrible experience.

author: Erica Oh
review_text: I was extremely surprised by the portion! Didn’t expect it would be this small loll. And look at how mini size the satay is. In my opinion, the food itself wasn’t that great. The pork meat has lots of soft bones and some of the meat is quite hard to chew. I like the pork skin, the soup and the lawar veggies, but other than that, I don’t think it’s worth the effort to reach this place. To get here, the traffic is pretty bad. But good things about this place is, that they have spacious parking lots

author: Elizabeth Martina Kelmaskosu
review_text: The babi guling is very tasty even we went here on Dinner Time. The pork skin is still "kriuk". Although is quite pricey for a plate, but it's packed with tourist and online drivers. Should try when you are visiting Canggu area.

author: Jessen george
review_text: The location is perfect for tourists who's visiting ubud. Which is near to the ubud palace and ubud art Market.vehicles will not reach to the property  so you have to walk nearly 250 m. But it is  good. The property ambiance is perfect for tourists. One side of the restaurant is facing toward the nature that's great and other side is with a fish pond and birds wich gives a cool atmosphere. We ate food after 3pm so the food was not hot at all. Better the want to heat the dish especially the pork meat, so overall food experience was not so great.

author: weda
review_text:
We came around 4pm and it was raining hard we had to move table due to the wind.

They have spacious seating with many tables and chairs. Perfect for big groups.

The babi guling itself wasn't among my favorites, I still can smell the pork from the meat. But the babi guling goreng was so good tho! Be careful, the bumbu was quite spicy compared to other babi guling. Beware if you're not a fan of spicy food.

author: Stephanie Xu
review_text:
Super interesting to try this dish. I almost didn’t order the soup cause it was already so hot but would recommend you to order it in the set meal. Taste of the soup was great! The sausage was very spicy, the pig skin was nice and crispy. I also enjoyed the fried meat, the grilled one was ok.

It just got way to hot after I finished drinking the soup. A few more ventilators would definitely help. Staring into the forest to eat was a nice touch though!

author: Monica Tj
review_text:
One of the well-known babi guling spots in the Ubud area. The place is slightly hidden inside (need to walk past the narrow aisle), but it’s quite spacious with a nice greenery view.

In terms of taste, it didn’t quite hit the mark for me. The spices weren’t as strong and flavorful for my liking. The fried pork were a bit tough (alot), but the meat is tender and plenty. The highlight was definitely the crispy pork skin - BEST I've eaten. If you come too late, the lawar might be sold out and they will replace it with sayur labu. Oh and the soup is similar with sop sayur with carrots and green beans.

The price is quite steep (tax included), and fyi they only accept cash payments.

author: Lucy B
review_text:
A delicious place for the classic Bali dish of Babi Guling.
The internet said I had to get there before 11 or all the crackling would be gone and there would be queues- this wasn’t my experience; we went in high season (August) and at lunch the place was not at all full and no food shortages.

Babi Guling was delicious - juicy pork and crispy skin! Very rich food.

Restaurant otherwise is simple and clean.

author: Kenny Tan
review_text: Food is definitely overrated. There r better n tasty suckling pig meals in other southeast asia. Food price is pricy relative. Cash only which is inconvenient. Also there r no green leafy vegetable in their vegetable or soup dish mainly carrot beans and potato. Meat is quite dry and the fried pork skin is hard to chew. Location is hidden in small alleyways. Environment is very dark in daytime so that doesnt help either. i will give it a miss

author: Coco Choi
review_text: It was really nice food and it’s my first time to enjoy our barbecue cooling that was like pulled pork it’s very soft and very tasty.

author: Stefan Nicorescu
review_text:
As soon as I land in Bali, there's one thing I know: I'm heading straight to BO$$MAN. This isn't just a burger joint — for me, it's a travel essential.
I always get what I call my “Winner Winner” burger (or any beef/pork masterpiece they have sizzling at the moment), and it hits every time — thick, juicy patties (dry-aged or slow-cooked), bold smoky flavours, and that perfect balance of textures and sauces. On top of that, the loaded fries are next-level: crispy, flavor-packed, with pulled pork (or cheese, jalapeños, chipotle mayo...) — ideal if you want something more than a basic side.
The vibe at BO$$MAN is epic: loud beats, street-cool decor, and an energy that feels like the pulse of Bali nights. The staff are always friendly and helpful — from service to a warm "welcome back," they make you feel right at home.
And here's the thing I love: right next door is Sisterfields Cafe — so sometimes I'll grab a burger (or two) from BO$$MAN and a side or drink from Sisterfields, then chill with both in one spot. It's the kind of combo that only a seasoned Bali-traveller truly appreciates.
For me, no Bali trip feels complete without that BO$$MAN burger fix. It's not just food — it's part of the experience, the ritual, the memories

author: Lena Bennett
review_text: Love love love this place!! Really yummy burgers!! Had the lil smashin ,So tasty. The chicken strips are also great! They have a unique flavour. Ate here twice! Great service and eating area airconditioned inside and clean tables. Will be back when in Bali again.

author: sonya pase
review_text:
I came across this burger spot while exploring Seminyak. The location is super convenient—close to everything and easily reachable on foot. The interior immediately caught my attention: bright and inviting from the outside, yet warm and cozy once you step in. My hubby and I chose our burgers with the help of the friendly staff.

I loved it! I’d give it a solid 8.5/10. The burger is perfect if you’re looking for something tasty and easy to grab on the go. Can’t wait to come back on my next visit! 🤗

author: Chloe Hill
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Amazing burgers, great vibes, and even better service! The food was absolutely delicious and full of flavour, and the music created such a fun, relaxed atmosphere. What really stood out was how attentive the staff were — they made sure to check for allergies and took it seriously, which made us feel really comfortable and well looked after. Highly recommend if you’re after amazing food, good music, and excellent service! 🍔🎶

author: d7usah
review_text:
The burgers here are seriously delicious. I liked it so much that I came two days in a row. The ‘MC LOVIN’ burger was amazing. The truffle fries were also incredible, with that mushroom and cheese kick that makes them so addictive.

If you love burgers, coming to Bali and not visiting this place feels like missing out on something big.

author: 00i
review_text: I had a chance to visit this restaurant while looking for some Western food during our stay in Bali. The interior was really stylish, and the atmosphere was top-notch. The burger itself was absolutely amazing. This place is definitely one of the best choices for tourists in Bali who want a break from the local Balinese diet.

author: Noah Parker
review_text: Good food and a cool little vibe.  Just note prices listed do not include tax and service charge. 😕  We got the smashed patty burger meal and the winner winner chicken burger and the were both great. The chips were also cooked well 😋.  I would recommend over Grill'd next door.

author: B. R.
review_text:
Staff was great.
Place was nice and clean.
Food was good.
We liked the loaded fries.

author: Ismail Faseeh
review_text:
If you’re craving a seriously good burger in Bali, BOSSMAN Burgers Seminyak is the place to be! 🍔🔥

Food:
The burgers are massive, juicy, and packed with flavor — definitely made to satisfy. We tried a couple of their signature ones and every bite was delicious. The buns were soft yet held together perfectly, and the toppings were fresh and generous. The fries and sides also hit the spot.

Vibe & Service:
The place has a cool, edgy vibe with a fun “badass burger joint” theme that makes it stand out. Staff were quick, friendly, and the service was smooth even though it was busy.

Experience:
It’s definitely not your average burger stop — the portions are huge, the taste is bold, and it’s a great spot to fuel up before or after exploring Seminyak. Whether you dine in or grab a takeaway, the quality is consistent.

Overall:
BOSSMAN lives up to its name — it’s bold, unapologetic, and seriously tasty. If you love burgers, this is a must-try when in Seminyak. We left full, happy, and already planning to come back for more!

author: Andreas Darmawan
review_text: We ordered the Mclovin and Smashin. It was pretty good! The meat was okay, but the bun was the bomb! Recommended if you’re craving for some good burgers

author: Jonathan Alker
review_text: They do an amazing cheeseburger here and the wife loved her vegetarian burger. Fries are delicious and staff are friendly and funny. The prices are a little high but the quality of the ingredients mostly justifies it. If you've had a few beers and can't be bothered to wait for a sit-down meal, this will hit the spot.

author: David M
review_text: Very nice and hearty burger. The price for burger was 100,000 IDR and was melty and well worth it. The staff was professional and the setting appeared very clean as customers can see the cooking area. Highly recommended!

author: Hannah Barkell
review_text:
Fantastic small burger bar in Seminyak with an awesome vibe. The service was genuinely great — friendly, attentive, and happy to help. I have a food allergy and really appreciated how clearly and confidently the staff explained the ingredients and preparation, which made the whole experience stress-free.

The food was outstanding. The burgers were incredibly juicy, packed with flavour, and cooked perfectly. You can tell a lot of care goes into both the ingredients and how everything is made. Easily one of the best burgers I’ve had. Highly recommend.

author: The Samoan Light
review_text: I'm a critic when it comes to burgers, these burgers are good but i still prefer Johnny Rockets for the overall experience. They dont offer beef bacon as a replacement to pork, which i dont like. The shop seems very empty and bland compared to the theme layout in Johnny Rockets. This place is definitely worth trying out if you like burgers.

author: Mishu T
review_text: Experience fresh, juicy burgers bursting with generous fillings! We highly recommend ordering a set menu—it's perfect for sharing between two people. Plus, the servers are incredibly friendly and welcoming!

author: Thien An Nguyen
review_text: One of the best burgers we’ve tasted. Got the truffle fries and numero uno burger!! Fries were so good. Staff were very accommodating!

author: Trevor Bennett
review_text:
Fat Bhat burger aka a Zinger burger+ (more heat) for the Aussies craving a ZINGER..... add a bintang to elevate this burger experience.

Clean, crisp food with great service.

Update:
Went back for round 2!!

The Winner Winner burger, it is a 100% winner ...Delicious.

author: Andrea Danielle Pinto
review_text: Came here for a late dinner one night as many shops were closed. This place opens till 5am!! Amazing! Burger was good, truffle fries were yum! I would suggest to sit inside as you can see rats outside at night. But we sat outside coz we wanted some fresh air. The staff were really friendly and happy to serve us even though it was pretty late. That’s the kind of service we love! Will be back!

author: Alexandra
review_text: It was an amazing experience. The beef burgers are better than the chicken burgers. It was a nice atmosphere which clearly matches the concept of the restaurant. Staffs are welcoming and friendly. Would definitely recommend.

author: Andrew McDonald
review_text: Tasty burgers. The truffle fries were awesome and the Bintang was cold. Great for a quick easy meal of Burger and Fries.

author: Royy
review_text:
My absolute favorite Babi Guling spot! The suckling pig is so tender, and the crispy skin is perfection. I also love that they serve genyol (fatty pork) which is so flavorful and soft.

To top it off, their Es Teler is the perfect refreshing dessert after the spice. All of this paired with the best rice field view—you can’t beat it. Huge menu and delicious food!

author: Bartosz B
review_text: We tried **Warung Babi Guling Pande Egi** and the **Nasi Babi Guling Special** was really tasty, with pork served in different styles — the crispy skin was definitely my favorite. The **Vege Nasi Ayam** was less impressive, quite dry and lacking flavor. We also tried **Es Kolak**, which had a very unique and interesting taste. The prices are extremely low, making it a great place to experience local flavors without spending much.

author: Karn A
review_text:
Great local spot with truly authentic flavours. The suckling pig set was good. The meat on sticks was amazing too: smoky, juicy, and full of flavour, definitely a highlight.

It gets very busy with lots of locals dining here, so expect a bit of a wait. The menu is extremely short and focused mainly on their signature suckling pig, but they do it really well.

author: michael aldryan
review_text:
Just amazing. One of the best pork dishes in Bali (babi guling). Price is very cheap with the high quality taste. There is big queue but Waiting time is short due to the speedy staff action. While you wait there is also many traditional food outside.

I recommend the jumbo size of nasi campur. Dont forget to try the sate babi.

Drinks also nice such as coffe bal, es buah, es daluman.

The view is also nice, you can see rice fields while eat that delicious foods!
Recommend!

author: Mo Mo
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Pande Egi Review – Totally Lives Up to the Hype!

Pande Egi is one of those places that actually deserves every bit of hype around it. The restaurant was recently renovated, and you can really feel the improvement—more seating, cleaner layout, and an overall more comfortable dining atmosphere. Parking is also super convenient with a spacious lot available right across the restaurant.

The menu is simple and straightforward, which I love. Even though it’s known for its pork dishes, they also offer chicken options for those who prefer alternatives. We ordered the Nasi Babi Special, which basically gives you a bit of everything. The portion was generous, the flavors were on point, and honestly, it’s such great value for the price.

Their sate babi and sate ayam are also must-tries—perfectly grilled, juicy, and delicious. And the vibe? Even better. Eating with a view of the rice fields gives the whole place such a relaxing, “just chill” kind of feel.

For dessert, I tried the Es Teler Mix. It was good, but if you want the best experience, I’d recommend choosing the regular one. The mix version can get a little overwhelming because they add a lot into it.

Overall, Pande Egi is a solid 5-star spot—affordable, delicious, relaxing, and absolutely worth visiting. Must try!!! 🌾🍽️✨

author: jerena teo
review_text:
What an amazing experience dining within the rice field!

Perfect place to have lunch before kanto lampo waterfall (close distance).

Food was good paired with their cold coconut.

Place is also kids friendly- highchair available,  non Chili food for kids are also available.

Will be back!

author: Andre W
review_text:
I had the chance to visit Warung Babi Guling Pande Egi in Gianyar, Bali, and it was an unforgettable experience. Tucked away on the way from main road to Ubud this warung is a gem surrounded by lush rice fields, offering a serene backdrop that instantly sets a relaxed vibe. The open-air dining area is spacious, clean, and modern yet retains a traditional Balinese charm—perfect for soaking in the cool breeze while enjoying a meal.

I arrived around 11.30 am, and the place was buzzing with locals and tourists alike, a testament to its popularity. Despite the crowd, the staff was incredibly efficient, using electric buzzers to manage the waitlist, which kept things organized. I was seated almost immediately with a stunning view of the rice paddies.

I ordered the **Nasi Babi Guling Jumbo** (IDR 38,000, roughly $2.50 USD), which came loaded with tender suckling pig, crispy pork skin, pork sausage, lawar (a traditional Balinese vegetable mix), pork satay, and a savory pork soup. The pork was melt-in-your-mouth soft, with a smoky, well-spiced flavor, and the skin was perfectly crackly. The sambal matah added a fresh, spicy kick that tied everything together. I also tried their “es daluman”, a refreshing dessert beverage of mixed grass jelly in coconut milk and palm sugar, which was a great palate cleanser.

The service was friendly and professional, even with the hectic pace. The warung has clearly evolved since its early days as a small local spot in 2016, now boasting a larger space and extras like coffee and Balinese “jajanan pasar” (local cakes and desserts). I noticed a group next to me order a whole roasted pig for takeout, which looked impressive and apparently feeds 6-12 people for around $120 AUD.

My only minor gripe was the wait time during busy hours (noon), but the food and ambiance made it worthwhile. If you’re planning a visit, I’d recommend arriving early (before noon) to beat the rush or catching the sunset for an even more picturesque experience. Warung Babi Guling Pande Egi lives up to its legendary status as one of Bali’s best babi guling spots—highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Balinese cuisine in a beautiful settings and local price!

Worthy note: Pande in Balinese = craftsmen
Him/his family line previously probably metal craftsmen

author: Josh Smith
review_text: This place was outstanding! Best Babi Guling we tried and very authentic setting. We were the only westerners eating there in the morning all though I know alot of tourists go also. Great service and even better food! Highly recommend trying whilst in Bali. Go early not long after they open and enjoy the suckling pig with the kind hearted locals 🙏❤️🙌🐖🐖🐖

author: Márk Lövei
review_text: Best Babi guling I have even eaten in Bali. Spices are just so good, the pork skin is crunchy, I really can't complain about anything, everything was nice and the environment is stunning with a little ricefiled they have, I can definitely recommend it to everyone!

author: Ivan Michael Pung
review_text:
This restaurant is rather out 🏘️ of the way but since we were travelling from Airport ✈️ to Tulemben 🏝️, it was a perfect 👌 stop ✋over. It is a beautiful Indonesia 🇮🇩 Restaurant surrounded by Padi Fields 🌾.

Staff – Amazing service from the team 💁🏼‍♀️💁‍♂️💁🏾. They spoke 🗣️ good English 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿, always wearing a smile 😄 and polite. They received us at the entrance ⛩️ and guided us to our table. Once seated, the menu 📖was distributed. They gave us some suggestions while we are ordering 📝 as it was our first time there. 💥 Pro Tip : Just order the signature pork special 😋

Restaurant – Very beautiful 🥰traditional Indonesian design ✍️ and build 🪚🔨🪛🔩. Spacious, tall ceiling, very airy 💨, windy and surrounded by Padi 🌾🌾🌾 Fields. Where it should be, there are tiles and when it shouldn’t, it will have natural stones 🪨. #lovely Tables and chairs 🪑are wooden 🪵and gave a nice homely setting.

Food – Very well prepared and cooked 🧑🏽‍🍳👩🏽‍🍳👨🏾‍🍳 Babi Guling. Tried the Babi 🐷 Porsi Special and Nasi Ayam 🐓 and they are just so well marinated, soft and juicy! It just fell off the bones 🦴and went so well with the rice 🍚. It was a very, very satisfying meal 😋 and tick off all the check boxes ✅✅✅✅✅. What is more amazing is the low 📉cost to have a meal there. You can see from my pics. 📸, the menu dish is at about Rp$42,000 (before 10% tax) and that’s USD$2.60. So insane, I wish 💭 I had added on a takeaway. 🥡

There are a few Babi 🐷 Guling restaurants in Bali 🇮🇩 and this particular restaurant, I will highly recommend 😎 to all of you! So don’t miss it, get your driver to drive 🚙🚘🚖 you over, trust me, you will thank me! 🫶

author: T Sher
review_text: Very Pretty Location amidst of the Rice  Fields! A lot of local ppl come and enjoy meals there but need private transport to come. Near to Titi Waterfall. We ordered Porsi Special, Nasi Ayam, Rujak, fried spring rolls! All very very delicious especially the tender meat!

author: Stephanie Brookes
review_text: Best ever Babi (also chicken avail) experience .  The vibe is great and it’s totally 100% excellent service .  Highly recommend .  Delicious Babi - you can see the kitchen operation right there. Beautiful at sunset .  Around 50 k for dinner.  Total bargain.

author: Uyển Nhi Hồ
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Great local spot with plenty of options! The food was really good — I tried the babi guling, fried banana, and sweet soup, and all were delicious. The place is beautiful, spacious, and has lots of seating. Many locals eat here, which makes it feel authentic. A must-try restaurant if you want to experience real local food in Bali! 🍽️🐷🌿

author: shaivya poudyal
review_text: Might want to carry an insect repellent. Tried the Yummy Babi guling with crispy fried skin. Looked like a local fav, clean WCs and friendly service with comforting ambiance. Would totally visit again and happily recommend. Delish food and surper reasonly priced.

author: Gek Triana (Ms. Jung)
review_text: After a long time, I finally returned to the increasingly popular Babi Guling Pande Egi in Gianyar. It's changed a lot, and there are also new menu items. I didn't take many pictures because it was too crowded.

author: Inneke Mayachita
review_text: Highly recommended. They also have nasi ayam and lots other food including cakes, snacks, fruits

author: Alfred Hendric Salim
review_text: Foos taste good, the place is nice.. you eat beside a paddy field.. the servoce is just okay, all done efficiently, but no extra mile.. and it is not a bad thing.. 😃

author: Kenny Thirza
review_text:
They have lagre parking lot of car and motorcycle. Nice paddy field view. See the menu as attached, they have lot of items.
Nice and friendly staff.

author: Dimas Wijaya
review_text:
First time visit as we craving for Balinese babi guling, unfortunately the taste failed me! All combination is too dry and taste less, when I took the picture we were already excited but a dissapointment came later.
I think it's just more to the hype rather than quality to maintain its originality.
If I compared with Babi Guling bu Oka branch No.2 (only this branch), bu Oka still much much better to maintain their recipe and quality.
So, to conclude my recent visit to Pande Egi one-time is just enough, nothing special, tasteless, just over-rated.

author: Marek Dusza
review_text: Recommended to us by a local, this spot offered a pleasant experience overall. The food was fairly average—I tried the daily special along with chicken and rice, which were decent but nothing particularly memorable. Service was friendly and efficient, which made the visit easy and enjoyable. The real highlight was the setting, with a beautiful view overlooking the rice paddies.

author: Evita Hadiz
review_text: Padi field view whilst enjoying your food; feels like you are enjoying your meal in the middle of a padi field, yet you are in the middle of the city. Very creative idea from the owner. Mix western and local dishes with tasty desserts. Their spicy cheese burger, very thick and juicy beef burger with melted cheese topped with crispy veggies and with black bun. Very filling when you are hungry. The velvet cheese cake is just perfect and moist, not too sweet (as I don't like too sweet desert). Just enjoy a long lunch or dinner with friends and enjoy the food and the wonderful atmosphere.

author: Leticia JH
review_text:
great food! i especially lovee the gnocchi pesto, sauce was extremely rich and portion was generous.

love the vibe and the place too. great place to chill and hangout

author: Helmy MJ
review_text:
*Update* My apology on the staff name as my conversation with her I remember she said her name is Rita. I believe it is Ritzy as per her nametag. Hope you can convey my gratitude to her 🙏

————————————————————————————
Had a lovely lunch at Nook and thoroughly enjoyed the Crispy Duck à la Nook — perfectly crispy on the outside, tender and flavourful inside. The dish was beautifully prepared and very satisfying.

Service was excellent as well. Rita was attentive, friendly, and made the experience even more pleasant with her warm hospitality. A great lunch overall, and I’ll definitely be back!

author: bumble bee
review_text:
We had lunch at Nook Bali.

The food was quite tasty with satisfying flavors. The service was very friendly, helpful, and informative. Nook Bali offers a wide variety of menu options, ranging from appetizers and main courses to light pastries. The prices are still considered reasonable and standard for a tourist destination.

author: B Morsi
review_text:
Great restaurant with vast outdoor area facing rice fields.
Lots of non-smoking seating.
Food selection is fabulous with both western and Indonesian cuisine.  Including healthier choices.
Service is excellent and attentive.
Location is superb.
Non-pretentious vibe - Highly recommended

author: Mehmet Ali Eyuboglu
review_text:
A Hidden Gem with Stunning Views and Great Value!

We recently visited Nook, and it truly lived up to its reputation. The restaurant is situated on a large property right at the edge of a stunning rice field, offering that iconic, peaceful Bali vibe that everyone looks for.
The menu is incredibly diverse, catering to all tastes with impressive vegetarian and meat options. We were particularly intrigued by their specialty burgers—trying the black bun burger for the first time was a highlight! The presentation was top-notch and the quality of the ingredients was evident.
Commonly praised by many visitors—and we totally agree—is the relaxing atmosphere and the seamless service. Whether you prefer the smoking or non-smoking section, the layout feels breezy and comfortable. Also, having a dedicated parking area right in front is a huge plus in this area.
We paid approximately 300,000 IDR for two burger sets and a Bintang, which is excellent value for money considering the premium location and high-quality service. It’s the perfect spot for a casual yet high-quality meal with a view. Highly recommended!

author: Indy Gill
review_text: We went there more than a couple of times and the place overall was amazing!! We enjoyed it so much especially the warm service we received from the staff. Keep up the amazing work and food hits the spot every time!! ❤️👏🎉

author: Botak
review_text:
Interesting experience, where you sit facing the padi fields and have your meals.

Good variety of food and at normal restaurant prices and if you wish to have a taste of local food, they do serve a variety of them. Desserts are also many to choose from.

They have smoking and non smoking buildings and interestingly, the mozzles there don't sting, as I did not have any bites after the meal despite seeing many flying around.

author: Titi Athena
review_text: The breakfast board looked really beautiful and appetizing — such a nice presentation. However, the taste didn’t quite meet my expectations. The bread was unfortunately too hard to eat, and the watermelon wasn’t very fresh. I also noticed a slightly sweet taste in the scrambled eggs, which felt a bit unusual and didn’t blend well with the rest of the flavors. Overall, it looked amazing but could be improved in taste and freshness.

author: RenOverSea
review_text:
I came here to the Nook Western Restaurant without  much expectations, but I must admit that this place here is really a Delightful Escape here in Kerobokan.

The Restaurant blends Western and Indonesian flavors in a breezy, half-open garden setting that feels both relaxed and refined. The food is consistently satisfying—whether you're craving a juicy burger or a fragrant local dish—and the service is warm and attentive without being overbearing.
Surrounded by lush greenery, it’s the kind of place that invites you to linger. For anyone seeking great food, friendly vibes, and a touch of tropical charm, Nook is a spot I truly enjoy and highly recommend.

author: Jourdan Epstein
review_text: Highly recommend this place!! I only had 20 minutes when I arrived into town before an apointment but a friend said I mustn't miss this restaurant. When I arrived I told the wait staff of my time crunch as asked if it was possible, they brought a menu immediately, my food was out within 10 minute and it was DELISCIOUS!! the views are incredibly serene and the couch/chair was so comfortable, I wished I could have stayed for hours

author: S. N. Nindhita
review_text: a place where you can enjoy good food with a view of endless rice fields and a calming breeze. Such a relaxing spot—perfect for breakfast and brunch.

author: Bob Davis
review_text: Al fresco restaurant with interesting menu of Asian and Western fare set among beautiful padi fields. Nice selection of matcha flavours. Often busy so may have some wait to place order, drinks are served quickly once ordered, but food slow to arrive at busy times. Very popular with locals and tourists alike.

author: siraprapa puttasri
review_text: The tomato soup was too sweet like ketchup.The soto chicken soup was nice but the soup was warm not hot.And we ordered the chicken spring rolls,I couldn't taste and see some chicken in it at all.I just see only veggies inside in spring rolls.But we paid for chicken spring rolls😂 anyway the staff are Amazing.They will take care of you so well.

author: Mery Chang
review_text: We've always come here to eat when we're at Bali. Love the food and their ambience

author: Eddie Goh
review_text: The whole environment is very nice for all kind of events. During our visit there also a group of people celebrating birthday as well and the staff is also sing birthday song.

author: Angelia Margaretha
review_text: The food portion and pricing was pretty fair. The taste was good. What makes this place really special is the surrounding as you could enjoy the garden view and also the paddy field on the way.

author: eileen Tsao
review_text:
We had a lovely experience dining at Nook Bali. The setting is absolutely charming — nestled right next to lush rice fields, it offers a peaceful escape from the busy Seminyak scene. The view, especially during golden hour, is stunning and perfect for photos.

The food was delicious and nicely presented. We ordered a mix of local and Western dishes, and everything was flavorful and satisfying. The nasi campur was a standout — generous portions and very authentic. The smoothie bowls were fresh and vibrant too.

Service was friendly and relaxed, though not the fastest — but that’s part of the laid-back Bali vibe. Prices were reasonable considering the ambiance and quality of food.

Overall, Nook is a must-visit if you’re looking for a scenic, open-air spot with good food and a tranquil atmosphere. Great for brunch or a sunset meal!

author: Nathan Lam (Ben)
review_text: The food was decent, but the standout part of the experience was the setting. Looking out over a rice paddy while having dinner was very refreshing after the busy Bali streets. The options between Western and Balinese food were also great. Would highly recommend!

author: Melike Özden
review_text: It's a large area, and you can see the greenery and rice fields, which is relaxing. It also has separate smoking and non-smoking areas, which is nice. The prices are reasonable, and it's a nice place. We recommend it.

author: Dheon Mark (Prokopio)
review_text:
Walked here from my hotel on a hotel people rec ..worth every step!

Place was packed with locals & tourists, yet I was solo-seated instantly at a long table. Waiter spotted the foreigner in me and swapped the Bahasa menu for English in seconds 😄

Ordered Duck Tempong Rice + Hot Lime Juice.
Drink came fast, then a MOUNTAIN of food: crispy fried duck, steaming rice, fresh veggies (mystery greens but delicious), and a tiny bowl of sambal that could power a rocket. I can handle spice… but I tapped out after one dip 🔥

Watched locals eat with hands, respect! I stuck with my spoon & fork like a proper tourist.

Huge portions, authentic vibes, friendly service. Perfect local lunch during my short Bali Ingress trip.

If you want real Balinese heat (and a story), come hungry!

author: Wei Ting Tay
review_text:
Even though we came during peak lunch hours, my husband and I were seated quickly.

We ordered the Nasi Ayam tempong, Nasi Bebek tempong and Ikan Gurami goreng.

The rice sets were well balanced with plenty of vegetables(cucumber, chayote, eggplant and leafy greens), tempeh which were tasty, crispy tofu and the sambal was PEDASSSS but soooooo sedap🔥😍 ayam goreng was okay but bebek was 10/10 even though it was slightly salty. Ikan goreng was fresh and crispy i highly recommend. BEST MEAL i have eaten in Bali so far!

author: Punto Dewa
review_text:
Nasi Tempong Indra Dewi Sri is a great spot for anyone who loves spicy and flavorful Indonesian food. The sambal tempong is seriously powerful—in the best way—and gives that signature kick that makes the whole dish unforgettable. The vegetables are fresh, the chicken and fish are cooked perfectly, and everything tastes like proper homemade Banyuwangi-style comfort food.

Portions are generous and the prices are very reasonable. The place is simple but clean, and the service is quick and friendly. If you love bold, spicy flavors and want to try authentic nasi tempong, this is definitely the place to go. I left super satisfied and would happily come back again!

author: Ryan rizki
review_text:
Stopped by Tempong Indra for dinner, one of the popular local food spots in Bali. I’d give this place a 7.8/10.

The food is tasty and filling, but the price feels quite expensive compared to other Indonesian dishes with similar portions. One serving of nasi tempong ayam includes fried chicken, rice, tempe, and vegetables—simple Indonesian comfort food.

We ordered 2 nasi tempong ayam and 2 iced teas, and spent around IDR 150,000, which is definitely on the pricey side for this kind of meal.

Important note: the sambal is extremely spicy 🔥 Even for those who are used to spicy food, it really packs a punch. If you’re not a big fan of spicy food, it’s better to ask for less sambal or have it served separately.

Overall, Tempong Indra is worth a try for sambal lovers, but for Indonesian budget travelers, expect higher prices and very intense spice levels.

author: Syakira Mahadzir
review_text: I could eat here every day! The fish was crispy and amazing, no smell at all. The sambal is spicy as hell (in a good way!). Nice, clean environment and good vibes overall.

author: Nadia Nabila
review_text: If you love spicy sambal ++++ and samyang noodle is nothing for you, then you should try this! I would fly back to Bali just to eat this. Honestly.

author: annisa kanya
review_text:
Great place.
Tasty and humble staff, price good as well. Spicy but so goood, the service also fast.

Just be careful who bring kids or not comfortable with tobacco, since it’s permissible to smoke inside the restaurant.

author: Ghulam Muhammad
review_text: The chicken was smaller than I thought, but I love the sambal. The spiciness was perfect, a little bit sweet depth, and sour from the lime juice. Staffs were great and fast response.

author: Anjali
review_text: Wonderful atmosphere, there are also outdoor seatings available, which is a great add on for this restaurant. Great options for vegetarians, there are many varieties. There is quite a big delay in receiving food, but other than that it is fine. There is good parking area, for those who come here by car, motorbike or any other transport method. The food is nice and well plated, and there are also many drink options.

author: Christina Crenn
review_text:
Good food and service for a good price.
Unfortunately, the meal was a bit dry and the only sauce available is the sambal which is very spicy.
However, the napkins are poor quality, the owner should improve it.
The place is crowded and noisy due to its popularity. There is more room in the back of the restaurant.

author: Adam Ariffin
review_text: My first sightseeing of Bali is trying Ayam Geprek recommended by my girlfriend that time, the sambal is not too spicy which is just right although I wish the ayam goreng they provided should be larger in size and must be breast meat (not thigh or wing) for higher satisfaction but overall all good, and I met many Malaysians visiting the island during the pre-monsoon season.

author: kiwiez maESTro
review_text: A famous shop in Bali. Ordered their fried chicken & also gurame fish dish. I would say both were fried to perfection. Their main star is their chilli paste from ‘hell’. Would be nice if you can take that kind of spicyness level. The place was as packed as it gets. Service was fast and efficient.

author: Jong Chenny
review_text: Top 3 Tempong in Bali!! The sambal is shooooo spicy and shooo good!!! Fried chicken and prawn are the most ordered by us! Dont forget the sayur asam!!! 🤤🤤🤤

author: Brahmantia Muda
review_text: Good nasi tempong place. Fast services. The Sambal is really spicy.

author: Wasim Reza
review_text: Nasi Tempong Indra is a must-visit for authentic Indonesian flavors! I tried the beef, shrimp, and fried duck, and all were delicious—tender, flavorful, and cooked just right. Their signature sambal is spicy and addictive, adding the perfect kick to every bite. The portions are generous, and everything tasted fresh, especially the crispy tempeh and vegetables on the side. The staff was friendly, and the atmosphere was simple but clean and welcoming. If you’re craving real Banyuwangi-style nasi tempong, this place won’t disappoint!

author: Porter KHOR
review_text: Local restaurant decent value..menu has prices so not a tourist trap.  Chili is extremely spicy.  7/10.

author: Sasha Lam
review_text:
Spicy, saucy, and super satisfying
Tried the Nasi Tempong Udang (58K) and Ikan Laut (73K) — both solid 8.5/10.
But honestly... the sambal stole the show.

TikTok @sashaamalow

author: Mohamed Aslam
review_text: My first Balinese dish was from here, and I opted for the duck, which was absolutely top-notch. The place is always crowded with locals, which speaks volumes about its quality. The prices were reasonable, and the food was amazing. The spicy sambal is fiery hot but incredibly tasty!

author: Jessica Tan
review_text:
Sambal is very spicy! Be sure to order a lot of ice tea to recover. I would like to recommend the sayur asam, the portion is big enough, and cheap.

The place is quite big, but since it’s semi outdoor, it kinda feels hot. Maybe bring your own mini fan would help.

author: Dedex
review_text: I rolled up for lunch with my friends. The place was clean, not too hot, and the portions were huge for me. I liked that they hooked it up with lots of veggies. The food was kinda too salty for my taste. The sambal didn't really hit spicy at first, but it lowkey burned in my stomach later.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Lamemamabear Sonja
review_text:
Local cheap eats for sure! Fried pork (Babi Guling) place is limited seating, outside seating available. There’s only 1 choice of food, which comes with a delicious bone broth, with options of sizes that’s all.
Food was yum, and spicy. Even if you asked for non spicy, the kids can’t handle it, it has the spices infused into the veggies. I saw some families brought in KFC or packet fried pork skins, for their kids as replacements

During our meal, we could hear pigs being slaughtered… it sure is an experience!
Very crowded place n constant people. We were very fortunate to arrive n seated with 2 tables leaving just as we arrived.

Not ideal for large groups otherwise

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Marudut Manullang
review_text:
I always stop by this place every time I’m in Bali. The food never disappoints — honestly, it tastes better and more authentic than the place next door.

The seating area is pretty simple, nothing fancy. It can get a bit warm if you sit outside, so keep that in mind.

Overall, it’s a solid spot and definitely worth a visit. The only thing that could be better is the service — a bit more friendliness, especially toward local travelers, would make the experience even nicer.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Hamish Richardson
review_text:
The tastiest food I ate in Bali, hands down.

Went on a Saturday, incredibly busy with both locals and tourists. Pretty quick to order at counter and then try to find a seat wherever you can.

I got the regular size Nasi Campur Babi Guling (45k idr). Incredibly tasty, some of the sambals that come with it are very spicy.

Come for delicious, spicy pork. Don’t come for fine dining experience.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Maria Natalia
review_text: Tried this dish like 3 years ago and I didn’t have a quite of good experience. Come back here to do some confirmation for myself. I like the soup’s taste, the rice is okay and somehow the crispy pork is off. Still worth the price and worth to try. Just sometimes the line is crazy long, you need to go straight to the cashier to order and pay before you can take your food.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Virginia Januarielle
review_text:
The flavors are rich and well seasoned, everything tastes satisfying and full of character.

One standout is the flour crackers, they’re very different from the usual ones. It feels like they’re mixed with thin slices of meat or skin, making them extra savory and addictive. I always end up adding more.

The downside is that the place is almost always crowded, so finding a seat can be difficult. Food waiting time can also be quite long during peak hours.

Still, the taste makes it worth the wait. A solid choice if you’re looking for authentic, bold babi guling flavors.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Juber Herrera
review_text: Babi Guling at Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil was acceptable and reasonably priced for the location. One thing to keep in mind: the food is very spicy, and this is not indicated on the menu. If you’re sensitive to spice, it’s a good idea to ask the staff for recommendations or request a milder option. The experience is authentic, but be prepared!

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Simon Quek
review_text: The most amazing babi guling in town. We never miss this whenever we are in Bali. We have tried others, but we always come back here. Spicy yet flavourful. Definitely have to order the special set.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Marvella Elfreda
review_text: Best babi guling spot in south Bali. Not too spicy but very flavorful and aromatic. Since it is a popular place for babi guling, don't expect to sit down immediately, or to have your food served fast. Service wise, it is a warung so you can't expect a 5 star dining experience. But was is an experience dining here is the friendly dogs, aromatic smoke from the pork being roasted and the overall balinese local food experience. Might be pricy for a babiguling but the portion size was generous and cmon, it is a tourist place with lots of staff, it would be a bit more pricy.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Kevin Kurniawan
review_text: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil is famed for its generous portions and rich Balinese spices. The roasted pork is savory with crispy skin, served with lawar and spicy sambal. A humble eatery, yet always bustling with locals and tourists seeking authentic flavors.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Charles Edison
review_text:
For me, the taste is delicious but not that special
Also maybe for some people it's a little pricey and if u want something fast this not the place because u have to wait maybe around 20-30 min to get your food in the table.
Place is small, sometimes crowded and cannot find table to sit down so have to wait.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Keyla Joanne
review_text:
The food at Babi Guling Pak Dobil was genuinely delicious, and it's clear why the place is so popular. We understood the long wait, which was over an hour for our food to arrive, as the restaurant was incredibly busy. We were happy to be patient for what we knew would be a great meal.

However, the wonderful taste of the food was overshadowed by the very poor service we received. The staff, particularly a male server, was incredibly rude. Given how hot the weather was, we simply asked if our drinks could be brought out first while we waited for our food. This simple request was met with a surprisingly surly attitude.

While the babi guling itself is fantastic, the unpleasant service is a major concern. It's disappointing when a restaurant with such delicious food is let down by its staff's behavior. Because of the rude service, I would have to think twice before returning, despite how much I enjoyed the meal.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: nixam
review_text:
The best soup and variety of dishes I've had in Bali, so authentic and the flavours were just WOW!
I'm not good with chilli so I found it spicy but manageable and worth every hiccup I got from the spiciness 😅
Due to it being very popular and busy, the wait is long so make sure you get your drinks order first. Best to take cash but I think they also accept cards (unsure though).
Traditional eatery AKA no air con so be prepared with the heat both from the weather and food.
Definitely worth a visit - I've not found any other warung with these amazing flavours!

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Shirley B
review_text: not the best babi guling but this one is quite ok. love the pork satay which one of the speciality for this restaurant. parking lot is very small, the restaurant ambience is also very busy. better to sit at the outdoor area so it wont be too peak.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Sherli J
review_text: Best bigul spot in Bali! Perfectly balanced sambal (not too aromatic), juicy pork, and rich, moist, layered flavor. Will absolutely come back! ❤️

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: мιѕѕувєlα2828
review_text:
We were really looking forward to trying this babi guling spot in Nusa Dua, which came recommended by our hotel. It’s one of those roadside local stalls that promises an authentic experience.

We ordered three jumbo set meals, along with one extra serving of pork skin and fried pork fritters (we were told that was the maximum allowed for add-ons). The meal was a mix of hits and misses. The standout was definitely the fried pork fritters — crispy, flavorful, and addictive. However, the pork skin wasn’t as crispy as we had hoped and was quite tough to bite through. The pork meat itself was rather dry and lacked the juiciness we were expecting from a good babi guling.

There was no proper queue system in place, so we had to hover and wait around to get a table. The dining environment was also very hot and humid, and we ended up sweating through the entire meal.

Overall, it was an interesting local experience, but the food didn’t quite live up to the hype for us.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Regina Siena
review_text: It's the OG nasi Babi Guling! The service very in rush and not attentive but trust me the taste was amazing. All of the component was there on one plate. The soup was spicy and warm. Legend since beginning!

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Vania Haryanto
review_text: It’s been forever since i last visited, and it’s superb! Finished my plate in less than 10 mins. Queued for a bit but then after there’s quite long queue on lunch time.

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: WM Chan
review_text:
The establishment lacks clear signage differentiating between dine-in and takeaway queues, potentially leading to customer confusion. It is advisable to verify the correct queue before proceeding.

The ordering process was efficient, and a queue number was provided after a few indecisive customers. However, a delay of approximately 20 minutes was experienced before my food came.

The regular portion is recommended for first-time customers to manage expectations.

The dish contained a single piece of pork skin, approximately 15mm x 15mm, with a chewy texture. While the meat was tender, the accompanying crackling included hard chicken skin. Customers with dentures should exercise caution.

The sauce offered a flavorful, spicy profile. However, the soup was perceived as overly salty despite its rich taste.

The dining environment had poor ventilation and sticky table surfaces..

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: Stephen Chan
review_text:
I had my doubts about Warung Babi Guling Dobil, given the unanimous recommendations from hotel and service staff. But, curiosity got the better of me, and I decided to give it a shot.

The verdict? Excellent food! We arrived at 10am, and the restaurant was already bustling. The pig skin was crispy perfection, the pork was cooked just right, and the green and red chili mixture added a depth of flavor that complemented the rice beautifully.

The ambience, while not the fanciest, has a certain charm to it. The open-air seating might not be for everyone, but it's part of the restaurant's laid-back charm.

Despite its unassuming appearance, Warung Babi Guling Dobil is a must-visit for fans of Balinese cuisine. I'll definitely be back for more!

restaurant: Warung Babi Guling Sari Dewi Bp. Dobil
author: KF Yap
review_text: Another great option for babi guling here in Bali, especially if you’re in Nusa Dua area highly recommended.

author: Dahee Sohn
review_text:
We ordered the acai bowl and fruit platter, and both were absolutely delicious and incredibly fresh. From the first bite, you could really taste the quality of the ingredients. The acai bowl was perfectly balanced—not too sweet, smooth and refreshing—with generous toppings of fresh fruit that added great texture and flavour. It felt nourishing and light, yet still filling.
