The fruit platter was equally impressive, featuring a colourful selection of ripe, juicy fruits that were clearly prepared fresh to order. Everything tasted vibrant and natural, making it a perfect choice for a healthy meal or snack, especially in Bali’s warm climate.

Beyond the food, the vibe of this place really stood out. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, with a positive energy that made it easy to sit back and enjoy the moment. The people were friendly and warm, adding to the overall experience and making us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived.

This spot feels like more than just a place to eat—it’s somewhere you can slow down, enjoy fresh food, and soak in a great atmosphere. If you’re looking for a place with healthy, well-prepared dishes, a great vibe, and genuinely nice people, this is definitely worth visiting. We really enjoyed our time here and would happily come back again.

author: Cherry
review_text: I thought Crate Cafe was just a TikTok-raved spot, but it really exceeded expectations! The portions were huge and worth every penny, the food was delicious, and there were plenty of vegan options. The shakes weren’t just Instagram-worthy—they tasted amazing too. Definitely a spot I’d return to!

author: Sue M
review_text: First time visiting, a close walk to my accommodation, arrived before 7 am so it was very quiet and quick service. I walked by yesterday and it was very busy, so I decided to go today and check it out. Asked the barista about the menu and he was kind enough to provide some suggestions. Huge variety. Ordered cappuccino and a smoothie bowl. Great atmosphere. My only suggestion would be to provide a serviette with the cutlery  🙏🏼

author: Sharath Yarrapothu
review_text: Had a delicious chicken salad and a latte at Crate Café, Bali. The food strikes the perfect balance between healthy and tasty — fresh ingredients, great textures, and really satisfying without feeling heavy. Loved the relaxed, vibrant vibe of the place too. A must-visit if you enjoy clean eating with bold flavours.

author: Ilya
review_text: Amazing spot! Crate is a gem for anyone who loves healthy and tasty food. I got the massive chicken salad (Chick Chik boom) - it was so fresh and satisfying that it was a challenge to finish, especially with my protein smoothie on the side. Great portions, fantastic flavors, and affordable prices. I can't recommend it enough and will definitely be back!

author: Jimmy Vee
review_text:
This place is great. I love you he atmosphere, the people are friendly and it's just a great place to have a coffee and share a great convo.

Staff are friendly and take care of you. All round it's a great place to be.

I come here regularly.
I recommend the Salmon and avocado 🥑 on toast or the blueberry protien smoothie.

author: Dmitrii
review_text:
The Dr ABC juice was heavily watered down with ice. The Hipstar Smoothie bowl was tasty, but it was impossible to finish all the yogurt. In general, the food here seems to be for people who love to eat a lot. I believe the focus is on quantity over quality.

The tables are clean and nice, and there were almost no queues. You can't hear the road noise; the music is loud enough so that surrounding conversations don't stand out — it's a cool vibe. The prices are nett (tax included), which is rare for Bali. There is a large parking area.

author: felicity edmondson
review_text: I returned here several times during my trip. The service was quick and the staff were really friendly. The coffee was good, most of the food I had was good too, but I found the chicken salad under-seasoned and lacking in most of the ingredients listed. The atmosphere was generally good, but I found the music quite loud at times.

author: I komang Budiarta
review_text: Had an amazing experience at Crate Canggu! I ordered a salad and a smoothie bowl, and both were delicious. The ingredients tasted really fresh, the flavors were balanced, and the presentation was on point. The café has such a cool vibe with friendly staff and a great atmosphere. Highly recommend for anyone looking for healthy and tasty options in Canggu.

author: Jennifer
review_text:
I stopped by for the first time today and tried one of their chia bowls, felt like a queen breakfast 👸🏼
Beautifully balanced, fresh, not overly sweet, and surprisingly filling.

The cafe itself is bright, open and welcoming. You can feel that people enjoy being here, it's easy to settle in and easy to strike up a conversation if you're in the mood. Staff was attentive and kind, even during the busy hours.

A couple of small things to note: the overall noise level can get a bit intense when it's crowded, and I personally would love to see a water station or some served water added in the future. Little touch, big impact.

Other than that, great experience, fair value, and it seems like they're preparing to open a new spot in Pererenan, which is exciting.

Would definitely come back for the bowl alone.

author: Floriane Ying
review_text: Very disappointing overall. The portions are impressive and beautifully presented, but the quality isn’t there. We waited over 30 minutes to get our plates… reducing portion size but improving service speed might help. Giving 2 stars because I’m a mango smoothie fan, and theirs was easily the best in Bali.

author: mathew lawton
review_text: Great place for morning breakfast. Great vibe and the food portions are big. Can be a bit busy and noisy but I think that adds to the atmosphere of the place. Ordering at the counter is quick and simple. Then you just need to find a seat and they will deliver the food to you. Perfect for small or big groups as they have different table sizes.

author: Nam
review_text:
Review of Crate Café

I had an average experience at Crate Café. They only offer matcha with sugar, but to be fair, they were transparent about it from the start, which I appreciated. I ordered the breakfast plate—nothing special. The bread was quite average and the eggs were slightly undercooked. I also asked for no rocket salad, but it was served on top anyway, which was a bit disappointing.

The prices are okay, and overall you get what you pay for. Not bad, but nothing that makes me want to return.

author: Lorine Fyrd
review_text:
It might not be the most refined restaurant in Bali, but it’s become my go-to spot — the food is super tasty and the portions are generous! In terms of value for money, I haven’t found anything better in Canggu. They’re pretty quick too, so I don’t get the negative reviews…
The best!

author: Lalo Salamanca
review_text:
When i say this place is absolutely overrated to bits, i mean it.

Ordered a chicken salad and got a big feeding bowl full of lettuce and a couple of chicken pieces.

No way a COW can eat these many veggies at once let alone a human.

This is the last time i let insta influencers dictate my breakfast options

author: Aries Lai
review_text: Soooo disappointed! This ice coffee keeps melting. And this look terrible. How they can think the drinks keeps melting gonna be look good? So terrible aesthetics! The customer just needs drinks and food tastes good and provides good service! That all we need! Sooo bad! Pls don’t order this ice coffee frappe. Tastes like water. I can’t finished. I rated it -15 out of 10(minus 15)

author: Tom Quelch
review_text: Crate serves up massive portions, every dish is packed with flavour and made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The atmosphere is lively and full of energy. Easily the best brunch spot I found on the island. No doubt about it. Perfect for starting your day right.

author: ELLA ESHAGHIAN
review_text: This place was like a fever dream….no  actually a nightmare. Rather than being welcomed upon entering we were immediately scolded for having bottles of water and told they’d have to be kept behind the bar even though we expressed our intention to all order drinks. The menu is confusing and doesn’t describe the items or ingredients properly at all. When I asked whether the frappe had cream I was told no. I asked to add cream and pay for it and I was told no again. The drink then arrived with cream on top. The drinks are all for show and taste horrible. Some drinks are comically large whilst others are comically small but of course none of it is stated on the menu. The frappe is comically large but mostly ice. It arrived served on a plate which half of it had spilled onto which the waiter unapologetically ignored. The food is also all for show but lacks any flavour. My friend ordered the “bacon burrito” which was 99% egg filling wrapped in an egg tortilla with one tiny piece of bacon. He also ordered a side of hash brown which somehow also resembled egg and was inedible. The whole experience felt like a ridiculous prank.

author: Faye Ysabela Ong
review_text:
Great restaurant in central Canggu. We had breakfast smoothie bowls here and for the price, we were fully expecting something small. It turned out to be such a huge portion and was so good too! The menu is also quite extensive and I would have loved to try more of their stuff.

It wasn’t the easiest to find a table at around 11 (brunch and lunch rush), but it’s a great crowd of mostly tourists and we were all quite happy to share the tables with one another.

author: justine marie
review_text:
August 2024
Amazing breakfast spot in Canggu for açaí and smoothie bowls! The portions were huge and everything was so delicious — fresh, flavorful, and super satisfying.

The place has such a nice vibe — relaxed, tropical, and totally fitting for the Canggu atmosphere. The staff were friendly, and the service was fast, which made the experience even better.

A must-visit if you’re in the area and craving something fresh and healthy to start your day!

author: Aulia Rahman Putra (Aulia Putra)
review_text: A restaurant serving Tahitian-inspired cuisine. A pleasant place with friendly and welcoming service. The food is quite interesting, with a wide variety of dishes. A pleasant place to enjoy the evening with seafood specialties and warm drinks.

author: Jenna Nguyen
review_text: I liked that the menu had a wide variety of foods to choose from however most of the dishes that came out looked good, but lacked flavor. Wasn’t bad, but the dish could’ve been more seasoned. It is a cute little spot and the portions are large. Good for families. Not pictured was the banana bread dessert- that was a WOW⭐️ I would come back just for that!

author: Рудольф
review_text:
Good place with good interior.
Serving is fast
But food needs to point more attention. I Ordered Tuna starter and got CANNED TUNA😂 For seafood restaurant this is unacceptable .
Prawns really good.
Fish is  average

So total 4 points from 5

author: Efi Love Light
review_text: One of the best places in Bali! Fantastic food, exceptional service and super friendly staff! We come here at least once a day to have a drink or something to eat, and every time it's a real treat! The atmosphere is also very nice and the restaurant is lovingly decorated with a touch of Hawaiian culture, which we find very appealing and special! Well done, guys, and thank you very much for your hospitality! ❤️🫶🏼

author: Maria Bp
review_text: Moana Fish Eatery is one of my favorite restaurants in Bali. It’s always the first place I visit when I arrive, and I usually go at least once a week. Recently, I came with my family, and they loved it as much as I do. The food is always fresh and delicious, the atmosphere is cozy, and the service is excellent. I’d like to give a special mention to the manager, who has been incredibly kind and welcoming. Thank you for making every visit such a wonderful experience!

author: Melisa Lalalaa
review_text: This is my first time try a fish poke bowl. Taste so fresh, as Im not usually eating fish. The sauces helps so much.

author: Phillip Smith
review_text:
The food was amazing. Coconut cheesecake was really delicious.  When we left it was pouring rain with no end in sight. Our hotel was just a short walk and one of the workers walked us home with his umbrella. That was really
kind and very good customer service

author: Dwi Novita Cahyaningtyas Permatasari
review_text:
Always want to come back for the poke bowl.
The ambiance is equally inviting—cozy, warm, and perfect for a relaxed meal. Whether you’re dining solo or with friends, it’s a spot that makes you never feel disappointed.

author: Vadym Kasyan
review_text:
Really great place! The fish and seafood are super fresh,  you can actually taste the quality. The dishes are prepared clean and balanced, without heavy sauces or too much oil, so you get that natural flavor of the ingredients.

Service was friendly and attentive, and the staff helped with recommendations. The atmosphere is relaxed and cozy, a nice spot to enjoy a slow meal by the sea.

Definitely recommend if you're looking for fresh, tasty food and a calm vibe. I’ll be coming back for sure 🙌

author: Roberta Ballista
review_text:
High quality food, very fresh fish, with a relaxed ambiance and a perfect friendly service and reasonable prices.
I tried many dishes, and I can recommend especially the super fresh tuna carpaccio, oysters, squid skewers, bora bora and all the homemade desserts!
Special mention for Ayu the manager who let us feel like at home. Congratulations to all the staff

author: Merry'sHouse
review_text: I had pasta and it was very delicious. The atmosphere was nice and tropical. There is no air conditioning, but it's not that hot.

author: Troy Henriques
review_text: An outstanding lunch with my family at a lovely restaurant. The Polynesian theme and atmosphere was calming and captured the vibe really well. The food was beautifully cooked, mild spices with perfectly cooked fish. A memorable lunch!

author: Luca
review_text:
The best fish I’ve eaten in Bali.
I had tuna carpaccio and it was absolutely delicious. Fresh, well prepared, and full of flavor.

Highly recommended if you want to eat great fish in the center of Bali. The staff was very kind, welcoming, and attentive, which made the experience even better.

author: Jade Bacciarelli
review_text: Love this little nook! Moana has such a good variety of seafood dishes - if you’re looking for good quality fish and wanting to experience that tropical feel - Moana is the place 💕

author: Shem Shem
review_text:
A fantastic spot for seafood lovers in Canggu! The food is top-notch — everything is super fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. I especially enjoyed the grilled shrimp and calamari — you can really taste the quality. The staff is another highlight: polite, attentive, and always happy to help with recommendations. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming — a great place to spend an evening.

Photos on Google don’t do it justice — it’s so much better in person! I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to others!

author: Umut O.
review_text: Maui Poke was one of the best poke bowls i’ve ever had in my life. Super fresh fish, really good sauces. The coconut cheesecake was also amazing. Love it.

author: Julian Perez Granizo
review_text:
Stuff so kind as always in Bali 🌸
Now food was seriously good! Had the tuna platter oh yes baby yes put it in my mouth

author: Kseniya
review_text:
Don’t recommend👎 it’s like a cheap warung. Look at all pictures in the reviews and you’ll understand.

The food is average, it is not very bad, it’s just not the taste and quality that you expect to get.

We ordered shrimp curry and raw tuna.

author: Юрий Соловьев
review_text: The tuna poke bowl is good. But was better poke and for less money.

author: Tanja Zoellner
review_text:
Top value for money! I especially love the ambience and Polynesian style. The fish was very tasty and the coconuts are large.
The staff are very friendly and attentive. Would definitely come again!

author: Polina Mashkova
review_text:
Cuca is a refined and well thought out dining experience that feels relaxed and welcoming, which suits Bali perfectly.

It was especially pleasant to see that they offer a kids menu with food that children actually enjoy and are happy to eat. There is also a small playground on site, which makes dining here much easier and more enjoyable for families.

The menu for adults is designed around sharing, which is a great concept and works beautifully for a social dinner. Dishes are easy to divide and try together, making the experience feel more connected and relaxed.

The food itself felt quite simple. It may be that we chose similar dishes, or perhaps several items rely on frying, which made the flavours feel less complex than expected. Still, everything was well prepared and nicely presented.

Overall, it is a lovely place for a calm and elevated evening, especially if you are visiting with family and want good food in a comfortable, thoughtful setting.

author: Grace Chen
review_text:
Out of expectation in every aspect!
Amazing food with great creativity, amazing staffs and atmosphere, such an honor to have dined in this amazing restaurant!
If i have the chance to come back to Bali again in my life, i would definitely fly over to dine, no matter where i am.
Highly recommend chili satay, the beef bone; for dessert, if you enjoy tropical fruit, PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE get the Bali breakfast. SOOO GOOD OMG.

author: Kyeong Eun Kim
review_text:
Absolutely amazing. My friend and I stayed in Jimbaran for about 5 days and this is the best restaurant that we have visited. The food of course was on the top and the service delivery was amazing. We absolutely enjoyed every dish and would definitely come back again. It is the place that you must try the chef menu and you know you won’t be disappointed at all!

We went with 9 different options and added oysters on top of that. Oysters were so fresh and it was one of the best ones we have tried all across the world.

My absolute favorite was their scallop and my friend’s favorite was the bao. We both loved their special on that day, which was the oyster. I have been recommending to all my friends who are visiting Bali soon and especially whoever is visiting the Jimbaran area!

With the horrible Bali traffic and a closure of the road the day we were visiting, we had a major delay. However, the staffs were very understanding and friendly. No reason to not visit this restaurant. The price is extremely reasonable as well.

author: Paul Pistore
review_text:
On our third visit to Cuca, we decided to try the Tasting Menu. We really enjoyed the almost theatrical experience of sitting at the bar overlooking the kitchen. Watching the team of chefs prepare their amazing dishes was hypnotic and exciting
The service was impeccable, as always. The staff always make us feel welcome and well taken care of.
Although, not every dish hit with all of us (it is a tasting menu after all), the ingredients and presentation were excellent.
We thoroughly enjoyed the experience.
Even though it's been a few years since visiting Cuca, we felt like we were recognized and appreciated.
As a bonus, one of the owners visited us at the end of the meal to re-welcome us and asked us how we had enjoyed our experience.
He even presented us with a special gift!
As a fun and special fine dining experience, Cuca is unbeatable.

author: Chin Perera
review_text:
We found Cuca just after we landed back in Bali and we really enjoyed our experience there. We ordered the following:
Nachos
Broccoli caeser
Roast pork buns (one of our favs)
Crispy fried chicken
Spicy crab (my fav)

The ambience of the restaurant was really cool. Large open air spaces with drawback partitions for privacy. Dimly lit but not too dark. You can see the entire kitchen as well.

The staff were so friendly and attentive we really enjoyed our time there and highly recommend going there.

Thank you for the amazing food and experience team!

author: Jared Myers
review_text: What a great restaurant to visit! We went twice on our trip and did both tasting menu one and two! They were both very good with number one being the better of the two! The desserts were excellent! They have tons of staff who are all very friendly and helpful throughout the whole dinner experience! Overall a great restaurant that would otherwise be more expensive back home!

author: Lisa Sierra
review_text:
This place is an experience that is worth every dollar. This is a long review but hopefully gives you information you might look for.
Dress code island casual to dressy, you wouldn’t feel out of place in either.
We loved the dishes and the experience, the discussion and anticipation was half the experience! This was our second dinner in four days because the first was so good.

Both times we all looked at our chef’s tasting menus 1 the first time and two the second and chose what we each thought would be our top three of the evening and in almost all cases we were wrong!

CucaBali expanded our palates and the experience with your pairings on the plate and suggestions from your staff.

Some made us curious, two we all had definite reactions to, others surprised and many just delighted.    We tried each others drinks, and endlessly discussed the food, the order which things were served and what order we would have eaten them in, we tried to eat slowly to not get too full, but ended up very full and satisfied.

We had menu two this time - and I will tell you that I was going to try the Fish tartare, but had told my dining friends they could have my portion when we first reviewed the menu as I don’t usually eat sushi but love ceviche and didn’t think I would like it. That ended up being my favourite dish of the night! I ate more than my share!!

We loved the Bbq Octopus, roasted pork buns, pumpkin salad from our first visit and it was hard to watch them get prepped and leave the kitchen! We had intended to do Al a carte but couldn’t narrow down our choices so went tasting menu 2

Diner 2 tried to order a Tea-irmisu (sp?) but Veri  kindly explained it wouldn’t survive our long warm journey back to Seminyak. That’s how much she loved it ❤️

Diner 3  said his favourites were the Hawaiian Cracker, Lobster roll, crab and fish tartare, and chocolate cake.

Diner 2said her favourites were Fish Tartare, Moroccan Meatballs, Lobster roll, both desserts then crab and broccoli Caesar

Mine were Fish Tartare, morroccan meatballs, Hawaiian Cracker, Crab, the frozen yogurt dessert

Unfortunately, it was unanimous hands down for savoury cotton candy. Not aligned with our taste buds but tried it both visits.

The peppers with chicken inside - were a definite hit and we all loved those as well!

Drinks were again favourites of our trip!

Thanks to your incredible staff - here are some shout outs
Lala -Server from our first dinner kept things paced  perfectly, not too fast not too slow, great explanations, perfect amount of chat
She was so knowledgeable about the food

Veri- Server last night, attentive, anticipatory, there to explain, kept us hydrated since it was warmer at the bar, reminded us to take our pictures before we ate ( my parents wanted photos :)) because we kept eating before we remembered to get a photo.

Yuli- hostess last night enjoyed chatting with her and discussing weather, travel, and food

Heri and Casper who explained our dishes and oversaw our food

Everyone else was professional and warm and lovely almost as if they had invited you to their home.

author: A
review_text: We were there for lunch and had the whole restaurant to ourselves. The food kept surprising us in a great way, service was amazing. We felt extremely well taken care of. Everything was pristine! Highly recommend. They have a park and kids menu so it’s great for families too!

author: Hugo MORICEAU
review_text:
We had the chance to enjoy an amazing dinner there.
The dishes and recommendations were excellent, especially the restaurant’s best sellers. Every plate was crafted with great attention to flavor, texture, and creative combinations.

The oysters with pearls were simply heavenly and perfectly captured the spirit of the whole meal. The crispy rice was also unique, as was the Cuca breakfast dessert. This is definitely a must-visit restaurant in Bali for food lovers—whether you’re with friends, your partner, or family.

The open kitchen adds a special touch, allowing you to watch the chefs at work.

The only small detail for me was the wine, which didn’t quite match my taste with the dishes, and the spicy sauce, even though I usually enjoy spicy flavors.
Apart from that, the mocktails and service were absolutely exceptional.

author: Louise Cooper
review_text:
Fabulous!!!
Such a wonderful evening. It is hard to believe you are in Bali when you step into the immaculate modern space. Every effort is made to make you feel welcome.
We had a drink in the beautiful garden area surrounded by fairy lights. I had the Bloody Mary- wow!!!! This is one of the nicest drinks I’ve had in a long time. The ice was tomato pearls and the drink itself was so light and flavoursome- I need ti go back just to try this again.
We did the tasting menu. I highly recommend sitting at the bar overlooking the kitchen. It was wonderful to watch the talented staff at their stations working their magic.
Food was so inventive and different. So refreshing to go somewhere where the talent is so high and the skill levels to try imaginative pairings that work so well and are all cooked to perfection.
I cannot recommend this restaurant more highly. It is not just a dinner but an experience.
My favourite was the octopus- I have no idea how they made it so tender. My partner loved the beef bone marrow.
Hopefully we can fit in another visit before we leave Bali to try some of the dishes that weren’t on the testing menu and to have another Bloody Mary!

author: Diana Anghelus
review_text: This place definitely deserves 5 stars! It is the perfect restaurant if you are looking for a fine dining experience. From the moment you get to the gate till the end , they make you feel special. They have a tablet where they show you how each dish looks which is very helpful. Just be mindful that the portions are pretty small. We ordered the Almost Bbq Ribs and the Bbq Octopus and they were very small. So if you are very hungry, keep this in mind. We only wanted to check it out and didn't come starving, otherwise we would have ended up ordering more. FYI, the ribs come in two small pieces. They also offered us some complementary dish that looks like small marshmallow with the texture of a cotton candy - Cotton Betutu. Definitely give it a try.

author: Marlon Lierz
review_text:
We had an amazing dinner at Cuca in Jimbaran. All the tapas were creative and full of flavor, and the cocktails were excellent.

The atmosphere is beautiful and relaxing, perfect for a special evening. But the best part was the service, especially from our waitress Putu. She was incredibly warm, kind, and attentive – we truly enjoyed talking with her. Her hospitality made the night unforgettable. We highly recommend Cuca and will definitely come back! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

author: Kris
review_text:
Had a great time at Cuca Restaurant! The food was spot on, and that octopus dish? Easily one of the best I’ve had—perfectly tender, beautiful char, and a savoury sauce that tied it all together. Cooking octopus right isn’t easy, so props to them. Every dish had such a unique twist, making me feel as though "this is what going to a restaurant should be like." Nothing over the top with fancy techniques - just flavour bombs that take a lot of work to get to, with a clear vision of the chef.

The service was very attentive without being intrusive. I dropped a pair of chopsticks, and before I could even pick them up, a new pair was given to me. We had less than an hour to eat, but they somehow managed to get all the dishes out quickly without making it feel rushed.

The atmosphere was gorgeous too - one of those places you could happily linger in if you had more time.

(The coconut cocktail was so good, too!)

Definitely worth going back!

author: ARMANDO HISUAN
review_text: Cuca Restaurant offers an exceptional dining experience that combines creativity, flavor, and elegance. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted using fresh, locally sourced ingredients, highlighting both artistry and taste. The restaurant’s ambiance is modern yet relaxed, providing a perfect setting for a memorable meal. The staff deliver impeccable service — professional, warm, and attentive throughout. Overall, Cuca stands out as a fine example of world-class dining that celebrates culinary innovation and local inspiration.

author: Sean D
review_text:
An unforgettable gem in Bali. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was perfect. Elegant, quiet, and deeply private. It felt like we had stepped into our own little world. The service was exceptional, with staff who were attentive, kind, and incredibly polite without ever being intrusive.

We chose the romantic package and were welcomed with a breathtaking flower arrangement that immediately set the tone. Each course of the chef’s tasting menu impressed us more than the last. The flavors were bold and inventive, blending local culture with modern twists that elevated every bite. It was easily one of the best tasting menus we experienced during our entire time in Bali.

They adapted the entire menu on the spot for my wife’s seafood allergy without hesitation, and the alternative dishes were just as delicious. The attention to detail and care they showed were beyond impressive.

At the end of the night, we were given a thoughtful gift that we’ll genuinely treasure. The entire experience felt curated, luxurious, and heartfelt. The pricing was more than fair for the quality and care provided. This place offers a Michelin-like experience that we cannot recommend highly enough. Add it to your Bali itinerary. You won’t regret it.

author: Pongpon Phanthaphuek
review_text:
I’ve dined here twice already, both times while visiting Bali from Thailand, and it has become a must-visit spot for me. The food is absolutely delicious, the drinks are excellent, and the staff provide warm and attentive service. The atmosphere is also wonderful, making the whole experience even more enjoyable.

Most importantly, everything is great value for money. The prices are very reasonable and not at all out of reach.

Highly recommended if you’re in Bali. Definitely worth a visit!

author: Marsha Malinda
review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Cuca Restaurant in Bali, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. I ordered a variety of dishes. Each dish was thoughtfully prepared, full of flavor, and beautifully presented.

The service was equally impressive—attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. I also loved the ambience: the dining room felt relaxed and intimate, perfect for a cozy evening meal without feeling too formal.

If you're in Bali and looking for a place that combines inventive cuisine with warm service and a comfortable setting, I highly recommend giving Cuca a visit.

author: Bebek
review_text:
Interesting fine-dining twist on tapas - this was definitely a unique eating experience and a creative approach to tapas style cuisine.

Whilst the establishment claims to not be a fine-dining experience (as written on the menu), everything about Cuca suggests otherwise. Being escorted through the courtyard on arrival, each small plate being introduced as they were served, the special service provided by the staff and, of course, the price.

Whilst we had an enjoyable experience here, we didn't actually eat much - just three tapas dishes and a couple of (non-alcoholic) drinks between the two of us, whilst the menu suggested six tapas dishes per person. Despite the small order, we still ended up spending over one million rupiah, and sadly left still feeling peckish.

Nevertheless, the overall experience was pretty enjoyable and the food was tasty and creative, albeit overpriced. Considerable wealth is required to fully enjoy this restaurant without feeling guilty for visiting, so we aren't likely to attend again.

author: Kia Kalantari
review_text: Cuca Restaurant in Bali is a fantastic dining spot with both indoor and outdoor seating that creates a relaxed yet elegant vibe. The service is outstanding, with attentive and friendly staff who make you feel welcome. The menu offers a wide variety of delicious foods and creative drinks, making it perfect for any occasion. Highly recommended!

author: Michael Härte
review_text:
We spent a fantastic evening at Cuca, where everything was perfect from start to finish. From the very first moment, we were welcomed warmly and guided professionally through the evening.
The dishes are more than just food; they are small works of art – creative, exclusive, and a true culinary delight. The concept is excellent: you choose about 3 to 4 dishes per person, which are served one after another. It was also a lovely touch that each course came with a brief explanation of the special ingredients and the preparation. You can feel the team’s passion in every detail.
The drink selection leaves nothing to be desired either. They offer excellent Balinese wines and an impressive range of unique cocktails. A big plus: all cocktails are also available as non-alcoholic mocktails without losing any of their sophistication.
The service was flawless: attentive, professional, and very warm. The atmosphere, especially the stunningly beautiful garden, perfectly rounded off the experience and created a very special vibe.
While the price level is a bit higher than the usual average in Bali, it is absolutely worth every cent for the excellent quality and the unique overall experience. It couldn’t be any better – highly recommended for any gourmet visiting Bali!

author: Kevin Stevano
review_text:
Amazing service and experience at Cafe Gigi Susu! The service truly deserves 5 stars, especially thanks to Valen, who served our drinks and food. Everything was delicious, well-presented, and exceeded our expectations.

He was very informative, friendly, and attentive. He explained the menu clearly, gave great recommendations, and made us feel very welcome throughout our visit. His warm attitude really enhanced the overall experience.

Highly recommended cafe with outstanding service. Definitely coming back again!

author: Stefanny Sengkey
review_text:
A lovely brunch spot with great vibes and a beautiful space 🤍
The place was quite busy, but the atmosphere was still cozy and enjoyable. The interior is really nice and makes it a great spot to relax.

We had the almond croissant and the plain croissant—both were flaky, buttery, and tasted fresh. The almond croissant had a rich filling without being too sweet, it was perfectly crisp outside and soft inside.

For drinks, we tried the iced oat palm sugar coffee and the cold brew. Both were smooth and refreshing, with well-balanced flavors.

Overall, a great place for brunch with good food, good coffee, and a pleasant vibe. Would definitely come back!

author: Zella Keiko Bawr
review_text:
I really wanted to love this place, especially since my first visit (before it became an an 'Insta hit') was much better. Unfortunately, my second and most recent visit was quite disappointing.

I understand why it’s famous online, but I care most about the food quality, and unfortunately, it seems to have declined. I must say, however, that the staff were consistently friendly and nice throughout our visit.

We spent over 500K IDR on breakfast, which I don't mind if the food is excellent, but paying that much for a poor meal was frustrating:

Avo on Toast with Extra Salmon: The sourdough was incredibly hard and burnt in places. The avocado was plain and had a bitter taste. I couldn't finish the meal.

Brisket Bagel: The beef brisket was tough as hell, and the bagel itself was also very chewy. The dominant flavour was just overpowering mustard.
Green Smoothie: Had a very weird taste and we couldn't finish it.

The Almond Croissant was better than the rest, but even that wasn't as creamy and delicious as the one I had on my first visit when the cafe was quieter.

It feels like the focus is now on the aesthetics/hype rather than consistent food quality. I would hesitate to recommend it now, which is a shame.

author: Jennifer
review_text:
I visited this place with a friend on a Friday morning around 10am for breakfast. We didn't have a reservation and were told there would be at least a 20-minute wait, but could sit in the waiting area. That area is unfortunately right next to a construction site in the back, which wasn't very comfortable.

After about 10 minutes we were seated and asked if we were okay sharing a table with other guests. While I generally don't mind shared tables, we ended up at a large table shared by several different parties. Combined with how busy, loud, and crowded the space already was, it felt quite overwhelming and had a bit of an assembly-line atmosphere.

The café itself is nicely designed in a rustic, wooden style, but due to how packed it was, the overall vibe felt stressful rather than cozy. Conversation was difficult because of the noise level.

Service felt rather slow. The coffee was genuinely good, and the banana bread was fine, but nothing particularly memorable. I've had noticeably better breakfast and coffee in Canggu, Pererenan, and the surrounding area over the last years.

While I appreciate that the staff asked before seating us at a shared table, and it ultimately was our choice, the combination of crowding, noise, and hype took away from the experience. For me, this isn't a place I'd return to for a relaxed breakfast.

author: meffieyv
review_text:
I recently visited Gigi Susu Bali and had an absolutely wonderful experience! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and the service was top-notch.
A huge shout-out to the crew member, kak Eric, who was incredibly helpful throughout my visit. He was attentive, always ready to assist, and really made the experience stand out. Thank you, kak Eric! 🙏
I ordered the Big Breakfast and the Frittata, both of which were delicious and perfectly prepared. For drinks, the Iced Palm Sugar Latte was wonderfully balanced, and the Nelayan Energy (a fresh mix of carrot, pineapple, and orange) was soooo refreshing.
Everything tasted amazing. This place is a must-visit for anyone looking for delicious food, great ambiance, and outstanding service. Highly, highly recommend!

author: suanne
review_text: love the food here.. first time visit and it amazes me in many ways.. the food here is savory and sweet, many cute spots to take pictures and the coffee here taste super warm. the atmosphere around here is chill and windy.. great spot to chill and relax! will definitely come back again and try other food 🤤🤤

author: Tiara
review_text:
✨ As bomb as the hype says – Gigi Susu absolutely delivers! ✨
Everything was just so good – the food was delicious and perfectly balanced, and the drinks? Not overly sweet (yay!) with such a fun variety to choose from. The vibes were spot on, and I have to say… their hospitality was top notch. Truly appreciated and respected that! 💛 Already thinking about my next visit. Highly recommend!

author: Adinda Ellena
review_text:
Always coming back whenever I’m craving pastries because this café is truly the place to go. The almond croissant is perfectly sized for the price and tastes amazing, and their coffee is also really good.

All the staff are helpful and friendly, even their HR Manager (if I’m not mistaken) kindly helped pass my order to the team.

author: Dzaki Adzkiya
review_text:
Tried the Oat Caramel Latte at GigiSusu and it was really good. The oat milk was creamy and well-balanced with the caramel—sweet but not overpowering. The coffee was smooth, not bitter, with a pleasant aftertaste.

The atmosphere is cozy and aesthetic, perfect for relaxing or hanging out. Service was friendly and quick. Overall, GigiSusu is definitely a recommended spot for oat milk coffee lovers. ☕✨

author: Cherry
review_text: The café used to be amazing, but the quality has dropped recently. Croissants and bakes are still decent, and the vanilla almond latte is good, but it’s not quite the same. The second floor is a nice escape from the crowd, though the broken toilet and floating stairs make it less convenient and unsafe for kids.

author: Mauro Martin
review_text: Gigi Susu is such a lovely spot, great vibe, friendly staff, and a wide range of baked goods that look ang taste amazing! The pastries are flaky and flavorful, and you can’t go wrong with any of their coffee selections. The place has a cozy, earthy design that feels warm and inviting, perfect for a morning coffee stop or a relaxed brunch. Everything feels thoughtfully done, from the rustic presentation to the service. Definitely one of my favorite bakeries in Bali!

author: Lusiana Gomulia
review_text:
Gigi Susu located at:
Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong No. 80, Canggu,
Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali.
opening hours:

Gigi Susu Canggu famous for it’s big size croissant, taste very good.
Coffee is also very good, we ordered oat latte.

The restaurant is very unique, made from wood

perfect place for breakfast and brunch lain.

The staff are all very friendy.

author: Ajeng AP
review_text: I ordered the plain butter croissant and the berry smoothie, both were excellent! I  loved the croissant, especially. It was incredibly buttery and flavorful, with a soft inside and a perfectly crisp outside. Highly recommended!

author: Miya FM
review_text:
I’d been meaning to come here for months, and I’m glad I finally made it on Monday. The waiting list was only five people, so it went by quickly.

The service was excellent—the staff were very friendly and informative. I loved all the food, and I was shocked at how big the chicken was! The coffee was also impressive; the caramel with almond milk is my favorite. Definitely worth the hype.

author: Gede Cahya
review_text: This coffee shop has such a chill vibe, perfect for a cozy afternoon! ☕️ The coffee itself isn't too intense, which I actually kinda like. However, I have to admit, it felt a little pricey for what it was. Maybe it’s the atmosphere that comes with the cost! 🌳 Still, it's a nice spot.

author: Ni Luh Putri Honey Dewi
review_text:
I visit this place almost every week after my beach walk. Their coffee and food are awesome.
The service is also great, especially Kak Gung Mas, who took care of me during my visit today and provided excellent service.

author: Naii Nadia
review_text: Nice place to start our day.. I ordered Ice Americano & Tomato Foccacia Bread for breakfast.. The coffee was good!!! Houseblend Arabica roasted by themself.. and the bread is super yumm.. the atmosphere was pretty good, super comfort.. definitely will come back..

author: zul mausir
review_text: Gigi Susu is a charming little café with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The place feels quite cozy, with wooden interiors, natural light, and a relaxed setting that makes you want to stay longer. Despite being popular and often busy, the ambiance remains comfortable and not overwhelming.

author: Shella Yuridasari
review_text: Hype of the town. Came in the morning to get a Pain au Suisse and a cup of medium hot cappuccino.  The pastry tasted good, coffee was ok. Would like to try other menu. They serve various pastry, desserts main courses, coffee and non coffee drinks. They have spacious downstairs and upstairs seating area. Bike is the best transport if you want to visit.

author: Gerry Wijaya
review_text:
Been here again and again and again.
Remembering this bakery everytime I think of Canggu and Bali.

Their pastry is amazing.
A must try menu: Pain Au Suisse (Soft in the inside, Crunchy on the Outside)

Usually their very pack at 9AM. I’ll recommend to come earlier for the queue.
Loving it!✨

author: Kezia
review_text:
I've actually been to this cafe for years and i have to say, the quality of the food remained the same! Had the brunch menu with their smoked salmon egg bennys and their scrambled egg croissants with their fruit bowls and some cake and coffee. Loved every option, i would definitely recommend this restaurant to those who are keen for brunch style like cafes. However i would say that the food would be more appropriate for australian rates (150k+) but if you are willing to spend anyway, i'd say it's worth the price.

Good ambience for working, coffee is good and cakes are affordable too. All in all, i will continue to visit this place and recommend it to my friends!

author: Ahmad Dammak
review_text:
Everything was perfect. The food was really tasty and the balance of the flavors in the recipes was on another level. Drinks were also great with no exception. The pastries also are all perfect and we wanted to try as many as we can.

The service was on point and they were extremely friendly and helpful.

I always try new restaurant/coffees, but this one I tried its breakfast and the day after I tried its lunch and it did not disappoint.

I recommend anyone in seminyak to visit and try Linvingstone.

author: Chairil Junin Riza
review_text:
Such a beautiful café with amazing vibes ✨ The atmosphere is elegant yet cozy, making it perfect for catching up, working, or just enjoying some quiet time. The space is spacious and thoughtfully designed, so it never feels crowded.

Their bakery is next level — fresh, delicious, and beautifully made. Pair that with their specialty coffee blends, and it’s honestly a perfect combo. Every sip and bite feels well crafted.

Definitely a spot I’ll keep coming back to. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates good coffee, great pastries, and a lovely ambiance 🤍☕🥐

author: Azyan Azami
review_text:
I had such a lovely experience at Livingstone. The ambience immediately puts you in a good mood with its cosy, welcoming space and the kind of atmosphere that makes you want to sit a little longer.

I was totally in love with their coffee blends. We tried both the Petitenget and Canggu blend and each one had its own character. Smooth, aromatic and genuinely satisfying.

Food wise, we tasted quite a variety. The different nasi goreng options were all enjoyable. The salmon version had a nice balance of flavour, the chicken was comforting and familiar, and the oxtail nasi goreng was rich and deeply savoury. We also tried the fish and chips which came with a crisp coating and tender fish inside. The fluffy pancakes were a pleasant surprise, light and soft with just the right amount of sweetness.

I  would definitely return for the coffee alone, and the food just makes the whole visit even better.

author: Shankari
review_text:
Dropped by for brunch on a weekend and it was pretty packed. Highly recommended to make reservations beforehand.

Excellent variety of pastries, all of it looked so amazing! 🤤 Food-wise, good options of western and fusion meals as well as some local dishes. However, could only try the breakfast menu as it wasnt time for the lunch menu yet.

The brioche bun big breakfast was definitely unique, and portion was huge. Smoothie bowls were fresh and flavourful.

The croissant sandwich was light and flakey, filling was good as well. The breakfast bagel was nice but avocado mash was slightly under seasoned. Both of these came with a side salad.

Drinks tasted good as well. Overall definitely a pretty nice cafe to visit.

Parking is super duper hard so best to opt for a Grab to get here.

They also sell merch like notebooks, bottles, etc at the cafe so can check those out for a nice gift or such.

Wait staff were incredibly warm and polite, food was also served considerably fast.

author: Ruben
review_text: This place deserves a review. The drink (creamy tiramisu frape) was really delicious. The ultimate croissant sandwich with salad was made so well! The poached egg, prawns and other ingredients so refined! My boyfriend had the chicken pita. Also that meal was so tasty! The pita not too thick, the fries crunchy and not too greasy, the chicken tender. Best place! Compliments to the staff, keep up the good work!

author: Art
review_text: Comfy ambiance with delicious food, well presented. Jazzy music sometimes buy always kind and professional service. It can get a bit loud in the afternoon, but you have outside and inside seating options. The long Americano coffee is a tasty deal. Some of the tables are quite large, good for laptops, but a little high too.

author: Tia Carden
review_text:
The place is really nice and cute, good place to chill and read without being disturbed.
Maybe cuz I was sitting outside in a corner but I didn’t actually get served after being seated for 30 mins…
Loved the coffee, the eggs were great (bread a tad soggy but tbh that happens with avo toast) needed a bit more salt, the pain suisse was warmed which was so nice but could be more moist and flavourful. Overall cute just needs a lil bit more but definitely recommend for a coffee ☕️ 😌

author: TereTere
review_text:
I’d honestly recommend this place to anyone who’s in Bali or planning to come. Every single bite is worth the calories. I didn’t find this place through influencers or TikTok hype—just stumbled in as a customer and left completely satisfied. Definitely coming back.

*our fave is nasi goreng & coffee. May order more but for now my tummy needs some rest because we keep ordering more than we need.

author: Kampung Minion
review_text:
Came by for a late lunch on a weekend. Wasn't too packed. They have both indoors with AC and outdoors with some shade. the tables were abit cramped and they have 1 large table which can accommodate bigger groups.
Service was average. Lotsa staff around but difficult to get them to take our orders. Although they are nice and polite when you get them, however they seem busy chatting or just walking around, not attentive at all.
Food was good though. Enjoyed the pork belly aglio olio. Very nicely done and flavourful with fried onions and garlic.
Had a croissant as well but that was honestly average.
Will be back for the aglio olio.

author: yasmeen sayad
review_text:
Loveddd this place definitely a must visit when in Seminyak
The atmosphere is super relaxed and chilled with both indoor and outdoor seating in a spacious setup. We came here for breakfast and tried

The Bakers Scrambled Egg Croissant
Sausage Shakshuka
Hot Hazelnut Latte
Cappuccinos
Chicken & Shrimp Spring Rolls
Choco Almond Caramel Pistachio
Madeleine Original
Oxtail soup
Mixed rice (Nasi kampung)

Everything was amazing but the star for me was definitely the Bakers Egg Croissant perfectly done and so delicious. Their coffee and lattes were also top notch smooth and full of flavor. Everything felt fresh, and the croissants were easily some of the best Ive had.

Big kudos to the staff very humble, welcoming and the service was fast. It’s the kind of place you can sit for hours enjoying the vibe and food.
Will be coming back to try more dishes and spend more time here

author: Mohamed Uzain
review_text:
Really impressed. The food was delicious and the part I love the most is that the fact that everything is served so fast right after the order.

The environment is spacious and tidy and the staffs are VERY attentive. I had to revisit here just because how good it was.

Highly recommended for a meal here.

author: Dhiani Satiti
review_text:
If you’re looking for one of the best morning coffee experiences in Bali, Livingstone in Petitenget is a must-visit. This bright, stylish café and bakery serves an exceptional cup of coffee, and the specialty Canggu blend is a standout.
The vibe here is relaxed yet lively, perfect for a chill morning catch-up. Extra bonus for the amazing services from all the staff. Well done!

author: XSP
review_text: Randomly came across the cafe. It turned out to be such a great experience that we stayed for a long while. The ambience in the evening was cozy and relaxing. There was a live singer with a really great voice. We also liked the coffees and the ox bone soup.

author: Rene Dhariswari
review_text: Lovely place with a cozy atmosphere and delicious bakery items. Everything was fresh and well presented. Special thanks to the staff, especially Dekwi, who was very friendly and welcoming. Great service and a pleasant experience overall. Will definitely come back! 😍🫶🏼

author: Bu Rashid Harun
review_text:
Loved this place! We stopped for a coffee, smoothie, and muffin and were instantly impressed. The coffee is top-tier, the smoothie was refreshing, and the muffin was deliciously fresh.

The atmosphere is what really sells it a beautiful, plant filled space that's both stylish and relaxing. Seeing other plates come out, it's clear we need to come back for a proper breakfast next time.

author: fu ching
review_text: Thanks to Dekwi, I had an amazing experience at this Bali cafe! Really appreciated for your lovely service and help me to fill my bottle with iced water, such a life-saver. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, perfect for a relaxing meal. I ordered the all-day breakfast, and it exceeded my expectations — the food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure I had everything I needed. Excellent service combined with delicious food makes this cafe a must-visit. Highly recommend for a satisfying and enjoyable dining experience in Bali! -By Michelle

author: 이예인
review_text:
The staffs are very kind And the food is fantastic. Especially the homemade fluffy pancake is the best and you can have the salad together. The fresh fruit is very juicy.

Also, Airconditioner in Bali is very important for my parents and they were very satisfied with this place. The music is subtle. This place is the best café in Bali in our experience. Also this place is very clean and has no bugs :)

author: Sabrina Cheng
review_text: Absolutely loved this place! The atmosphere is so chill and the service was excellent. The food portions are huge and incredibly tasty. It's also super Instagrammable – a perfect spot to enjoy a great meal and have a long chat with friends. Highly recommended!

author: Arlene Reksoprawiro
review_text: First time coming here and everything is so wonderful. They have a parking lot for cars (very important), helpful and friendly staffs, options for indoor and outdoor area. We got caramel pistachio croissant and lava cake which is sooo delicious, and the coffee also very delightful. Definitely will be back.

author: Natasha Georgiou
review_text:
Excellent Vietnamese. The best spring rolls we’ve had on our trip. The food was fresh, authentic, tasty & cheap.
The service was super fast. We had an appointment to get to so we ordered and got served in 10 minutes!!
The only downside is that they don’t have air con. Only fans, which makes it hot inside.

author: Dee Parmar
review_text: Had an incredible experience at this Vietnamese restaurant! The food was absolutely amazing, rich, flavourful, and truly authentic. The menu offered a great variety of options, so there’s something for every craving. The ambience was warm and inviting, making it the perfect spot to unwind and enjoy a good meal. Plus, its prime location makes it super convenient to visit. Highly recommend if you’re looking for delicious Vietnamese cuisine!

author: Ratih Safirawati
review_text:
I visited Mevui Vietnam Kitchen at Legian today. The place has a good atmosphere. The food is full of Vietnamese flavors and really comforting dishes. I love to order Pho Saigon, Nem Nuong, Banhmi and Com Soun. It’s was delicious.
The staff are super friendly. Thank you to the staff tonight. Ayu, Santya, Melinda, Dwi, Komang, Pandu and Okta. The manager is also really kind and attentive. It’s the kind of service that makes you want to come back.
Overall, Mevui Vietnam Kitchen is a great spot for tasty Vietnamese food paired with genuinely good hospitality. Definitely worth to visit! 🤍

author: Natassja
review_text: tried the pho Saigon, banh mi, and egg custard coffee. While the pho was just okay (I was hoping for more flavor), the banh mi was excellent! It was fresh and hit all the right notes of sour, sweet, and spicy. The egg custard was also a highlight🍮

author: Anita Robin
review_text: We dined here on our trip to Bali last week, it turned out be one of the best meals we had! We tried the Pho, Bahn mi, the spring rolls, kefir and more...The food, the ambience and the whole experience was brilliant,  must try place in Kuta

author: Khanh Doan Ngoc Mai
review_text: As a Vietnamese I am proud to say this restaurant got the flavor and the presentation of the dishes 1000/100. Everything was so extraordinary that I wanted to come back. For all of you who are checking for what to eat: dare to explore anything new besides pho cause they are all amazing. Taste some wraps, rolls and the dessert as well☺️

author: yunchia
review_text: Discovered this Vietnamese restaurant in Bali through Xiaohongshu. They have multiple branches and the food is served quickly very convenient. The restaurant is open air with no AC, but it was comfortably cool in the evening. The pho is flavorful and delicious🥰 definitely a place I’d visit again!

author: Camilla Seeland
review_text: This place is amazing. Especially this location in kuta (it is a lot tastier than the other one in kuta). we ate here 4 times and will definitely return. Since it is so tasty it get busy so please be patient with the staff they are working hard and doing their best.

author: Dayu Tania Wardhani
review_text: Get ready for an unforgettable culinary adventure at Mevui! The Vietnamese food here is absolutely extraordinary! From the mind-blowingly delicious pho to the crispy, savory banh mi and mouthwatering grilled chicken, every bite is a burst of flavor. What’s even better? All Mevui locations maintain the same high standard of deliciousness! But the Legian store takes the prize with a more extensive menu, featuring scrumptious pork dishes and being the very first store in the chain! Plus, if you ride a bike, parking is a breeze! Overall, I can’t wait to come back here again and again for more amazing food! Oh one more thing! Their Ginger Pandan Tea will always be my favorite drink!

author: Małgorzata Pindych
review_text:
We absolutely love this place! Being deeply in love with Vietnam, we especially appreciate being able to come back here whenever we’re in Bali and Vietnam isn’t accessible. It’s like a little slice of our favorite country—right here on the island.

The service is always excellent. We’ve never had a single issue with the staff. They’re clearly well-trained, know exactly what they’re doing, and always make us feel welcomed and taken care of. The food comes out super quickly, and even the drinks are outstanding.

Special shoutout to the pandan iced tea—it completely blew my mind. One of the very few places where I can order it without sugar and it’s not treated like a weird request. And the food? Just amazing. We always leave feeling light, happy, and full—but not heavy. It’s magic.

And let’s talk about the prices: absolutely fantastic. Every time we visit, we walk out beyond satisfied. Can’t wait to come back again (and again).

author: Just Wall
review_text: Many times coming to this restaurant. Great vibe, great food, great service. The Saigon Pho is 10/10. The platter is just amazing! The drinks are also great. This place keeps me coming back!

author: Ervan Setyo Nugroho
review_text: The vietnam’s ambience is pretty nice. The food also good. But recommended to come at after noon, because I went at noon but not all the food is available due to awaiting the supplies

author: Wayne Anthony
review_text: Discovered this little 😍 gem 💎 of a place buy chatting to someone at the beach ⛱️ very impressed with the food and the service,  the price is also great for the amount of food you receive,  full of flavor and very pleasing to the eye ! Would highly recommend that you give a place a try as you will definitely appreciate that you did 👍 😊 so many bars 🍸 and restaurants to choose from and this one ticks all the boxes, and not like a lot some of the restaurants in bali that try and use the locals to intimidate you to come in 🤕they have built up a good reputation from the word on the street 📦 😍 .

author: Jia-Fu Yu (Rex)
review_text: It’s great for your first time to try the Pho in here, but if you did have experience with “PHO”. They are just ok. It just pretty normal, non gonna surprise you.

author: Yuwono Alim
review_text: Went there once and came back again the next day. No doubt the food were deliciousss, but service. Next time when ordering pho, the red pinkish colour beef slices is a sign not to be missed.

author: Ghazal Lotfi
review_text: Good Vietnamese food in Bali. Unfortunately, there’s no air conditioning, which made the dining experience quite uncomfortable.

author: D P
review_text: The food was perfect. Every little details was spot on authentic Vietnamese flavour. Will come back!

author: Cassandra Furst
review_text: My favourite Vietnamese restaurant hands down! I always come to this place when I’m in Bali and am never disappointed. The chicken spring rolls slap. Highly rec their ice/smoothie drinks — elite.

author: mojojoedwards
review_text: A good break from Indonesian food. Taste like proper Vietnamese food - although the pho could do with a little less MSG flavour. Restaurant is packed with East/SouthEast Asians which is testament to how good/authentic the food is.

author: minios no
review_text:
Tasty Vietnamese food!
Pho Sai Gon, Pho Hoi An, Cha Gio, Mango Kefir & Bee Perfect —> all good!

author: Business Assistant
review_text:
We were very satisfied by the service and food! We tried pizza (Saturday promo - take 2, pay for 1) — Vegetarian Green and Pumpkin pizzas was amazing! 🤩 Also we tried Masala tea and cappuccino decaf, as well as pancakes 🥞.
Everything was sooo tasty. But I think that 77k for Large cappuccino decaf with oat milk is too much 😊
Anyway, we want to come back! 😃

author: Ben Attack
review_text:
Exceptional service from all the staff. Especially from Novi!
Really enjoyed the live music with breakfast on a Sunday morning.
Burrito was delicious, especially with the sauces.
Madu breakfast was very tasty, the only comment about that would be to chop the coriander a bit smaller.
Unfortunately the coffee here isn’t very good, taste too much like dirty water.

author: Rosie Bakes
review_text:
Absolutely fantastic experience!
From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles and genuine friendliness that made us feel so welcome. Novi was an absolute delight! attentive, kind, and truly made our night special with her wonderful service.
The food was delicious, with the pizzas being a standout and the Anzac apple pie an absolute treat. My freakshake was epic – so big I couldn’t finish it, but every sip made me happy!
The atmosphere, the food, and the service all came together perfectly. We all had such a wonderful night and can’t wait to come back! 🌴🌸

author: Farra Natalea
review_text:
had breakfast at Milk & Madu Beach Road and absolutely loved it! I ordered their Super Brekky Bowl — a beautiful mix of tropical fruits, quinoa granola, yoghurt, goji, chia, cacao, bee pollen, flaxseed, nuts, coconut, and honey — and it was so yummy and refreshing! Super healthy yet really satisfying.

I also had a flat white, and the coffee was excellent — smooth and well-balanced. The service was fast and friendly, and the staff were attentive even though the café was busy.
Overall, it’s a great spot for a healthy breakfast or brunch with good vibes and quality coffee. Definitely a must-visit when you’re in Canggu!

author: Evi !!!
review_text:
Amazing place for brunch and coffee!
The food is excellent, the coffee is high quality, and the atmosphere is beautiful and very welcoming.
Everything is spotlessly clean, and you can really tell that attention is paid to every detail.
A place that adds something special to your day.
I highly recommend it!

author: Luke Marden
review_text: Absolutely amazing breakfast and coffee! Everything was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The coffee was rich, smooth, and clearly made with care — easily one of the best cups I’ve had in a long time. The breakfast was just as impressive — generous portions, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back — highly recommend!

author: Michael Eng
review_text: stopped by Milk & Madu and was really impressed with the quality of the food. The carbonara was creamy and rich with just the right balance of flavor — perfectly seasoned, with a silky sauce that coated the pasta beautifully. The lasagna was a standout too, with generous layers of sauce, cheese, and tender pasta that all came together for a comforting, homemade taste. Both dishes were served hot and fresh, and you can really tell they care about quality and ingredients here. Combined with the cozy atmosphere and friendly service, it made for a great dining experience. Highly recommended if you’re craving hearty, well-made Italian dishes in Bali.

author: Joceline Setiawan
review_text: This is my second visit to Milk & Madu, and it’s still one of my favorite cafes in Bali! The food is consistently delicious (fresh ingredients and beautifully presented☺️) The coffee never disappoints, and the staff are always friendly and attentive. The cozy atmosphere makes it the perfect place to relax, whether for breakfast, brunch, or just a coffee break

author: Alyssa Jane
review_text: We got the coconut cold brew, latte, poke bowl and ceasar salad. Everything was wonderful. Some live music playing and a variety of sweet treats available! Will be back while we are here for their happy hour from 4-7 (BOGO). Movi was our server- she was attentive and very kind!

author: Gregor Malcolm
review_text:
Me and my girlfriend visited here last year many times last year, we have now returned for the second year of our trip and we have been here many times again. This time we chose to both have the pancakes as we can remember how tasty they were last year (they still taste fantastic!) they’re location is generously sized which accommodates lots of seating options which can host from a couple up to 9 people +. We would definitely come back here again for breakfast and would recommend it to anyone looking for a scrumptious breakfast !

5 ⭐️

author: Cherry
review_text: I always come back here, love their shakes, especially the Monkey Magic, which is sublime. The breakfast menu is fairly typical, but everything is executed really well. Cozy, friendly spot that never disappoints.

author: Ali ÇİÇEK
review_text: We stopped by Milk & Madu for a light snack and really loved it! The fruit bowl was fresh, colorful, and full of tropical flavors like dragon fruit, mango, and berries. It was the perfect healthy and refreshing mid-day treat. The atmosphere was cozy and lively, with great live music in English playing in the background. A wonderful spot to relax, enjoy good vibes, and have something delicious and natural in Bali!

author: Grace Chizawsky
review_text:
The best açaí bowl I’ve ever had!

Everything about this bowl was perfection. The açaí base was thick, smooth, and packed with flavour — not watery like some places. The fruit was unbelievably fresh, the granola perfectly crunchy, and the toppings beautifully arranged (just look at that presentation 😍). Every bite tasted like pure tropical bliss!

Service was also amazing — super friendly staff who made sure everything came out quickly and with a smile. This bowl was honestly to die for!

author: D G
review_text: Average spot at best. The skillet was flavorless. They have a kids area but almost no options for kids breakfasts. Bathrooms were very dirty. All around not impressed. I came here years ago and it was a much better experience.

author: Luca Tonino
review_text: this is an absolutely amazing restaurant and all the dishes that i tried are simply outstanding. the mocktails are delicious and the coffee is excellent. i’m going here and to the other branch a lot and it’s perfect for any time of the day. really nice job of the owner, service is great as well.

author: Adri T
review_text:
Great spot for breakfast or brunch! The option to build your own eggs is awesome to cater to your own liking—at reasonable prices, at that. The long black coffee was strong and hit the spot. I would only skip the pancakes—they look better than they taste—we found it quite dry, a bit dense, and lacking in flavor. The “crispy bacon” add-on isn’t crispy at all, either. Just a heads up for those who actually prefer them crispy/crunchy to bite.

We arrived around 11,30am for brunch and the place was quite packed. We waited but not too long. The tables are arranged close to one another, FYI—if you’re particular about privacy. Still, would come back here next time to try other menu offerings.

author: Laura B
review_text: We went 2 nights in a row because the pumpkin pizza was phenomenal!!   Absolutely loved it!  Fantastic service too.  There is a small slide for the kids and they bring pencils and paper for them to use at the table too.  There was live music one night, but it wasn’t too loud and we could still easily talk.  So lovely.

author: Janie Martin
review_text:
Very friendly staff. Service was great!
Food wise, it was okay only. I would rate it a 7/10. We enjoyed the salad and wrap. Pizza was so-so. They have kids meals that comes with fruits and cookies.
They have a kids play area too.

author: Natasha's pov
review_text:
Warm and friendly service, and the food came out really fast.

The menu has a wide variety of options and plenty to choose from.
Tried The Madu and the Cubano sandwich, both were super tasty and satisfying.
Portions are generous for the price, definitely worth it!

The space is big, with both indoor and outdoor seating.
There’s also a playground for kids, which makes it very family-friendly.
Lots of parking for scooters, and valet service for cars.

Great spot for brunch, chill time, or family outings!

author: Brightone Nik
review_text: Great location near beach. Wifi access, mixed toilet. Venue is comfortable, kids friendly and refreshing. Pizza was delicious, thin and crispy straight out of oven, fast service. Great for date and families. Music in late  afternoon Would go there again for that rustic pizza.

author: Risk
review_text:
Went for dinner and everything was great,  the food was fresh and delicious. We ordered the poke bowl, cheeseburger 🍔, and sticky date pudding. We were starving, so no photos… except for the dessert duhh 😄

Dicky was super helpful and friendly, and the whole team was warm and welcoming 🫶 As always, we love Milk & Madu, and having this new branch just a short walk away (no more trips to Canggu!) makes it even better.

author: Marlyn Fransiska
review_text:
We had brunch here and Milk & Madu remains one of our favorite spots to hop to. This Seminyak branch is fairly new (opened around 20 Nov 2025, if I’m not mistaken), and the vibe here feels more neutral and airy with lots of direct sunlight. Fully air-conditioned, so no worries about Bali’s heat, and the toilets were clean with a fresh lemongrass scent—always appreciated.

Food quality is consistent, just like their other branches. We had the cinnamon bun French toast (great portion), classic pepperoni pizza (large & gluten-free), and fresh young coconut. Love that they offer gluten-free pizza options—such a win.

They also have a kids’ corner that’s quite decent, plus free face painting, which our kids absolutely loved.

Service overall was good. Just one small moment that made us smile—we asked to sit at the sofa area. The sofa tables are designed for two, so for a group of four they need to be combined. We were initially told it was only for two, but shortly after, a family of three was seated there with the tables combined 😅 Not a big deal at all, and the team kindly offered us a bigger table right away.

All in all, a solid brunch spot with great food, family-friendly touches, and a comfortable setting.

author: suveena nair
review_text: We had breakfast here and it was amazing! Reasonable pricing and great service from our waiter Merta. The atmosphere was lovely, with great live music playing (not too loud, you can still talk). I wish I could visit over and over again.

author: Tracy Betts
review_text:
Fritters are my go-to order whenever I have brunch, and these were the best fritters I’ve ever had. Mind blown!
Yumang, our server, was lovely.
The aesthetic of the place is beautiful and it’s spacious.
The price for breakfast which includes a juice and coffee, was great value!! I highly recommend coming here 💜💜💜

author: Matt Dellamalva
review_text:
Absolutely loved our visit to Milk & Madu Seminyak! The food was outstanding across the board — my wife had the chicken pesto melt, our kid enjoyed the pancakes, and I had the breakfast muffin, and every single dish was fantastic. Fresh, flavorful, and beautifully done.

A special shout-out to our waiter Dicky, who did a great job looking after us. Friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better.

Highly recommend this place for a great family breakfast or brunch in Seminyak. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Elizabeth Jung
review_text: The food was fresh, natural no artificial flavor, and delicately prepared. Dicky was so friendly and helped us choosing the perfect dishes for the brunch - breakfast set is very good deal! We had omelet and french toast. Thank you Dicky for making our morning wonderful.

author: Sara Al Zarooni
review_text: I’m here visiting from Dubai, I must say this has been one of the best food places I’ve ever tried. Came here for dinner yesterday and breakfast today! Servers are super friendly and welcoming as well

author: Bianca
review_text:
Good food at Milk & Madu Seminyak.
Great service from waiters named Dicky. He explains the menu and promo to us while other waiters didn’t explain as well as he did. He told us theres brekkie set and shows whats the best menu  patiently. Hes also fast response and helps us a lot. Thanks Dicky!

author: Kevin Stevano
review_text: Had a great experience at Milk & Madu Seminyak. The food was delicious with good portion sizes and consistent quality. The atmosphere is cozy and relaxed, perfect for breakfast, brunch, or hanging out with friends and family. The service was friendly, attentive, and efficient. Overall, a highly recommended place in Seminyak!

author: Giovanni
review_text: The food is standard, nothing to complain, nothing wow. The dishes are all well prepared and the ingredients quality is good, but the overall experience will not remain impressed in your remembering. The location is new and is huge, I would try it for work also. Busy at everytime, the staff is still training but the managers are overlooking everything, so give them a bit of time. I didn't find a place soul.

author: Gavin Borges
review_text:
Had a lovely experience visiting milk and madu for the first time
The place totally lives upto it’s name
Absolutely lip smacking food

We tried the sweet chilli garlic bread with an almond milk matcha and a pinácolada followed by a chicken Parma which was cooked to absolute perfection

A visit to this place couldn’t be complete without trying their raspberry and coconut chia bowl which was so beautifully presented

Ended the meal with a berry kombucha
A special mention to the lovely server Mr Merta who was kind enough to give us insights about some local food as well as the order we placed
A must visit place when you are around Seminyak
Cheers

author: Maria Yastika
review_text: Really good restaurant with super friendly, fast service, and a very comfortable atmosphere. I came around 1 PM, and thanks to the AC, the place was still cool and pleasant to dine in. The food and smoothies were top-notch—really yummy. On top of that, the place is so pretty. Definitely worth visiting!

author: Ella Amoroso
review_text: We loved Milk and Madu at the new branch in Seminyak! All the staff, particularly Windi and Vera were so attentive, smiley and kind to us. We loved our breakfast on day 1 so much that we came back 3 times! The food was all so fresh and came out quickly. The aperol and elderflower spritz were also perfect! Breakfast was particularly brilliant with the live musicians, which created a wonderful atmosphere. I would come back here everyday if i could!

author: Irwin Harith
review_text: Gorgeous cafe with yummy food. Had a great experience during brunch yesterday. Been to the branch in Canggu but this is definitely more spacious and new. Our waiter, Dicky was super friendly and sweet too!

author: Sindhuja Poorni
review_text:
Had sweet cravings and visited Milk and Madu for breakfast.

Pancakes awesome. French toast is a bit overwhelming and too sweet to handle. The milkshake and cappuccino were great.

Great place for breakfast.

author: Neneng Lestari
review_text: This place is really gwooddd! The food tastes amazing and everything is nicely prepared. The ambience is cozy and super comfortable—perfect for hanging out or having a relaxed meal. The staff are friendly and helpful, which makes the whole experience even better. Definitely a spot I’d recommend if you’re looking for good food and a good vibe👌🏼👌🏼

author: Alicia MH
review_text:
Milk and Madu Seminyak is a very good breakfast spot. My partner had the croissant croque monsieur and I had the eggs benedict. The food was delicious, we were served very quickly.
Dita served us , she is sweet and very attentive.
Highly recommend this place!

author: Александра Качало
review_text:
The place is really nice — cozy & comfortable, stylish.
I ordered chicken, it was good, the portion is served with french fries and veg salad and it's really huge. The only one thing was a bitter taste of tomato sauce.
I also liked the hospitality of the staff, especially our waiter Yumang. She was really friendly and helpful.

author: Xin Lin Ng
review_text:
I had the best burrito ever here! Each element of the burrito was well thought and intentionally prepared. Flavours were balanced, and portions were just right.
They were slightly short staffed, but they kept us regularly updated on the progress of the food without us asking.
The cafe also had great vibes. High ceilings, cool, no insects. It was crowded but it felt like there was a lot of space, which made this a very comfortable experience.

author: mimi
review_text: Loved this place! The food was fantastic, and the service was top-notch. Our server (DICKY)  was awesome—friendly, quick, and very helpful. Can’t wait to come back!q

author: Juliette
review_text:
Amazing experience at Milk & Madu in Bali!
From the moment we arrived, the service was absolutely top-notch: the team is incredibly reactive, attentive, and genuinely kind. You immediately feel welcomed.

The atmosphere is super warm and cozy it’s the kind of place where you can actually have a conversation without having to shout, which is rare and so appreciated. The crowd is great, the vibe is relaxed yet lively, and honestly, everything just feels right.

Now, the food… wow. Every single dish was delicious. My plate was simply incredible: perfectly creamy, with a flawlessly poached egg and amazing flavors pure comfort food done to perfection. The food bowls are outstanding, the fritters are delicious, the carrot cake is rich and moist, the banoffee pie is to die for, and the homemade juices are fresh and perfectly balanced.

Milk & Madu truly excels at everything: exceptional food, a beautiful atmosphere, and outstanding service. A must-visit spot in Bali i can’t recommend it enough!

author: Darsshan Parmar
review_text:
