Milk & Madu is a lovely café and a great place to relax in Ubud.

Location: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)
Very convenient and easy to reach, making it a perfect stop while exploring Ubud.

Taste: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)
The food is fresh and well-prepared with good flavors. Plenty of options to choose from.

Ambiance: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)
Comfortable, lively, and welcoming. A nice balance between relaxed café vibes and a social atmosphere.

Service: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)
Friendly staff and fairly quick service.

Additional highlights:
• Parking available
• Free Wi-Fi
• Cash and cards accepted
• Vegan & vegetarian options available
• Live music performances, which add to the overall experience

Overall, a great café in Ubud for good food, good vibes, and a pleasant time 🎶☕

author: Ali Raza
review_text:
Firstly, the service was incredible.
The staff was super attentive and helpful in explaining allergens etc.
The staff also dealt another table of entitled customers very professionally so kudos to them.

The food tasted great. There were alot of raving reviews about this spot and it didn't disappoint one bit.

A special shout out to their carrot cake. scrumptious!!!

author: puspita sari
review_text: Had a great lunch here! tried the double smash burger, juicy and flavorful. The apple crumble was a nice surprise, and the pineapple juice tasted super fresh. Cozy place with a relaxed Ubud vibe. Would definitely come back.

author: Maryam
review_text:
I come to Bali twice a year, and every time I make sure to visit this restaurant. The quality of the food, drinks, and service is truly top-notch.

At this point, the standard they maintain is so high that whenever I dine anywhere else ,even at 5-star hotel restaurants  it rarely compares. The flavors, presentation, and overall experience here are just on another level. They are remarkably consistent, which is rare and so appreciated.

The photos I’m sharing are from the Ubud location I visited on this trip, but I can confidently say the Canggu location is just as amazing. Highly recommended if you want an exceptional dining experience.

author: dominique ordinario
review_text: TASTY & BEAUTIFUL! Milk & Madu blew me away with their kind and attentive service, delicious lattes and wonderful food. i ended up going back the next day and the food was consistently remarkable. my server Rita had such a kind soul that enjoying the space felt like home. thank you to the whole staff.

author: Anna Vlasova
review_text: I came here on a Sunday to try their special brunch, and it was such a great way to start the day! I had the cheeseburger with a beer — absolutely delicious and satisfying. Then I couldn’t resist trying the dessert: an apple crumble pie with ice cream. It was simply amazing! I left with such positive vibes and a big smile. The atmosphere here is wonderful- friendly people, great music, and an overall lovely energy. Definitely a place I’d love to come back to:)

author: Merve
review_text: Nice atmosphere in the morning and in the evening because inside gets too hot at noon (due to big glass windows). You can enjoy great cocktails (you pay one get two during the happy hour). I ordered grilled fish and salad -the portion was a bit small- but it was really delicious. Prices are a bit above average. Service was very fast.

author: Farena Virginia Lawalata
review_text: Everything about this place hits the spot. From the face-sized, juicy burger that’s seriously tempting, to the ice-cold Kura Kura Lager that’s perfect under the Ubud midday heat. And don’t even get me started on the dessert—hands down one of the best dessert combinations I’ve ever had. Amazing food, great portions, and effortless Ubud daytime vibes. Definitely a place I’d come back to.

author: Charu Goyal
review_text:
One of my favourite cafes to eat at in Bali. I have been to their Ubud location 4-5 times in the past few years. Every visit has been great and I have no complaints.

Highly recommend trying their house fries, fresh juices, avocado toasts and pizzas.

author: ns ps
review_text: Food and service was so good, we kept coming to this restaurant for 5 straight days! Big portions and fresh ingredients. Must try: their fish burger and Mexicana salad.

author: alzulaikha humaid
review_text:
We had dinner here, and the staff were extremely kind, friendly, and quick to respond. The food was delicious, and we found it hard to decide what to order because of the wide variety of options.

We eventually chose the peri peri chicken with mashed potatoes, truffle mushroom cacio e pepe, and French fries. All the dishes were absolutely tasty, but for me, the pizza was the standout.

This is definitely the kind of restaurant I’d love to return to and explore more dishes from their menu.

author: Sudarshan Lodha
review_text:
Absolutely loved our lunch at Milk and Madhu! The service was top-notch – we’re super picky vegetarians (no egg, no fish oil) and Captain Puspa and Novi were amazing, guiding us through the menu without batting an eye. She suggested the Summer Slice Pizza and OH MY GOD – best pizza EVER. I seriously still can’t get over how good it was.

Big shoutout to the team for making a Milo Shake for us, even though it’s supposed to be just for kids. That was such a nice touch!

We had an awesome lunch and can’t wait to come back soon. Highly recommend this place!

author: İpek Delikkulak
review_text: We came here based on reviews and had breakfast and dinner. Everything was great. They had breakfast promotions, and it was incredibly crowded. A line formed after we sat down, but it wasn't as crowded that evening, so we enjoyed our meal comfortably. Since we don't eat pork, they offered to swap our menu items for other items, which was very nice. We enjoyed the lasagna for dinner. The ice cream is safe, and the food is delicious. We recommend it.

author: Ivey
review_text: Stopped for lunch and really enjoyed it. The double smash burger was well cooked and tasty, the apple crumble was unique and comforting, and the pineapple juice was very fresh. Nice atmosphere and friendly service. A good spot to chill in Ubud.

author: Venkadesh A C S
review_text:
I’ve been to Milk & Madu over 20 times now, and it never disappoints! The food is consistently fantastic, with a menu that’s both creative and full of fresh, delicious options. My personal favorites are the French toast (hands down the best I’ve ever had), the burrata, and the sandwiches – all incredibly tasty and satisfying. The smoothies are a must-try too, always refreshing and perfectly blended.
The atmosphere is so laid-back and welcoming, making it the perfect spot to relax, catch up with friends, or enjoy a solo meal. The staff is always friendly and attentive, which makes every visit feel like home.
If you're in Ubud, don’t miss out on this gem! I always look forward to my next meal here – it’s the kind of place you’ll find yourself coming back to again and again.

author: Natasha Weleilakeba
review_text: So glad I came to finally try their double smash burger! It was everything & more of what I was hoping for- a 10/10 fabulous meal! The restaurant is lovely-beautiful set up & even better staff! Totally coming to try their breakfast & dinner menus as I’m sure it’s just as fabulous 😍👏🏾

author: Tita CNesa
review_text:
I finally revisited Milk & Madu Ubud, and their burger was absolutely amazing.
A juicy patty, a perfectly toasted bun, and rich, delicious flavors that hit all the right notes. Paired with an ice-cold Kura Kura Beer, it was the perfect combo for a laid-back afternoon in Ubud.
The atmosphere is warm, lively, and carries that cozy Ubud charm that makes you want to stay a little longer.

author: Luna Vilasco
review_text: We were made to feel very welcome, the staff are very friendly and cheerful. The food is excellent and the setting is relaxing. I highly recommend it.

author: Kanika Khatri Daing
review_text:
Had an amazing time here .. the staff was so so nice and welcoming.. Had some great breakfast.. Avo toast was a HIT !!
The coffee was good .. Will visit this next time for sure .. And recommend it to everyone who ever is travelling to Ubud .. 👌🏼

author: Hans Bae
review_text:
A double espresso at Pison, a fusion restaurant and café in the heart of Ubud, was the perfect pick-me-up after a long day of traveling.

The cool air-conditioning, spacious high-ceiling interior, and beautiful rice field views make it a very comfortable place to relax. The atmosphere is lively, with travelers happily enjoying great food and drinks.

The staff are friendly, attentive, and truly welcoming. They even try their best to accommodate special requests, sometimes preparing items not listed on the menu.

Excellent service and a wonderful experience overall.

author: Diana R
review_text:
The food is really good. The pork eschalot pasta is so yummy I wanted to order two portions. Truffle steak, thai kalian pork belly and spaghetti bolognese were also solid choices. Skin elixir juice was also sweetly refreshing.

But the food took very long to come. I came at 12:40pm on Saturday, there was a queue and I was seated at 1pm, I ordered 1:03pm and only got the food at 1:34pm :( 30mins was too long but luckily the food was worth the wait.

author: Arindi Arisani
review_text:
I went here for dinner to try their Indonesian dishes and left quite impressed. The oxtail soup from the main menu was rich, aromatic, and deeply comforting, with meat so tender it easily fell off the bone. The broth had a beautiful balance of warmth and spice, complemented by the chili and sweet soy sauce served on the side. The dish came with rice and emping (melinjo chips), which rounded out the flavours perfectly.

The second dish, featured on a seasonal menu, was grilled octopus with finely chopped snake beans stir-fried in Balinese spices. The octopus was juicy and smoky with a distinct char that added depth, though I personally wished for a touch more salt. Since rice wasn’t included, I ordered it separately to complete the meal. The combination of the tender octopus and the crunchy, aromatic snake beans made this dish memorable and full of texture.

As for drinks, the watermelon juice (despite with no additional sugar added) was refreshingly sweet with a slushy consistency, ideal for Ubud’s tropical weather. I also appreciated the staff’s clarity when explaining that “Draft Beer” referred to a local brand rather than a traditional keg pour. Hence, a classic Bintang was ordered instead. Overall, the experience was satisfying, with attentive service and well-balanced local flavours worth revisiting.

author: Bella Yang
review_text: Food was absolutely delicious! My husband and I enjoyed three meals at Pison yesterday 🤣 — breakfast and lunch at the restaurant, and dinner via delivery. Even the delivery packaging was high quality. Truly an amazing restaurant. Love, love, love, love Pison!

author: Cassandra Sun
review_text:
The staff there were very accommodating to give my friends a surprise for their birthday! Great service and the carrot cake was very good.
Oxtail fried rice was chef’s kiss. The chicken cordon bleau was a highlight too.

author: Shankari
review_text:
Super nice restaurant to grab a meal at with 10/10 vibes! Has both al fresco and indoor dining options.

Many varieties of food options, western and Asian dishes with fusion options as well 👌 Pasta was perfectly cooked with a good amount of sauce.

The fish curry was good as well but felt like it was missing a bit of a base flavour, but paired well with the rice.

Chicken cordon bleu was nice but super filling, good portion size. Duck fried rice was nicely cooked with tender meat and the accompanying sambal had varying levels of spiciness.

Mushroom soup was nice and creamy.

The avocado latte was nice and creamy, definitely quite filling. The strawberry and lychee coolers were super refreshing, perfect for the heat of Ubud. Latte was good as well.

Parking options are limited. Waiting time was around 20mins to get seated but you can buy a coffee slushie to sip on while waiting, but it is SUPER sweet.

author: Diamond Path
review_text: There’s usually a big queue and I only got to eat here once. We were able to choose a nice table — arrived at 9 am and there was barely anyone there, so maybe this is a good time to drop by. I had the rye bread with salmon and eggs and my mom had the pancakes. Both tasted amazing 🤩 the lemon cake was absolutely stellar spot on —-  pound cake with cream cheese nice and tart with a bit of meringue on top. Yummy 🤤 I can totally understand why this place is always packed! BTW when they served our pancakes these did not come with syrup but you can ask for some if you want it.

author: 林大原
review_text: The food was delicious, with well-balanced portions and reasonable prices. The restaurant itself is beautifully designed, creating a lovely dining atmosphere. Our server, Leony(the girl in selfie), mentioned she had just returned from a trip to Taiwan,she was incredibly friendly and adorable. Her service was outstanding, and we truly enjoyed our experience. We highly recommend this restaurant!

author: Trần Thanh Thảo Nhi
review_text:
I really love this restaurant 🤤

It has two sections, one outdoor dining area and one indoor café with a tiny library for book lovers.

The menu is quite diverse with a lot of Western-style dishes. Everything tasted fresh, from the veggies to the soft-boiled eggs. The mushroom pieces were a bit big though, I’d prefer them thinner. The sauce was unbelievably good and the view of the mini rice field made everything feel calm and relaxing.

Drinks were tasty but a little too sweet for me.

Staff were super cute and friendly, definitely worth coming back!

author: Michelle Arlene
review_text:
vibey and cozy place, came around 10.30ish so we got a place to sit (if u come later, it’ll be full asap). food came out decently quick, and pretty filling for portion wise.

food ordered (stars out of 3) :

• salmon quiche (⭐️⭐️⭐️) — picky eater cous approved
• egg’s benedict (⭐️⭐️.5) — like usual benny but its p guds
• big breakfast (⭐️⭐️.5) — v filling, the hasbrown issa win
• caramelised banana toast(?) (⭐️⭐️) — its okay, nothing cray. imo needa be more moist for the bread

drink :
• latte (⭐️⭐️) — p gudss, was a bit strong at first n taste a bit on the acid side when its colder.

author: Baggage Claim Philosopher
review_text:
WHO GAVE THESE PEOPLE THE RIGHT TO BE THIS GOOD?

I’ve been to Pison Ubud twice now, and let me tell you, it’s so consistently excellent it’s starting to annoy me. Nobody should be this good at feeding people unless they’re trying to overthrow a government.

You walk in and the place is vibing, all style, energy, and good-looking people pretending they’re not checking their reflections in every shiny surface. The staff? Exceptional. Too exceptional. Smiling, attentive, helpful  like they’re auditioning to be adopted into your family. I’m suspicious of that level of kindness; it usually means someone’s stealing your watch. But no,  they’re just… good. It’s unsettling.

Now let’s talk food.

I had the Seafood Spaghetti, and dear God, it was so scrumptious I nearly applauded. That’s embarrassing. No grown adult should clap for pasta unless they’re at an intervention. Perfectly cooked, flavours bursting, the kind of dish that makes you rethink your life choices, like, ‘Why don’t I live here? Why do I bother cooking at home like a fool?’

Then the Truffle Tenderloin Steak;  juicy, gorgeous, covered in truffle like it’s trying to seduce you. I've eaten steak in a lot of places, sweetheart, and half of them should be in prison compared to this. This thing melted in my mouth so gracefully I filed a police report for emotional manipulation.

Pison is the kind of place that’s so good, so polished, so utterly on point that you leave feeling slightly inferior. You want to improve yourself just so you deserve their dessert.

So here’s the truth:

Food: Outrageous. Stop showing off.

Service: Kind enough to make you suspicious.

Atmosphere: Cool people pretending not to stare at your shirt.

Overall: If you go to Ubud and miss this place, you’re the kind of person who goes to Paris and eats at the airport.

Pison Ubud,
I love you.
I hate how much I love you.
I’ll be back.

And I’ll insult you again. That’s how affection works, sweetheart.

author: Jolin Min Min
review_text:
Food portion is 👍.
Taste is also good!
Just that their signature fried rice is slightly saltier.
They also sang birthday song before presenting the birthday cake to the table.
Very friendly staffs and helpful with the kids.

author: Farah Samy
review_text: Amazing amazing amazing. Everything is top notch. Whether its the staff, especially Indra who was very welcoming and kind, the food! The tenderloin steak and the baked pasta with smoked beef as well as the chilli fries were exceptional. The strawberry lemonade shaker was insane as well. Only thing that wasnt up to that goodness was the bread and butter basket, the bread felt very oily and the portion of the dips was so little. But it honestly did not matter that much because of the quality of the rest of the experience. I would recommend you make a reservation but it wasnt crowded since its a big space.

author: Yesle Hong
review_text: At first, we were a bit concerned because the restaurant is very popular with tourists, but the food was actually very tasty. We had the beef skewers and the red bellet burger, both of which were delicious. The coffee was good too.

author: Yanick Suriyati
review_text: Finally got a chance to try this hype place! Food is good, service is good too, could be improved more and should get more brief or training for them to be able to identify their own menu 😂 the daily worker has been missed placed the drinks, however it’s a minor things for me. The ambience is great, although it was crowded and makes us waiting a bit for the menu to be taken and the receiving our food.

author: Bella
review_text: I’ve always like eating here, because the food is delicious, the ambience is great, but sometimes it takes too long to be seated. So i always choose best time that not too crowded and i enjoyed it. I ordered pork eschalot pasta, and it was delicious! They were very generous with the pork! The oolong is okay and lemon cake is okay.😊

author: Kiran Seth
review_text:
The cafe has indoors & outdoors seating with a view of the padi fields...so refreshing to have the green view instead of the concrete jungle!

Had the avocado coffee, espresso shot on the side and served with ice cream. Guess one needs to acquire a taste for it.

The truffle fries were well flavoured however not well fried as they were oily.

The staff are friendly & attentive to patrons although they were house full.

Do be prepared to wait for a seat.

author: Michael Mandle
review_text:
If heaven had a food court, Piton Coffee & Catery would definitely be running the snack bar. Every dish was unreal — truffle fries addictive, wings spiritual, cordon bleu dangerously good. The coffee? Life-changing. I don’t usually review big spots, but I added this to my exception list

My exceptions, I do not review a place with over 1,000 reviews unless:
-The sever asks me to
-The food is busting

author: boonhong wong
review_text: One of the best food in the region, yet price is very reasonable and portion is quite big. Worth the long queue. Hotel guest next door get 10% discount too!

author: Lusman Yunarto
review_text: Never not happy when dining at Piston Ubud. Amazing service with crew always attentive and smiling. Food & drinks prepared quickly too and freshly arrived at our table. My cream brulee iced americano was salty and great fix, the yuzu cold brew was good too since I asked for the syrup separate (otherwise it'd be too sweet). Thai pork belly kailan over rice was fragrant and saucy. Loved the coriander cilantro taste and its perfect portion size. Only issue? I think price could be a bit less if I'm being honest, like 10-15% less. But with the location, setting and service I'm happy to keep coming back to Pison Ubud.

author: Zackery Goh
review_text:
I recently visited Pison Cafe, and I can confidently say it was an exceptional dining experience! From the moment I walked in, the cozy atmosphere and friendly staff made me feel right at home.

The menu offers a delightful variety of dishes, and I was particularly impressed by the freshness and quality of the ingredients. I tried their signature avocado toast, and it was simply divine! The bread was perfectly toasted, topped with ripe avocados, a sprinkle of feta, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.

For my main course, I indulged in their savory quinoa bowl, which was a harmonious blend of flavors and textures. Each bite was bursting with freshness, and the presentation was top-notch!

The coffee is another highlight; it’s evident that they take great care in sourcing their beans. I had a cappuccino that was both rich and creamy, making it the perfect companion to my meal.

Overall, Pison Cafe is a must-visit for anyone looking for delicious, wholesome food in a welcoming setting. I can’t wait to return and explore more of their menu! Highly recommended!

author: Krisnhaliani Wetarini
review_text:
Nothing beats the ambience of Pison at night. Love spending time here, just to enjoy the live music, sing along, chatting, eating, and drinking. It’s an absolute go-to spot to cherish and celebrate.

The menu is varied and exceptional. Most of the dishes I’ve tried were delightful, and of course, there’s no question about their coffee. I’ve also been loving their matcha drinks lately. The cakes are also enjoyable, I usually go for the tiramisu or carrot cake.

Their pork belly is something you have to try. And if you’re looking for a light comfort food, my personal recommendation is their Truffle French Fries. They also serve alcoholic drinks, and if you’re into cocktails, I’d recommend their Honey Whiskey Mojito — refreshing and perfectly balanced.

The place is often fully booked on weekends, so I’d highly recommend making a reservation beforehand. There’s a minimum spend of 200k/pax, but it’s well worth it. They’re located right by the sidewalk, but don’t worry — valet parking is available.

author: Feri S
review_text: This was my second visit, driven by curiosity to try the crispy fried duck and the squid ink fried rice—and wow, they were absolutely delicious. The duck was tender and tasty, but the real highlight was the squid ink fried rice, easily one of the best I’ve ever had. Both dishes are a must-try if you come here.

author: Kwei Wong
review_text: Ambience is good. I like the fried duck a lot with the chilli dip and crispy skin! The acidic and refreshing salad on the side also cut through the greasiness of the meal. The matcha cloud is nice too! Next time will visit the outlet at Ubud!

author: Hilda Lee
review_text:
Had their breakfast menu and it was superb!!! Infact, we tried so many cafes in Bali and turns out, Pison - IMO serves the best breakfast!

Service rendered by Nadit was exceptional. He remembered on my second cup of coffee that I opted for skimmed milk.

Finally the residential singer’s voice is beautiful!!!

Was going to leave and then, decided to stay for another round of coffee.
Pison really took me by surprise!! Really enjoyed this place so much!!!

author: Jo Lim
review_text: I’m in Bali for 5 Days and I’m back here for 3 days for coffee break and lunch. I love their Cloud coffee, Squid Ink Fried rice with calamari and truffles fries. So delicious and satisfying.

author: Mauro Martin
review_text: Such a great spot for coffee & brunch in Petitenget! The coffee is really good; smooth, strong, and just right. Their desserts and matcha drinks are also beautifully presented and delicious. The warm rustic interior creates a cozy, chill vibe. What makes it even better is the live music, it adds such a nice atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing afternoon or evening hangout. Friendly service, good crowd, and overall a lovely place to spend time in Bali. Highly recommend! 10/10

author: Nem Mang
review_text:
5 stars all around! Pison completely exceeded my expectations. From the very first bite to the last sip, everything was spot-on — thoughtful flavors, great textures, and a cozy atmosphere that made it one of the true highlights of my trip to Bali.
The truffle fries had that perfect golden crunch — addictive and flavorful. My only wish? A few truffle shavings on top would’ve made them absolute perfection.
The duck fried rice was phenomenal — rich, perfectly seasoned, and made even better with the crispy chicken skin. The Thai beef salad was another standout — fresh, bright, and full of flavor.
And the drinks? The cream cheese coffee was unexpectedly amazing — smooth, balanced, and slightly indulgent in the best way. The watermelon cooler was light, refreshing, and the perfect finish to the meal.
Every dish felt crafted with care and creativity. Pison is hands down one of the best dining experiences I had in Bali — I’d go back in a heartbeat. I will also let the pictures speak for themselves.

ps: price per person may vary since there was just me and my friend that ate.

author: Ray Smith
review_text: What an amazing experience! Every ounce of the food we ordered was top tier! Outstanding service,  tourists and locals alike dining together. I will revisit soon we didn't have a chance to try the vast coffee selection, and if it is anything like the food, then it is also incredible. We opted for lemon iced tea which in itself was a surprise to say the least, mint leaves with a hint of vanilla. You must eat here!

author: Yi Wen Cheah
review_text:
Their signature espresso avocado is so so so good!!! Must try when you visit Bali!
We also ordered a main course bebek, it’s delicious, paired so well with their sambal and salad sides where they mix mint leaves with some local herbs.

author: Evi Pandiangan
review_text: Had the fish curry, fried bebek, matcha, coffee and kaya butter. Alll super good 🥰The food was tasty, portions just right, and the drinks hit the spot. Really enjoyed eating here. Would definitely come back!

author: Guido de Valk
review_text:
I frequently dine at Pison, yet this is my first time sharing a review. The experience during my recent visit was exceptional and certainly worth noting.

Upon arrival, we were greeted with genuine warmth and informed that the table was reserved until 9:00 p.m. Since we arrived at 7:15 p.m., this allowed for a comfortable and unhurried dinner.

The meal itself was outstanding. I chose the salmon teriyaki, while my companion ordered the fried duck. Both dishes were executed with precision, offering depth of flavour and excellent balance. The addition of the sous vide egg elevated the presentation and taste. To accompany the meal, I enjoyed a glass of chilled Shiraz. Though I am accustomed to red wine served at room temperature, this variation proved to be a refreshing and well-matched choice.

Overall, the evening combined attentive service, refined dishes, and thoughtful details. Pison continues to demonstrate consistency and quality, and I look forward to returning on future occasions.

author: youjin Song
review_text: Previous experience in Pison Ubud made me to visit this place again …!!!!! And yes, they served much better Steak than Ubud area !!!!! Loved it so much. But the view was much better the Ubud as they’ve got the nature there haha. I should come back this place for coffee 🤎

author: vania
review_text: This place have a very nice atmosphere, gives off industrial and rustic vibes. The food is absolutely divine, me and my family enjoyed everything. You can go here to just have a snack or a full meal, and you will be satisfied.

author: Ahmad Fauzi
review_text: We love the drinks option, and wide array options for the foods. The drinks were amazing- we almost ordered a second glass of caffeinated drink because they look tempting 😁 but we find the foods okay and reasonably affordable.

author: Jeremy Marcellino
review_text:
have been coming here for 6th time already and i think today was the right time to put a review on this place:

TREMENDOUS FOOD!!
Squid Ink Fried Rice definitely our favorite. Truffle Fries felt crunchy and amazing too, if you're looking for a well deserved price this is definitely a best place to go!!

author: B I G P O P P A
review_text: This joint was just across the road from us and we went a few times as they have really creative coffee choices like the soft serve Latte, cloud Latte, creme brulee Latte and others. Good was also real good. I had the Turkish eggs which was really different.  If you're nearby definite check it out.

author: Su Jane
review_text: I'm missing their mochi egg tart! Overall, the brunch here is ok. I ordered the oxtail soup, which was comforting on a rainy day. The food was delicious that I returned for a second straight day (conveniently located next to the yoga barn), proving how good it is

author: Rini Raharjanti
review_text:
Pison serves delicious coffee and food. My favorites are their famous nasi goreng, fried calamari, and pretzel with red bean and butter.

Every night, a live band performs, and the fun crowd makes it even more enjoyable! Make sure to reserve your table in advance 😊

author: rae wu
review_text: The coffee was so unique, but the avocado one was a little bit thick for me…yogurt jar is really recommended! Nice place nice staff:)

author: 孤獨的美食家
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Rock Bar is truly one of Bali’s most iconic sunset destinations — perched dramatically on the cliffs of Jimbaran, it offers breathtaking ocean views that are simply unforgettable. Watching the sun dip below the horizon with waves crashing beneath you feels magical, and the overall ambience is unmatched. It’s definitely a must-visit spot for anyone who loves scenic views, good vibes, and great music.

The atmosphere is vibrant yet relaxed, especially as the sky changes colours. The live DJ adds a nice energy to the evening without being too loud. It’s the kind of place where you can enjoy a cocktail, take in the sea breeze, and just unwind.

The drinks are well-crafted and beautifully presented, though the prices are definitely on the higher side — expected for a venue with such a view. The food is decent but not particularly memorable; it serves more as a complement to the drinks and sunset rather than the highlight itself.

The service was generally friendly, though it can be a bit slow during peak hours due to the large crowd. Staff members were polite but seemed slightly overwhelmed at times.

Overall, Rock Bar delivers a spectacular visual and sensory experience. It’s perfect for sunsets, celebrations, or just soaking in the best of Bali’s coastal charm. While it’s not ideal for foodies seeking fine dining, it’s absolutely worth visiting for the view and atmosphere alone.

author: Christina Lui
review_text: The view is super nice IF you can a good seat. And obviously the nice view seat only for the guest and we, walk in guest just to bring to the designated table depends on luck. We got the seat only can see 20% of the sunset. The waitress are super good as in every time they are around to serve us. The food is so so. I went there around 530pm and by 645+, the sky is dark and we can’t see anything. There’s minimum spend too for walk in guest so we have to order something to enjoy the view. Also, it was so hot without any wind

author: Nothing
review_text:
A great place to watch the sunset in Bali.
Located in the Ayana resort grounds, you will be guided to the entrance.
I had a good seat to watch the sunset and the sea view. The drinks were delicious and the decoration was beautiful.
One of the most valuable and unforgettable experiences for me in Bali, and I want to come back here again.
My raw pictures are not enough to capture the dreamy, vast and brilliant beauty here, you should come and experience it yourself.
From Vietnam with love.

author: means mini
review_text:
The view is spectacular, but the experience was a letdown.

• Drinks and food were just average.
• Poor seating—I was placed near the smelly restrooms.
• No non-smoking area; the air was thick with smoke even with children present.

For a bar with a "world's best" reputation, I expected much more.

author: Vania C
review_text:
finally got to experience rock bar as we got complimentary 10% off as in house guests from Ayana. the vibe was everything! and the drinks were delicious. we had Sunset Dragon & requested Long Island which was not in the menu book. worth the hype. definitely coming back again.

notes for Rockbar (if u’re reading this): please add some fan or anything to make sure that we could enjoy the night better. last time we were there, the wind was absent and it was so humid & hot. thank you!

author: Lochie Matonti
review_text:
Awesome experience that is well worth the journey and the perhaps marked up prices or the bar.

Go for sunset, and go early around 4.30-5pm to ensure you get in, and get a nice spot.

There is a minimum price for either the Tapas or the Dinner (sit down at dining area), but if you grab a couple of cocktails each or a drink and some food, you will hit this no worries

The food is nothing to write home about, but it gets the job done if you are wanting to eat here.

The main sell is the absolutely amazing setting - there is nothing like it in Bali. It's truly an experience worth visiting, with an amazing vibe, music, drinks, and atmosphere.

author: Dikan Reyes
review_text:
The architectural design of this venue alone is a sight to behold, videos and pictures simply don’t do it justice. The views and design elevate this place to true bucket-list status.

The service is world-class, the food is exceptional, and the shisha service is supreme. It’s uncontested why Rock Bar is consistently ranked as one of the top lounges in the world, and I will gladly second that choice.

This place is absolutely breathtaking. With top-tier service, excellent food, drinks, and shisha, it delivers an unforgettable experience from start to finish.

author: Catherine Galea
review_text:
I am the first to say how amazing the Rock Bar is… I have been many times. But this time I couldn’t believe that they are charging approx $15 AUD for a 380 ml bottle of water and a can of coke/sprite. Just wow.
Food was good, but I was disappointed they did not have the lamb available.
Overall a beautiful place and experience but stop charging $15 for a can of coke!
Staff have also become much younger and they do not understand a lot of English.
Which also made it hard to communicate. Customer service was not their best this visit.

author: Dilip
review_text: Definitely worth it if visiting Bali. It’s one of the items on the list you tick off. You would be brave to site by the water as there’s a lot of sea spray. You will get wet so be sure you are ok. Sunset is spectacular. Food is good but a bit overpriced but you are in a 5 star and paying for the venue

author: Michael Forkin
review_text: This spot has a great sunset, a lovely, albeit cramped layout and some very attentive and wonderful staff. Despite all of this, I must admit that the prices at the venue are on the expensive side and the “++” on the menu only adds to this. The food is very overpriced for what it is, we ordered the beef and lamb kebabs which came out as eight small meatballs, the crispy red snapper bites and the golden fries. None of which were show stoppers and for the price paid, the flavour and size was quite disappointing. The venue is great for a sunset photo shoot if you are that way inclined, and a cheeky pre-dinner drink but I wouldn’t say it’s a must see if you aren’t staying at the Ayana Resort (or if you are).

author: Ahmed Alzahrani
review_text:
Great place to watch the sunset, but you need to make a reservation. Once you book, you can arrive early and they’ll find you a table—don’t worry, the place is huge with over 500 tables. The earlier you come, the better.

There’s a minimum charge of 350k IDR per person (around $20). The food wasn’t the best, but the atmosphere and the sunset view were absolutely stunning, plus there’s a live DJ. Definitely recommend adding this to your Bali list.

author: steve ong
review_text:
FIRST & LAST ‼️

Arrived at 5pm for a 7:30pm reservation. The staff were welcoming at first and seated us at a hot walk-in area with umbrellas. Ordered some beers while waiting, then asked about our dinner table, turns out it was just right beside our current counter top seat, with a poor view, while walk-in guests at 5pm got the top deck seats with the best views.

Decided to try some bites before dinner-ordered nachos, and they were honestly the worst I’ve ever had: bland, tasteless, nowhere 5-star hotel standard. We lost our appetite and canceled dinner.

By 7pm we decided to leave. Shockingly, the exit process was terrible-no guidance, no staff escort like when we arrived, just vague directions. The way out was dark, with endless stairs, and even other guests were complaining.

In the end, 4 beers and awful nachos cost nearly 900k IDR. The view is the only thing worth it, but overall a disappointing, overpriced experience. Definitely won’t return.

author: Aleksandra Abdulgazijeva
review_text: The bar is located in a truly beautiful spot. If you arrive about 1.5 hours before sunset, be prepared — it gets very hot, even though there are umbrellas. We didn’t make a reservation and came by chance about two hours before sunset, being among the first guests. The sunset itself was truly unforgettable. We paid nearly €300 for some snacks and champagne. The food certainly doesn’t match the prices, but for such an incredible view, it feels worth it.

author: Sayu Devi
review_text: Perfect spot for sunset! It gets pretty hot before 6 PM, but they provide umbrellas. It’s an outdoor bar, so they’ll close if it rains. Loved the vibe, just wish the food was better!

author: Murray River
review_text: We visited the famous ROCK BAR as part of our AYANA resort experience. We had pre booked well in advance a time slot from 5-7pm local time. From the initial check in and staff who greeted us it was positive. Not to mention our table which had perfect views from the upper deck unobstructed. We enjoyed tapas which were generous in their size and variety. Two deserts finished the experience off and of course several signature cocktails. I would highly recommend adding this to your next Bali adventure. Book well in advance. A lift is available for those with limited mobility and security us on site and has a visible presence.

author: Adam Herlambang
review_text:
Visited in August 2022 and I still can’t get over how stunning the sunset was. This place isn’t just a bar—it’s an experience. Perched on the edge of a cliff with the ocean crashing below, every golden hour turns into a movie scene.

Drinks were solid, vibes were unmatched, and the staff was super friendly. Pro tip: come early to grab the best seat before it gets packed.

author: Rory Staff
review_text: Stunning spot. A real must if you are over this way. Food was decent, but the views just absolutely make this place perfect for sunset dining. If you're not staying there you can risk it and try to get a spot for sunset otherwise you have to book in for after it.

author: Ronex D Bonex
review_text:
What a amazing Dining Experience 😱
What else you can ask for The Sea waves, The Sunset, Live DJ and music, Amazing view, The smell of the sea. Everything is amazing. You should experience this place. 👍🙌👏

author: Manon Bruynel
review_text: Food and drink here are very average compared to the rest of the resort. Personally I felt Rock Bar overall was overrated. It was chaotic where we were with lots of people trying to get photos with the view and others smoking at tables nearby which we couldn’t get away from. None of the food or drink we ordered lived up to our expectations and was all very so so, the dinner menu food looked like it probably tasted better. Glad we tried it as we were staying at Ayana but feel I would have been disappointed if I had come from further away.

author: Glara Y.
review_text:
Where to begin with Rock Bar? Perched literally on the rocks, it offers an indescribably stunning view of the ocean—truly one of the most iconic sunset spots in Bali.

On a clear, sunny day, a breathtaking sunset is all but guaranteed. The sound of waves crashing below, the golden light reflecting off the sea, and the panoramic horizon stretching out in front of you—it’s an experience that leaves you in awe.

I felt incredibly fortunate to have celebrated my big birthday on the Round Deck, a more intimate setting with uninterrupted views. It made the moment feel truly special—surreal, even.

The staff go above and beyond, not just with attentive service, but also in helping guests capture perfect photos. They understand that this place is not just about drinks, but memories.

The cocktails are well-crafted and refreshing, but honestly, the view is the real star. If you’re visiting Ayana, Rock Bar is simply unmissable.

author: Kenny Yap
review_text:
Easily the best meal I’ve had in awhile and possibly the best I’ve ever had in Bali at any price point, yet the price is highly reasonable for the quality you’re receiving.

I headed there on a Friday night without any booking, a ballsy move which paid off as I was dining as a single pax. I got the bar counter at first but was able to move to another high table.

I went with mixto ceviche, wood fire grilled chicken and 2 of their starters - the beef tartare and squid. Finally ended off with their frozen cheesecake.

Everything was superb, and while the chicken felt somewhat normal I wanted a meat instead of ordering all seafood items, so it went well in the end.

Service was also tip top, constantly checking in on me without feeling too imposing and also topping up my water and clearing the empty plates. The vibes was also pretty cosy with a live DJ in the background. The interior needless to say is one of the nicest you would see in Bali, with high ceilings.

author: Vernice Pai
review_text:
Celebrated my birthday here and it was the best decision ever. We heard from friends that this is the best cafe in canggu and must try. We were so excited we came at lunch, and we got to enjoy the sunlight and big blue sky in the fancy decor. The place is stunning and the food was amazing. Two of us, but we ordered 5 dishes + 1 dessert on the house!!!!!! It was so good we wanted to try everything.

Thank you again to Vera And Ketut who made special arrangements to celebrate this big day for me ❤️ I really felt the hospitality. They were really professional and well spoken in English too. Would love to visit again :)

author: An Le
review_text: I had one of the best meals in Bali here. To start with, the restaurant was really responsive and nice to accommodate our change of plan. Overall, the dinner was amazing with the salmon roe and tuna, beef tartare, potato mille being the highlight. And you cannot miss their amazing dessert. We ordered a frozen cheesecake and it was so creamy, refreshing, and not too sweet. My partner and I went here for a birthday dinner and we got a complimentary guava tart. The tart was delicious, soft, fruity. We will definitely come back to this place for celebration!

author: Maureen Kwok
review_text:
Went twice during my stay in Bali- alone and with my family. Love the food here, taste is simple and clean with no heavy spices, but overall impressed by how everything is salted evenly. Nothing is too salty, too sweet, too sour, or too tangy etc. very well balanced. The kitchen did a v good job.

If you came with 2 other people, order their 14 days dry aged duck. So good

In the evening the staff gave me free limoncello shot and kept on checking on me. I think they didn’t want me to feel alone. Thanks for the hospitality guys (and girls)

Love to be back next time & keep up the amazing work

author: Elvi Thio
review_text:
THE SNACKS ARE 10s ACROSS THE BOARD!!

Must-order Snacks (1 a person):
Woodfired baby squid
Foie gras parfait
Tokusen wagyu beef tartare
PLUS Order the Mixto Ceviche!! Creamy.

Snacks also Yummy but not necessary:
Duck empanada
Chicken skewer

Mains were just okay, good but not the same caliber as the snacks.
1 Yellowfin Tuna
1 Char-grilled Octopus
1 Woodfired chicken

I also loved the Potato Mille Feuille, but I love potato so maybe a bit biased.

author: Tan Tessa
review_text:
We tried several dishes and really enjoyed them!
Grilled Octopus – Nicely charred with great flavor, and the sauce balanced everything perfectly.
Chicken Skewers – Nothing like your typical satay; they were soft and moist, and the arepa underneath was grilled to perfection. We even ordered extra to go with the duck!
Duck – A very generous portion that can easily be shared between 2–3 people. It does get a bit jelak after a while, but still delicious.

The vibes were amazing and cosy. Service was excellent — they paid attention to our allergy notes, which we really appreciated. We mentioned we were celebrating our anniversary, and they surprised us with free churros that were chewy and full of flavour.

Overall, a wonderful experience. Highly recommend!

author: Giovanni
review_text: I loved it. The atmosphere is calm and classy, retro, very south American. It has a second floor with view on the basement, perfect for romantic dinner. The kitchen is very organized and efficient. The dishes are perfectly prepared and all the flavors will balanced. The staff is attentive and super kind. We loved all the dishes we had. A place to back.

author: Iris Chang
review_text: Celebrated my birthday here - great ambience, really tasty food and impeccable service. The server Anom gave food recommendations that were spot on - potato Mille feuille, empanadas, grilled octopus and wood-fired chicken finished off with Frozen Cheesecake. Anom surprised us with a complimentary guava pie and took great photos of us. The only regret I have was not eating here in all my earlier trips to Bali.

author: Ivy Wong
review_text: Worth a trip from Seminyak to Canggu just for this meal! We tried 3 different ceviches with the Alfonsin being the stand-out dish. The grouper was amazingly cooked with the skin so crispy and meat so flavourful. Service was excellent as per most Balinese restaurants, and they even served us a complimentary guava tart (must try!) when they found out it was our honeymoon. The place is beautifully decorated too. 10/10 would recommend!

author: CE.C Foo
review_text:
I think easily the best restaurant in Canggu! If you don’t come here, you are missing out.

Every dish was so yummy, we would love to order more but we are trying to control ourselves.

I love love love the strawberry guava tart!!

author: Yeung Au
review_text:
Santanera is my favorite dining spot in Bali! The food was fantastic, but what truly made our experience exceptional was the service provided by Gung Vera and Ade. They were incredibly friendly and always greeted us with warm smiles.

When I mentioned that we were celebrating a friend's birthday, they went above and beyond to create a wonderful atmosphere for our celebration. Their thoughtful touches made our day truly special.

We will definitely return on our next trip to Bali! I highly recommend Santanera for anyone looking for great food and outstanding service!

author: Lily Newman-Kelly
review_text: Absolutely incredible dining experience - the team were incredibly helpful and seated me in a wonderful table despite not having a prior booking. The food and drinks were outstanding - one of the best meals I’ve had out! Thanks particularly to Listia and also the main hosts who were very proactive and cautious regarding my nut allergies. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area and would love to come back!

author: Bassam Alam
review_text: Quality dinner with really good service. The portions are quite small so you need to order a lot of food if you’re a big eater but the food was amazing. Spent approximately $220 AUD between my partner and I. Oka took great care of us. Thankyou.

author: Pui Ka Chan
review_text:
We came here for my birthday celebration. The restaurant was decorated in style with a joyful and cozy ambience. All staff were friendly and welcoming with big smiles on their faces.

We ordered the Yellow Fin Tuna and Salmon Roe Tartelette, Mixto Ceviche, Woodfire Chicken, Char-grilled Octopus and Potato Mille Feuille. Everything was delicious. We especially loved the chicken which was tender, juicy and well seasoned.

The portion of the dishes were pretty generous.  We were both very full and decided not to order any desserts. However, knowing that it was my birthday, the Santenera Team insisted to celebrate with me. It was really heartwarming. Thank you very much for your hospitality and all the tasty dishes! Will definitely come back if we visit Canggu again.

author: Bruce (Bruce Ning)
review_text: I came here to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday. The waitress, Asmi, was incredibly friendly and even gave us a complimentary cake. The food was excellent—especially the Wagyu Picanha MB7 cooked medium rare—and the char-grilled octopus was a close second. A perfect place for celebrations.

author: Marce J
review_text: Amazing experience! The service was excellent. We had dinner at the bar and loved it, the bartender were shaking cocktails right in front of us and sharing the stories behind them, which really made the evening feel special. The live Latin American music in the background added so much atmosphere, and the food was truly great. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Jeanne Mendoza
review_text:
The food was absolutely amazing, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented! We really wanted to try the desserts but were way too full, so that just gives us the perfect reason to come back. 🤩

The service was impeccable, and a special shoutout to Sri, who was so warm and helpful in guiding us through the menu since it was our first time here. Definitely a must-visit in Bali — can’t wait to return!

author: Klyde Bacala
review_text:
We came here to celebrate my father-in-law's 60th birthday with the whole family. We were ushered upstairs to a very nice private space that could sit 10-15 people. The whole atmosphere was pleasant and suprisingly kid friendly as we had a total of 4 children.

We had the fine dining set order by candlelights. Our server was Rudy and his team, they were very welcoming, fun, and hospitable.

Food wise, we started off with Mahi Mahi with potato bread. This for me was probably the best combination of bread and dipping sauce. The Mahi Mahi was marvelous, very creamy with that hint of fishy taste at every bite. It was a wholesome experience. Then came the tuna tartelette and jamom croquette. The tartelette was zingy and flavourful as a mouthful, I personally liked that. The croquette was creamy and blended perfectly with the saltiness of the jamon. As for the ceviche, it was alright though, my famumily had the same sentiments. We probably expected it to be a bit more sour and vinegarey, but this one somehow lacked a bit of those elements for our liking, some even commented it tasting a little sweet. Now for the shared mains, we had dry aged grouper, lamb shoulder, and potato mille. Not many of us appreciated the grouper, although it was presented well and had that crispy skin, we found the meat a tad bit mushy in some parts. The lamb was a delight though, very soft, almost a melt-in-your-mouth kind of attempt. It tasted a little gamey, but we all were used which we didn't mind at all. On that note, most of us wished it was a potato mash instead of mille. We thought it would've been a more rounded pairing with the lamb. But the mille was crunchy and soft inside, we all liked it. Finally, as a dessert person, my winner would probably be the churros. It had that perfect crunch and soft core. The dulce de leche was a nice touch as it melts the chocolate on top of the churros. The amalgamation of all the components in this dessert was very well executed. It was a delightful experience altogether.

The staff also prepared a candle for my father-in-law to blow, and they catered very well to the children. Our team of servers were very fun and accommodating. This definitely made our whole experience a comfortable and memorable one. The restaurant should be proud of their staff, very kind and go above and beyond.

We highly recommend this restaurant if you want to try a fine-dining experience with its own flair and genuine service!

author: Simon Choe
review_text: Came for date night and had the set menu. Overall highly recommend. Loved almost everything we got. Ceviche was perfect! The lamb and thousand layer potato were well cooked but taste-wise felt out of place on the menu, as the flavor profile was much narrower than the other dishes. Perhaps it would have been better to swap for a seafood main and the corn cake.

author: Vincent Yuen
review_text:
From the moment we walked in, the service was warm, attentive, and full of great recommendations. The ambiance is a beautiful blend of classic elegance and traditional Balinese culture—truly a feast for the senses. Ketut provided excellent service—his thoughtful recommendations made the experience both joyful and impressively professional.

The highlight of the meal was the dry-aged duck—perfectly cooked and bursting with flavor. Every dish we tried reflected high-quality ingredients and thoughtful preparation. Prices are very fair considering the exceptional food and atmosphere.

Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy refined cuisine in a culturally rich setting. Will definitely be coming back!

author: Erda Roslan Khairi
review_text:
Seniman Coffee Roasters does something refreshingly thoughtful with their coffee to go, no disposable cups, no flimsy lids. Instead, your coffee comes in a glass bottle, and that small detail makes a big statement!

It feels intentional. Sustainable without being preachy. The glass keeps the coffee at a better temperature, preserves the aroma, and somehow makes even a takeaway latte feel curated, not rushed. It’s coffee you respect, even when you’re on the move.Of course, the coffee itself is well-roasted, balanced, and confidently crafted. The atmosphere is warm, creative and alive! You come for the coffee, of course, but there is more reasons to stay. You stay for the feeling❤️

author: Vlad Tapia
review_text:
Retro Vibes & Serious Coffee

Very cool café with an 80s retro feel and a creative, artistic décor. The coffee-making setup is super advanced — you can tell they take their craft seriously. It’s a great spot to read, chill, and enjoy a quality cup of coffee.

I had the avocado toast and it was well done. The egg Portuguese tart was alright, a bit overcooked for my liking, but still enjoyable.

Overall, a stylish café with excellent coffee and a unique vibe. Worth checking out if you’re in Ubud.

author: Kevin Stevano
review_text:
We had a wonderful time at Seniman Coffee Ubud! The atmosphere is cozy and relaxed, and the coffee is simply excellent. From the aroma to the flavor and presentation, you can really tell that they take their craft seriously. It's a perfect spot to unwind, have a good conversation, or just enjoy a well-made cup of coffee.
A special thank you to Saman for the warm and attentive service. You made our visit even more enjoyable with your friendliness and professionalism. We truly appreciate it!
We'll definitely be coming back the next time we're in Ubud. ☕✨

author: Prachi Chaudhary
review_text:
They have a coffee house , a music store and a restaurant all in one place.
You can eat while purchasing CDs and music merchandise or you can look at them while drinking your coffee. They also conduct coffee making workshops.
We ordered spring rolls, a smoothie , a tart which were good.We also ordered a vegan dessert which wasnt much good.
They have valet parking service, which is very good because we couldnt see any space to park our scooter.

author: May S.
review_text:
Came here two days in a row since I live next door. On the first day, I tried the bakery and coffee... they were average, but the vibe is really good and cozy, perfect for reading or working on a laptop, even on a rainy day.

Came back for lunch on day two and was pleasantly surprised! this place is seriously underrated! The Hainan chicken is superb, and the Asian-fusion menu is creative and different from the usual café offerings. Highly recommend for the food, and I’ll definitely be back to try more dishes.

author: Diah Septyana
review_text: Seniman coffee is a great spot to check out. Their dishes are reasonably priced, served in generous portions and are quite filling. They also offer alternatives for those who prefer non-coffee drinks. The atmosphere is cozy, making it a good spot to chat with friends.

author: Zeal Amar kapadia
review_text: Visited Semian for coffee and some treats. The place was really creative and the ambience was genuinely nice. The coffee was good, and most of the food was fine, but the brownie tasted a little bit off. The main downside was the washroom, which definitely needs improvement. Overall, it’s a nice spot to chill for a bit, but there are a few things that could be better.

author: Alexander Zhdanov
review_text:
📍 Coffee with a Creative Twist in Ubud? ⬇️

✨ Save & Share this spot ✨

If you’re in Ubud and love coffee, Seniman Coffee is a must-visit! ☕️🌴
The vibe is super chill with jazz music, breezy seating (both AC & non-AC), and a creative menu full of unique signature drinks.

I tried the Wild Side — a mix of cold brew, coconut, honey, and lime — and it was honestly one of the most refreshing and unforgettable coffee experiences I’ve ever had in Bali. 🍯🥥🍋 The cold brew sampler and nitro espresso mocha are also next-level! And don’t even get me started on the croissants 🥐… perfect.

Yes, it’s a little pricey, but the quality, atmosphere, and attentive staff make it worth every rupiah. A gem in Ubud for true coffee lovers. 🌿

👉 Have you ever tried a coffee that surprised you with its flavor?

Seniman Coffee ☕️

Credit: #BaliCoffee #UbudVibes #VeganFriendlyBali #CoffeeCulture #SenimanCoffee #BaliEats #CoffeeAddict #IndonesiaCafe

author: LI FENG
review_text:
DO NOY BUY BEANS HERE..🙅

The beans I bought were very soft in texture and lacked aroma. The cup was flat and dull, drinkable, but only in a very functional way, with no real character. For the price, the quality was far below expectations.

The flavor notes on the bag did not match what I actually tasted, and there was no clear information about altitude or detailed origin, which makes it hard to judge the beans as “specialty.”

If you are looking for true specialty coffee beans with clarity and aroma, I honestly wouldn’t recommend buying beans here. For me, this purchase felt like a waste of money.

author: Coffee in Bali
review_text:
📶 WiFi ~29.7 Mbps down / 45.7 Mbps up
🌀 AC: 1/5 no AC but good fans
☕ Coffee quality: 4.8/5
💵 38k small latte
A VERY popular place, excellent coffee, great to work and to met people

author: Andil Ong
review_text:
- Very cool vibe and atmosphere
- They have a lot of signature coffees and menu items.
- Tried the Wild Erness which is a coffee topped with white chocolate cream and it’s pretty good but it tastes more like dessert rather than a wake up juice, in case that’s your thing.
- They have AC and non-AC area but even the non-AC area is full of breeze so it was nice to hang out there.
- A little pricey but I feel like it’s worth it because I always enjoy my time and my drinks there

author: Avijeet Sen
review_text:
Visited in Aug 2025

One of the best coffee places in Ubud. Tried a few cold brews which were quite good. Seniman also gives a small biscuit/cookie with every beverage you order, which is quite a nice gesture. I also packed some beans for home. Would definitely recommend a visit if you’re staying in Ubud.

author: raabia hessa
review_text:
can recommend the chilled espressos! great service, we will definitely return!

edit:
have come here many times during our trip in Ubud. we love the coffee, the atmosphere, the food & the service! i’ve had breakfast, lunch & dinner here - never disappoints. highly highly recommend the asian salad with the tofu, some of the best tofu i’ve had :)

author: gede febri prayoga
review_text: The black coffee was excellently brewed, delivering a clean and well-balanced flavor profile. The aroma was pleasant, and the coffee maintained a consistent quality throughout

author: Aji Sapto Perbowo
review_text:
The Vibe is great, lunch in next to the street…
Coffee are original & delicious
Non-coffee also nice
The uniqueness place of seats & tables are nice
Service, cepat, sopan & presisi
All are good and nice experience to my kiddos
Thanks utk Wiwiek for teaching my kids about coffee..🥰

author: dhimas baskoro
review_text:
Very unique cafe in ubud. As it suggests in their name "seniman" (=artist) they took coffee very seriously. Half of their menu consists of coffee from all over Indonesia. Coffee and tea actually. The chairs are rocking chairs!! Lol. They also sell coffee beans and tea leaves, a lot of kinds. They also do coffee workshops with reservation.
Cozy place, friendly staff. Great cafe experience.

author: Yang Jian
review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Seniman Kopi!
The coffee here is truly exceptional—rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed. The food is just as impressive; everything I tried was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. What really made the visit special was the outstanding service. The staff are incredibly welcoming, and a big shoutout to specially the baristas Rimba and Yoga—they were so friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about what they do. Their warm and genuine hospitality made the whole experience even better.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great coffee, delicious food, and top-notch service in a cozy atmosphere. Can't wait to come back!

author: Swiss
review_text: Five stars to this place for authenticity, creativity, culture and use of recycled items . Enjoyed sitting on the plastic rocking chairs - they were incredibly comfortable! There is a large table at the front where guests can bring their laptop and work. Plenty of plug points . The middle of the shop has retail items for sale showcasing local and international artists . The food prices were reasonable and food tasted good too . Service as prompt and with great vibes .

author: Vicky Li
review_text:
So much selection of coffee!! I especially love their house blend from my flat white (make sure you ask for double shots if you prefer strong coffee as the default is one espresso shot only) — rosy, chocolatey, and nutty. Bought a few bags of beans with me so I can try at home.

Food here is surprisingly tasty!! We got an avocado toast (Indonesian avocado is more mild and watery than the creamy Mexican counterpart just to manage expectations; it’s still good to feel full & healthy from its big portion). We also loved the Asian chicken salad (chicken is so flavorful and tender!!) and the refreshing sesame handmade noodles (wow the handmade noodles are delicious!!)

Would love to come back if we were in Ubud for longer.

author: Youana Agustina Lopies
review_text: I stopped by at night just to relax and ended up staying until closing. The staff were super caring and the tofu dessert I ordered (forgot the name) was so delicious. I’ll definitely come back when I’m in Ubud!

author: Royy
review_text:
If you’re looking for a spot in Denpasar that nails the "work-from-cafe" vibe without sacrificing specialty coffee quality, Seniman Coffee Renon is arguably the top contender in the area.

Unlike the bustling, tourist-heavy Ubud original, the Renon spot feels more "pro." It’s a favorite for digital nomads and local professionals.

• The Setup: It features a spacious indoor air-conditioned area and a breezy semi-outdoor space. The lighting is bright enough for working, and the decor is distinctively "Seniman"—think upcycled furniture and artistic touches.

• Connectivity: The Wi-Fi is generally reliable and fast, making it ideal for Zoom calls or deep-work sessions.

• Ambiance: It strikes a great balance; it’s quiet enough in the mornings for focus, but transitions into a lively, cozy hangout spot by the afternoon/evening.

Their manual brew selection is massive. You can choose from various Indonesian single origins (like Karana Kintamani or Aceh Gayo) prepared with precision.

author: I komang Budiarta
review_text: Seniman Coffee Renon is hands down one of the best coffee spots in Denpasar! The coffee is consistently excellent — rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed. You can really taste the quality of the beans. The café has a cool, modern vibe with a relaxed atmosphere that’s great for working or just hanging out. The staff are friendly and knowledgeable, always happy to recommend something new. Love their cold brew and pastries too. A must-visit for coffee lovers in Renon!

author: Aulia Yuginastiti
review_text: Been here three or four times. One of the best coffee in town, but average food. Had the shakshouka, but the sausage is a bit downer. Price wise, it is a bit higher than other coffee shops, but I can say that is worth the price! Love the coffee variety served here as well. Ambience? Very nice. Lively and bright.

author: Ketut Suta Arjana
review_text:
Seniman Coffee is indeed a very comfortable place to drink coffee. Located in the centre of Bali, in Renon, it is very strategic. The coffee served is roasted in-house, with many choices of types and origins. As a coffee lover who brews coffee every morning, I like the taste of the coffee brewed by the barista. Because I stop by in the morning just for breakfast and don't stay long as I have to continue on to other destinations. So far, I am satisfied.
Thank you, and I hope I can visit again on my next trip.

author: weda
review_text:
I came in around 8 am on a weekday and some tables were already booked. No wonder because their coffee was always so good. I ordered a latte and cheese cake, both were great.

Always love their iconic decor. Spacious indoors and semi-outdoor area. You can also sit by the bar.

Great selection of coffee. Some pastries are still unavailable around this hour.

author: Ray Ray
review_text:
The coffee is pretty good. And the presentation kicks it to another level. Very well thought out. Every piece of what's coming out for my Long Black is just amazing. I can see the dedication prepared for this place.

There's even a DJ station. Reminding me of a coffee shop i visited in Kemang, South Jakarta.

The decoration is also up and above what's the normal coffee house will present. Amazing!

The way they decorate the cashier is also interesting. Makes me want to hang out by the cashier for extended period of time.

Unfortunately the team are not well trained. They leave the empty plates or glass or cups by the table for sometime. No one is going around or checking from a distance for this. Only when they were serving next table, they see our empty cups, then they asked if it's okay to picked them up.

Else than that, I'm liking the place. And yes of course I'll be coming back.

author: Mr.K
review_text: Loved it ! Stayed from 5pm till closing hour 😅 super comfortable. Coffee was great & so is the pastry — toilet was spotless btw. Definitely come back for sure !

author: Wira D. Putra
review_text:
For me, Seniman is still the best place to have cups of coffee!

The first sip delivered a brilliant flavor and this is it! Seniman Coffee I’ve always known. Clearly, it's back as my favorite cappuccinos.

Thank you for the warm response to my last complaint. Dita and the team handled the misunderstanding very well.
She works very professional.

Then you guys give me many compliments and of course thanks! 😁

Note : Kintamani V60 sample works very well btw!
Gonna try it soon!

author: Journal Pengangguran
review_text:
Coffee always superb. Always love being in Seniman. Everything is good, its just too crowded sometimes, but happy to know that.

Cashless payment only. Service is excellent as usual.

author: Gita Swasti
review_text:
If you want to work from a cafe, it feels too noisy unless you have no problem with it. They have a bag holder on the floor so my backpack doesn't get dirty, wow that's so thoughtful. This place is always crowded. Previously it was located in Sudirman, then moved to Renon. That's great, no need to go all the way to Ubud.

The coffee is not too overwhelming and is wrapped in milk that tastes creamy. What a pleasant tasting. Somewhat difficult to find parking as the cafe is located in a busy area with limited parking spaces. Visitors often need to circle around or park a bit further away especially during peak hours.

author: Mirah Sanjiwani
review_text: Good vibes, good food and friendly staff. Coffee was very recommended (Milky Way Vanilla Flavour). Before asking the cable extension, staff was very attentive to provide it (such a five star service). Spacious table and area, good for work-in-cafe too. Thank you very much for the best service ❤️

author: Bayu Mayura
review_text: Perfect combo for coffee and Vinyl addict, i like the store concept. I ordered seniman latte, the taste quite unique than others latte. But i like the taste. Please note: you better booked the table before coming especially in the evening almost crowded. The staff very kind and helpful to get my seat.

author: Anggita Widyananda Nugraha
review_text: Love all the things from the greetings, service, ambience, the food and ofc their coffee! For you who want to work there, best!

author: Febriyanto Wibowo
review_text: Always a place I recommend visiting when in Bali — a coffee spot with a distinctive taste and an atmosphere that’s both cozy and calming.

author: Rony Zakaria
review_text: They moved to Renon from their old place in Sudirman. Honestly like their old setting before. This one is like just another coffee shop in Jaksel… but good coffee and great service tho

author: Valeri Deassy
review_text:
good space good vibe good food
saved this place into my favorites!

author: TranSon. Swellhanoi Studio
review_text: A cozy place for weekend morning coffee or lunch . I like this place decorations too. Music corner is cool . Staff are very friendly

author: Putu Yudi
review_text:
The place is so beautiful, full of art, every corner is aesthetic,
The ice latte is so good, refreshing well made,
The chocolate pie is delicious too,
Very beautiful place

author: Tania N
review_text:
It was packed when I went here on a Saturday. You can’t deny the place has that chill vibe you need when hanging out with friends. Music was top notch and noise level was bearable, although for me I had to wear my headphones. Their food and beverages, though, were mediocre to me, but there’s a plenty of intriguing choices that could peak your curiousity.

What really stood out was this certain corner. Tektonik Records sells used vinyls from various genres, as well as zines, pins, posters originally made by a Balinese artist. You can listen to the vinyls too. Unfortunately they weren’t selling any cassette tapes (the ones on display were merely the cases for decoration purposes).

author: Latifah Qurrota Aini
review_text: The staff were so nice. I had a black coffee made with Papua beans, and it came with water and a little snack (surprisingly really good). Since I was sitting in front of the bar, they also let me try a cup of coffee made with their own beans for free. For me, it was a 5 star experience

author: Denis Uelski
review_text:
It’s one of those places that has consistent quality and never disappoints. I have over 100 food photos from here (starting from 2022), and I can assure you — today everything was basically the same as three years ago. That’s a huge achievement if you think about it, especially compared to similar places around Bali.
It’s the spot with the best healthy breakfasts I’ve found — and I’ve been to quite a lot of them. I know pretty much the whole menu by now, and the smoothies are especially good. My favorites are Island Life, Choc Tops, and Startup — I just can’t decide which one to get each time I’m here.
There’s also this really nice outdoor area that somehow calms you down — you just want to stay there and keep coming back. Whenever I’m staying in this area, I go to Shady Shack for breakfast about 90% of the time.
The staff is almost the same as it was three years ago, which is another incredible achievement.
I just hope this place keeps going and lives forever — because it’s already something truly special.

author: Rosie Bakes
review_text: Absolutely loved this spot! 🌿 The tropical vibes are unreal—lush leafy seating, relaxed atmosphere, just so inviting. The food is a feast for the eyes and the taste buds: vibrant, colorful, and incredibly fresh. Even as a non-vegan, every dish was packed with flavor and totally satisfying. Generous portions, happy tummies, and a seriously chilled, fun night out. Highly recommend! 🌺✨

author: Aryan Mahajan
review_text: Loved this place! fresh, delicious food with great vegan and gluten-free options. Beautiful, green, and peaceful ambience paired with genuinely lovely staff. Highly recommended

author: Tamara K
review_text: Great place for a clean light meal! Love the salad bowls!! The ambience is also lovely, and apart from the street noise, it's also quiet.. If they had power outlets closer to the tables, would be a great place to work from… :)

author: Anaïs I.
review_text:
Photos by @anais.ia

My favorite place. The food is ALWAYS clean and amazing. The staff is sweet and place amazing for breakfast lunch dinner or chill. Can you tell I am into avocado toast too much =)

author: Kyla Shaw
review_text:
Shady Shack quickly became one of our favorite spots in Canggu. The setting feels calm and leafy, with a relaxed energy that makes it easy to linger over breakfast or a late lunch. It is the kind of place where the music sits in the background, the staff greet you with a smile, and you never feel rushed. The menu leans fresh and vibrant, and everything we tried tasted clean and satisfying without feeling plain. Service was friendly and efficient, and the portions were generous enough to share.

The smoothie bowls were excellent. Creamy bases with bright fruit, crunchy toppings, and a good balance of sweetness made them feel both indulgent and light. We also really enjoyed the Mediterranean platter, which was full of color and texture. The grilled vegetables were charred just right, the dips were smooth and well seasoned, and the bread was warm and soft, perfect for scooping. It is the sort of plate that works for a light meal or for sharing while you sit and chat. Prices felt fair for the quality and the atmosphere, and everything arrived fresh.

Overall, this is an easy five stars from us. Shady Shack delivers on what people come to Canggu for, a beautiful space, healthy food that still feels special, and a pace that lets you relax. We would happily return for more bowls, another round of that Mediterranean platter, and a slow afternoon in the shade.

author: Sandra
review_text:
This is my go to place in canggu! I am a meat lover, but everything they have on this menu is so tasty, high protein choices and looks amazing on the plate.
Everything from smoothies, bowls, eggs, oats, coffee or pancakes! Highly recommend🫶 aways smiling staff/super friendly !

author: Michelle S
review_text:
Our favorite place to eat !!

We live here and can’t get enough of it!

The wraps are all ver good! The portions are great and everything is fresh!

You can request to have them cook in coconut oil !

Special thanks to Lia always remembered our order! Everyone here is super sweet and awesome! Remember to tip!!!

Must order
Crispy Mushroom
Vegan Boss Burrito ( so filling ) !!!
Bahn Mi Wrap
Lentil Soup ( actually big size other than many places in Canggu give you less than 250 ml 🫠)

And Their nacho hot sauce 🤍🤍🤍

author: ganzschoentutka
review_text:
We discovered this lovely vegan restaurant tucked away on a quieter street in Canggu, and it instantly became one of our favorites. The location is perfect – peaceful, beautifully maintained, and such a nice place to sit down and enjoy a meal away from the busy main roads.

The staff were extremely kind and attentive, and everything was spotlessly clean, which made the whole experience even better. We ordered the jackfruit burrito, sweet potato wedges, and a fresh salad – all of it was absolutely delicious and prepared with great quality.

The prices are on the higher side, but totally justified by the taste, freshness, and atmosphere. For anyone vegan (or simply looking for amazing plant-based food), this spot is definitely a must-do in Canggu. We can truly recommend it from the heart! 💚🌱

author: Anita Tang
review_text:
I had lunch at The Shady Shack in Canggu, Bali, a beautiful vegetarian café and bar, and it was a fantastic experience.
The Breakfast Burger was fresh, flavorful, and generously portioned, paired with a delicious homemade tomato sauce.
The Jamu Jamu was honestly the best I had in Bali — perfectly balanced with a mild, pleasant taste and none of the usual bitterness.

The staff were warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere was incredibly cozy, surrounded by lush greenery. I especially loved the relaxed couch seating, which made the whole vibe feel peaceful and chill.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a vegan-friendly restaurant in Canggu or just a relaxing spot for healthy, plant-based food in Bali.

author: Olivia Oostmeijer
review_text: Hands down my favorite restaurant in Canggu. The outdoor seating is set between the trees and is so tranquil, and their menu is fantastic, there were so many options we didn’t know what to choose. We went for the cauliflower steak, crumbed mushrooms, lasagne and fresh spring rolls - everything was 100/10. And all fully vegan. They also have a wide selection of guilt free desserts. I couldn’t recommend this spot enough 🤩🤩

author: Mariel Wilk
review_text: This place is one of the best. It was recommended multiple times to us coming to Bali and does not disappoint. Been back multiple times. I LOVE the vibe, look, feel, staff is BE-YOND lovely. All around no brainer to enjoy this nourshing place ALL AROUND! TOP notch energy! Thank you. Grateful costumer! Pictured: Friend I was with had the cauliflower dish, I have had the harvest bowl (special - with some modifications) , protein and nori (with modifications, probably the protein bowl fav so far) , extra falafel (ALL very good!) I would say the sweet potato wedges and all the different veggies etc they offer in dishes are delightful and fresh!

author: Krystalinh Magick
review_text: Overdue review!!! I have coming here since 2017, that was my 1st vegan restaurant in Canggu, still one of my favorite : lots of yummy good quality ingredients. My tops are Protein Bowl, Vegan nachos, Falafel bowl, Açaï smoothie & the choco mousse dessert is delicious😍💖✨ I always bring my friends here 🙏🏽🌸✨

author: Radu B
review_text: Everything is good here, food atmosphere all. Chill and peaceful good way to spend a nice morning ❤️

author: Athena Roos
review_text: So many vegan options and vegan treats. I’ve eaten here 4 times this week just to keep trying different things. They also have such a gorgeous atmosphere…you can’t go wrong here

author: Християна Петкова
review_text: Great lasagna and sneaker bar. Great bowls and burgers. Highly recommend. Boho style - great atmosphere.

author: Ivett Vics
review_text: Ate here twice during my stay in Canggu, both times fantastic! Tried their pulled jackfruit burger, and the cauli rice bowl.
