Lovely variety or dishes both vegan, and vegetarian and delicious drinks, ice teas, kombucha, juices, smoothies etc. The atmosphere is lovely, all tables outside in the garden under the trees - hence the name - with natural furnishings and lamps, take mosquito spray in the evening though! Serive is very fast and friendly with a smile.

author: Patricia Guerola
review_text:
I only had a drink and it was really good! I really enjoyed the atmosphere.
The food looked amazing so I can’t wait go back for brekky.
I love the location and the place itself surrounded by plants:)

author: Ppaulina Jjamroz
review_text: Very nice place  and great service, helpful people very good and tasty  food - We came here for  breakfast - large menu a lot of choices-  you can choose between sweet or not sweet breakfast, simply delicious. I can truly recommend this place and I will definitely come back here.

author: Mulan Lover
review_text:
I came back twice for this green juice.
1st try their breakfast bowl and the size is quite big.
Highly recommend!
Dining alone is also chilling!

author: Ericka Lorenzo
review_text:
I’ll start by saying the food is good, especially the pork knuckles, which were a standout. However, the service and organisation definitely need improvement.

My brother made a booking for 25 people, with pre-ordered and fully paid meals. When we arrived, we were told they couldn’t find our booking and that it was under someone else’s name, which was quite frustrating. After about 10 minutes of back and forth, they eventually realised the mistake but unfortunately, that wasn’t the end of it.

The venue is quite small for large groups (just a heads-up), and despite specifically requesting a long table, we were initially given two separate tables upstairs. This defeats the purpose of booking in advance so arrangements can be made properly. Eventually, they set up a table outside on the balcony, which actually worked out well. Once settled, the food was tasty, the service improved, and the staff were pleasant enough.

One important safety note: there is only one unisex toilet, located downstairs. This can be challenging, especially for senior citizens or anyone with mobility issues, as the stairs may pose a risk.

Overall, good food, but better organisation and planning for large groups would greatly improve the experience.

author: Patrick Wass
review_text: If you’re looking for some nice porkmeals than you don’t really need to look any further. We tried the ribs, fried pork belly (seemed like what I refer to fried bacon, yet surprisingly ”fresh” for being fried fat) fried pork roast (this was to me more like classic pork belly), skewers, grilled corncobs, mashed potatoes and some greens (lawar kacang, recommend!!). Everything was REALLY GOOD, couldn’t complain absolut anything. The sides as well, totally awesome place, kinda fast food atmosphere rather than a finer restaurant but trust me you go here to get greasy!

author: Jolene Ng
review_text: Absolutely tasty, flavorful food. The spare ribs are tender and juicy. The roasted pork leg with crispy skin and tender meat is amazing. Nice view from the balcony to enjoy sunset and the local dance and music. Friendly staffs, they all can speak English too.

author: Jehna Liddle
review_text: Amazing Pork Ribs for amazing price! Could never find something like this in Australia, so we went twice! Beautiful food in a lovely complex! Pork is very special in Bali so they do it incredibly well. Ice cream next door was fantastic too!

author: Joyce
review_text: Had the pork ribs at Wahaha — the portion was huge.The meat was super tender and not dry at all. Came with fries or rice and some veggies, so I was really full. The sauce was sweet and savory, really good😋

author: Jonathan Goh
review_text:
Ordered sate, beef soup, mint juice and small pork ribs.
To keep the story short, sate is alright. Marinate is slightly spicy, meat portion is small. There was no bbq taste.
Pork ribs are nice. Good marinate. Very appetising and meat falls off the bone. Worth ordering.
Beef soup is disappointing. Hardly any meat in the soup. Soup itself is good albeit salty. For the price, better choices elsewhere.

author: Zachary Chan
review_text:
The service and atmosphere are quite good, and there's a traditional dance performance with audience interaction.
Unfortunately, the food isn't very tasty. The beef short ribs weren't tender enough, and the beef was too dry (it should have been prepared using a slow-cooking method / sous-vide).

author: A G (Pourover Traveller)
review_text:
Review of Wahaha Pork Ribs Jimbaran: A Reliable Dining Option

Wahaha Pork Ribs in Jimbaran is a solid choice for anyone craving delicious ribs in Bali. As part of a well-known chain, the quality remains consistent across locations, and the menu is refreshingly simple, focusing on what they do best.

The pork ribs are definitely the signature dish, and while they were tasty, I found them not quite as tender as those from Nuri's. However, they still delivered on flavor and were enjoyable. The fried rice didn’t impress me as much, and I found it to be a bit lackluster compared to other offerings.

On the brighter side, the grilled corn was delightful, though I wished it had been grilled a bit longer for an extra depth of flavor.

Service at Wahaha is commendable—friendly and attentive, adding to the overall pleasant dining experience.

Overall, Wahaha Pork Ribs Jimbaran is a nice spot to enjoy good food in a relaxed setting. While there are a few areas for improvement, it’s worth a visit for the ribs and welcoming atmosphere!

author: Brendan
review_text:
Came here for lunch and I thought that while the food was not bad, it was not especially special. The ribs were soft and meaty but flavour wise it was a normal bbq pork rib.

Food also came out lukewarm. Overall an okay experience.

author: Andrew SP
review_text: Ribs dry and not as easily pulled as it used to be. Lacking taste as well. Was definitely expecting a lot better. Service was good, but we came for the food. Pork knuckle also tastes quite bland, although the skin was still quite crackly.

author: Petter Hawk
review_text:
The restaurant very busy, service was fast and engaging, and one of the male staff members was very helpful in finding a taxi back to the hotel.

Overall: The food and service were excellent.
I will be back👍👍

author: Patricia
review_text: One of the mus to go place for pork ribs in bali. Love this location quiet comfy and cozy. Portion is nice, the ribs and crispy pork is very good 🫶🏼🙏🏻

author: Carpe Diem Pirate
review_text: This restaurant feels like a victim of its own hype. The food? Meh—some dishes were overcooked like they took a nap in the oven. The ribs looked promising with that glossy sauce on top (delicious!), but once you dig in… it’s basically Costco ribs in disguise. You’re paying for the marketing, not the magic.

author: Karina Adianto
review_text:
Wahaha jimbaran
We were seated on the outdoor area. It was a comfortable breezy spot.

We ordered:
Corn bbq
Corn cheese
French fries
Mashed potatoes
Colesaw 👍
Carbonara
Pork knuckle 👍
Roast pork belly 👍
Wahaha Pork ribs large 👍
Draft beers

Wahaha is one of the best pork ribs restaurant in Bali. All the pork were juicy, flavorful and tasty.

author: Natchonlathon Kodsup
review_text: Love this place! The ribs is amazing, don’t even have to use knife. The side is delicious also the soup (sorry no photo!). The staffs is so friendly and very attentive. Food is a bit slow but acceptable. Very good location and nice atmosphere. We were so happy to travel this far for this. Recommend!

author: Foodieextreme Foodieextreme
review_text:
Bali was our third port stop on a 28 day Asia cruise and we were lucky to have an overnight stay here. On our first day we hired a private tour guide through a tour company but sadly he wasn’t willing to take us where we wanted to go. I had hoped to bring my little daughters to the beach but after over four hours of driving he brought us to a beach restaurant in the dark. Disappointed we canceled our second day with that company and decided to take a chance with a driver from the port.

That’s how we met Kadek Agus, an older gentleman who was incredibly kind, patient and sincere. I told him how much I had wanted to try Bali’s famous suckling pig, something I’d seen on Mark Wiens’ food videos. I had mentioned this to our guide the day before while we were in Ubud but perhaps because he was Muslim he steered us away and said it was too far or not available. I had tucked that food wish away thinking it just wasn’t going to happen.

When I told Kadek Agus about it he said with such honesty that yes the suckling pig was indeed in Ubud, where we had just been yesterday, and now it was too far since the ship was leaving later that day. I was disappointed but I really appreciated his transparency and effort. He took us to another place that served pork but unfortunately the satay was too spicy for my little girls and they weren’t able to adjust it.

As we were driving again I spotted Wahaha Pork Ribs in Jimbaran and asked if we could stop. It ended up being the perfect decision. While I had hoped for more traditional Balinese food sometimes moms have to adjust and this was just what our family needed.

The staff were incredibly welcoming. When they saw my daughters getting bitten by mosquitoes the hostess kindly offered us bug spray to keep them comfortable. Service was fast helpful and kind throughout.

We ordered the pork ribs for the kids and the pork knuckle for ourselves. The knuckle was huge and carved tableside, crispy juicy and hands down the best pork knuckle I’ve ever had. My husband was happy to discover they were offering a buy one get one free caipirinha special which was a fun bonus.

Wahaha really delivered on flavor service and comfort. It turned out to be a highlight of our Bali stop and we’re so grateful to Kadek Agus for his thoughtfulness and care. Highly recommend both the restaurant and this wonderful driver if you ever find yourself arriving by cruise in Bali.

author: Katarzyna Jaworska
review_text: Nice place with good food. The ribs were a bit on the lean side – I personally prefer them fattier – but the crispy bacon was absolutely delicious and definitely a must-try! The presentation of the dishes was just okay. we didnt have to wait for the table- coz they have upstairs which was all empty

author: TEULIE Xavière
review_text: Perfect experience from start to finish! The ribs were the best I’ve ever had, and the staff were incredibly kind and welcoming. Highly recommend!

author: Aneesh Vaghadia
review_text:
The signature BBQ pork ribs are indeed worth the visit! They’re delicious, fall off the bone, and don’t have the overwhelming smokiness that many US rib places have. The other food options we had were great — the pulled pork burger was tender, perfectly cooked and had a toasted bun.

The service was excellent. The servers were able to tell us what dishes had nuts and which didn’t for those with allergies in our party. They split the corn into four pieces to make it easier to share and were able to make the nasi goreng vegetarian to accommodate dietary preferences as well.

The restaurant is a two storey location with options for outsider seating on their balcony. The atmosphere is relaxing and there are sometimes shows with traditional Balinese dancing outside that you can see from the balcony.

Overall, would recommend as a place to eat dinner if you’re in the area!

author: Yerai P
review_text: We really enjoyed having dinner at Wahahas! Pork ribs were amazing. Also the service was really great. Our waitress Desi was the best! I fully recommend eating here.

author: alana dimitrioski
review_text:
Kilo Kitchen is an excellent restaurant for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The food is consistently delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavor at every meal. Breakfast offers a great variety, lunch is fresh and satisfying, and dinner is exceptional and memorable.
What truly sets Kilo Kitchen apart is the amazing staff. They are incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely go above and beyond to ensure a fantastic dining experience. Their warm and professional service makes you feel welcome every time.
Highly recommended for great food and outstanding service!

author: Felicia
review_text:
All I can say is wow! I was nearly put off that the place didn't seem very busy but I think people are missing out on this hidden gem. They accommodated all 10 of us as a walk in and the service was amazing.

The stand out dish for the night for me was the octopus a la plancha - generous tender pieces of octopus on a bed of rich truffled potato puree. The octopus still had a bite to it but melted in the mouth while the mash rounds off the bite with a luxurious silky finish.

The squid ink rice was also another stand out dish. Crispy baby squid with flavour explosions from the salmon roe. Other delectable dishes we tried include seafood cevice, crispy eggplant, gnocchi, bbq pork ribs, ebiko pasta, beef cheek - all of which we very good.

It was also Taco Tuesday so we tried the beef tounge tacos (which seemed average in comparison to all the other amazing dishes above that I couldn't fault). The margaritas were also strong, with the Black Mamba being the dark horse of balance of tang, sweet and sour.

Whilst the prices may be on the higher end, the quality and quantity of the food exceeds it. We are already planning to be back at the restaurant before the end of the trip!

author: Siyu Miao
review_text: Highly recommended, from service to the food. Everything is very good! Pork rib, beef tongue tacos and roasted chicken are very delicious. All staff are very friendly and polite. This restaurant really surprised me a lot in Bali 🥰

author: Kenny Yap
review_text: Lovely quiet ambience at night, wanted to head there for drinks and dessert but the chocolate ganache I wanted was not available so I ended up having an excellent green smoothie.

author: Natalie Teo
review_text:
Always an enjoyable experience at Kilo’s! First time tried this branch and it became my most preferred branch 😆 ambience, food, cocktails were awesome.
Staffs were nice to throw in a complimentary birthday desert for my best friend!

author: Ariel Yeo Pek Wei
review_text: Had a very lovely dining experience here and was served by Arif! Exceptional service by the staff and the food was great as well.

author: Arif Budiman
review_text:
Great place to have group meal

Went here for lunch today and i think the food was okay. Some of the dishes was under seasoned and the cooking time was a bit long.

Overall great experience.

author: Sergey Voyt
review_text:
I was here already more than five times.
Always perfect, very friendly and helpful service. Food is just amazing! Best corn furikake and pork ribs I’ve tried so far.
It one of my favorite places for dinner in and around of Canggu.
Thank you guys!

author: Yasmin Leong
review_text: our server, arif, was very helpful and recommended the coconut dessert which was delish! there’s a warm feel to the restaurant, although a little dark. food portions were perfect for sharing and really good!

author: Jo-Lynn Wee
review_text:
Had a lovely lunch experience at Kilo.

Best ceviche I’ve had in Canggu.
The pasta dishes were delicious and the presentation was great.

Bobby whipped up great cocktail too.
Thanks for the great service, Arif.

They are currently running a food promotion on Mondays. Do check them out.

author: YY
review_text:
Amazing first dinner here in Bali, as recommended by our friend who came by 💯

🦀 crab croquette was probably the only okay dish we had, the pepper sauce that came with it gave it a good flavour though

🐙 octopus was great, recommended by the waitress and was one of the best dish unanimously 👍🏻

🦑 the squid ink rice with calamari was hands down the highlight of the show, very flavourful squid ink rice paired with a generous portion of calamari! This is truly one to return for whenever we are here! 💯

🐠 the grilled market fish tonight was a barramundi, and we were shocked as to how generous once again the portion was - fresh and thick and huge 🤤

🦐 the shrimp ravioli was okay, an average dish and probably wasn’t really worth the price

Ginger beer was good though, but not so much for the aqua which costed us 70,000IDR.

Overall a really good dinner spot, and one that we would highly recommend and probably even return within the next few days of our trip!

author: Daphne Potters
review_text: Absolutely loved our visit to Kilo! The food was fresh and full of flavor, clearly prepared with care. The service was outstanding friendly, attentive, and fast. You really feel welcome here. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys great food and excellent hospitality!

author: Mohammed Alshammari
review_text: We can’t wait until you open in Saudi Arabia this year; delicious food, great service and amazing atmosphere. Let me know about opening date in Jeddah and I’ll there for sure ♥️

author: Poh Zhi Nan
review_text:
Still so good as ever. Came on the night after the Bali blackout to celebrate myself for surviving 6 hours of no electricity haha. Reached around 10+pm and just in time for kitchen’s last order. I really appreciate the staff being accommodating and welcoming. The pork ribs with nacho potatoes were flavourful, juicy, tender - really hit the mark. Cocktail recommended by server was on a refreshing but subtly sweet palate, which perfectly balanced out the flavoured dishes. Ending off the night with a dark chocolate cremeux which I didn’t know what to expect, but it was certainly a sweet finish. However, I felt this dessert can be skipped as it is nothing spectacular.

Overall, Kilo is always a top and safe choice for brunch or dinner in Bali. Highly recommended!

author: Anthony A
review_text: We had a wonderful evening at Kilo. I ordered the ravioli and my partner had the gnocchi. Both dishes were absolutely delicious and tasted incredibly fresh. The staff were warm, friendly and attentive, which really elevated the whole experience. They helped create a special evening from start to finish. Highly recommend.

author: A P
review_text: Been here couple time the food was phenomenal. Everything was so good, the slow cooked beef cheek just melted in your mouth. The lamb shank, the tagliatele beef rendang everything was so good and not to mention the staff as well trained and attentive. Definately our favorite place for a date night.

author: Taylan Alpan
review_text: We tried Kilo Kitchen for thé first time this evening and were thoroughly impressed with all the food. The squid ink rice and the lamb shank were definitely the standouts for us. The atmosphere is perfect for a romantic date night and the staff are all super friendly. I would highly recommend Kilo Kitchen and will certainly be back here soon.

author: Kiara Chern
review_text: Best dinner restaurant that I’ve been to in Bali in the Canggu area! The exterior and vibes were perfect, food was good and service staff were all friendly. Absolutely loved their mains and highly recommend the squid ink rice and the laksa.

author: Taylor B
review_text: Food is decent here. Nothing super memorable but it's a decent restaurant along this strip. I do love the atmosphere and the interior. It's a really nice place to chill during the day and to dine at night. Their ginger beer is really good (when they make it really gingery)

author: Stewart Shuker
review_text: Lisna, our waitress was delightful, as was the food and drinks.  We kept it light with the corn.  Wow, just wow.  The first bite I was won over.  I can’t start to do it justice in a description, but it was Smokey and totally beautiful.  We had the house made ginger beer and it had so much flavor!!   The ambiance was great and the service really stood out, and that’s not easy in Bali as you know.

author: Brittany Baart
review_text: To say wow would be an understatement for how amazing Sun Sun Warung was. This was our first time trying Indonesian food being Australians, and first time at a Warang, It exceeded all expectations. We were met by someone that greeted us warmly and we waited in line to be seated (It was very popular and loved, hence the line). We then had the wonderful Lily help us pick items off the menu to eat as we had no idea where to start. We end up getting a tasting platter and some other dishes on the side. The food was INCREDIBLE! So full of flavour and fresh. We loved it so much we are going again for the second night in a row. Do yourself a favour and go have a great meal at Sun Sun Warung!

author: Jolin Min Min
review_text:
Ayam Bakar is very fragrant and tender. Veggies served together is nice too, look like mayonnaise seasoning but don’t taste like mayonnaise, quite nice to keep eating.

Sate Pitu is so nice, we order 2 more sets of 7 pieces because the ala carte only 4 pieces, not enough to share around.

Mie Goreng Ayam comes with 2 chicken satay. Noodles are quite tasty.

Ayam Goreng Asam Manis is fried chicken with something like sweet and sour sauce. But it’s more towards sweet than sour.

Definitely worth to come and enjoy nice food.

author: Victor Leung
review_text:
I recently dined at this traditional Balinese restaurant, and I had a wonderful experience! The location is very convenient and easy to find, although I noticed there wasn’t a suitable place to park motorcycles, which could be a bit challenging.

The quality of the food was outstanding; each dish was flavorful and authentic, showcasing the best of Balinese cuisine. The decor of the restaurant adds to its charm, with beautiful traditional elements that create a warm and inviting atmosphere.

I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking to enjoy delicious Balinese dishes in a lovely setting. I can't wait to return!

author: Vanessa Huynh
review_text: Absolutely love this Warung! I cannot recommend this place enough. It quickly became my comfort spot and I visited several times. The food is absolutely delicious, with a wide variety to choose from and it always looked so beautiful. The service was always warm, welcoming and kind. This place was good for the tummy, but also for the soul! I loved the Nasi Campur and also the duck - best duck ever!! and the desserts were also veryyy good! Suksma.

author: Iustin Raducanu
review_text:
Delicious local food in a traditional setting. Service is more than excellent and prices are very reasonable for the area.

Heard that this place can get very busy throughout the summer, however we got a table with minimal wait (in December). Note that their last order is at 9.15pm.

author: Irina Otto
review_text: After a year, I came back again—just as enthusiastic as last time. The value for money is just as good. Everything is fresh, delicious, and authentic. Genuine Balinese cuisine with all its special touches! Absolutely worth trying!

author: Lis Conde
review_text: Highly recommended. Best food we had in Bali at really affordable prices. The ambience is the place is exactly what you would imagine Bali to be. I had the Nasi campur and loved the fact that it had a little bite of everything! My husband had the duck with bbq sauce and he literally wanted to lick the plate. This place is awesome.

author: Matthew Gormley
review_text: The food was absolutely amazing! True traditional Balinese cuisine with an amazing atmosphere and brilliant service who are so welcoming and kind. Lili our waitress was incredible, kind, friendly and had amazing knowledge of bali and the restaurants cuisine for recommendations! I wouldn’t go to bali without coming here! 100/10

author: Willyan Aleksander
review_text:
Absolutely loved Sun Sun Warung!

This was, without a doubt, one of the best dining experiences we had in Ubud - and definitely the best value for money.

A special thanks to Santika, who took care of us with so much patience and kindness. She explained every dish in detail, helped my friend choose great vegetarian options, and made the whole experience feel genuinely warm and welcoming.

The food was outstanding. My friend's vegetarian dishes were full of flavor, and my Bebek Goreng (crispy duck) was simply perfect - super crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. As someone who loves duck, this was easily one of the best I've ever had in this trip.

This place was recommended to me 2y ago and reached all the expectations, and now I'm happily recommending it to everyone.

If you want authentic Indonesian food in Ubud, Sun Sun Warung is a must-try.

author: Milena
review_text:
We had such a wonderful experience at Sun Sun Warung! The food was incredibly delicious — every dish was full of flavor and clearly made with love and fresh ingredients.

The staff were so friendly and welcoming, always smiling and making sure we had everything we needed. The atmosphere is really lovely too – cozy, relaxed, and with a beautiful Balinese touch that makes you feel right at home.

We had to wait around 15 minutes for a table because the restaurant was quite busy, but it was absolutely worth it. If you don’t like waiting, I’d recommend making a reservation in advance. The prices are unbelievably good for the quality you get – honestly, the food could easily cost much more.

Overall, we couldn’t have been happier. Great food, wonderful people, and a beautiful place – a must-visit in Bali!

author: Robert Cruz
review_text: The food, service and atmosphere was everything we could have hoped for in experiencing Bali and Balinesian cuisine. Sun Sun Warung is a hidden gem. Unassuming from the exterior but the setting was a quiet haven. Our server, Lili, couldn’t be more helpful, made us feel welcomed and at home here. This is my wife’s and my favorite dinner spot in Ubud.  Thank you, Lili, and Sun Sun Warung for making our first, and repeated, dining experience the best in Ubud!!!

author: Leanne Pais
review_text: An absolutely beautiful place with amazing food and good service. It was a feat to get a table and after 3 attempts I finally got a table for lunch :) and it was well worth it! The grill duck was tender, juicy and filled with flavour. Highly recommend it! Will definitely go back when I'm in ubud next :) it is entirely worth the hype.

author: Yashita Vashishth
review_text: We had a wonderful experience trying out authentic Balinese cuisine at Sun Sun Warung. The flavours were impeccable! And Febri helped us understand the dishes and provided seamless assistance throughout! Will definitely come back 😊

author: 王迪雅
review_text: The food was okay — for my taste, it wasn’t bad but not particularly delicious either. My boyfriend actually quite liked it. Two of the dishes came out a bit cold, and I personally prefer my food to be hot. The crispy duck with rice was served hot though.

author: angelica uto
review_text: The whole restaurant from start to finish is an incredible place. Our server Juli was attentive and kind and the food was delicious and generous servings. Some of the best food I have enjoyed in Ubud, Bali. The atmosphere is breathtaking. It’s not just a restaurant but an experience not to be missed.

author: Angelica Pabon
review_text: The food here is absolutely spectacular, and the place feels so authentic! If you want to try the best cuisine in Bali, this is the spot. The staff are all incredibly kind, but a special shoutout to Yumi, who attended me. She went above and beyond, giving me hotel recommendations and tips on things to do – honestly, 20/10 service! I can’t thank her enough. I highly recommend Sun Sun Warung to anyone visiting Bali.

author: Gourmet Rara
review_text:
Sun Sun Warung in Ubud is the perfect spot to enjoy authentic Balinese food at great prices. The flavors are fresh, the portions are generous, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. The staff are so kind and make you feel at home, which really adds to the experience.

If you’re looking for local Balinese cuisine in Ubud or just a cozy place to eat while exploring Bali, this warung is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone wanting a true taste of Ubud!

author: Mita Paul
review_text: Our experience on 21dec2025 lunch . During the lunch, We asked for a plate & what was brought by the server was a broken chipped on the edges plate, which ideally should be thrown or discarded Then the server very curtly asked is that enough? As if to say , she’s doing a huge favour & its such a inconvenience that we asked for a plate . We have been to many many places during our two weeks stay in ubud , NOPLACE has been brusque/ rude . Appeasement in the form of bill on the house came & a package of cookies which I vehemently objected. Bottom line ,is its not all about the food its about the experience . Sun sun warung needs to train its staff , after all they are in the hospitality business . We wouldn’t like to go back .

author: Monica Tudor
review_text: Sun Sun exceeded my expectations! The grilled duck was juicy with perfectly crisp skin, and the coconut pancakes were heavenly. Friendly service and a relaxed vibe. Highly recommend!

author: Bianca Alina Mitrea
review_text:
Absolutely amazing place to eat in Bali – a true gem!

We loved Sun Sun Warung so much, we came back multiple times because it was just that amazing the entire experience!
The food was absolutely delicious every single time, fresh, flavorful, and made with love.
The place is beautiful and traditional, with that authentic Balinese charm. 🫶🏼 The staff are incredibly kind, welcoming you with that big smile and the prices are unbelievably low for the quality you get.
After discovering Sun Sun, we compared every other restaurant in Bali to it… and few places came close.
If you're in Ubud, do not miss this place. Sun Sun Warung is a treasure, we’ll be dreaming of their meals until we can come back. 🙌🍛🌿

author: Federica Caldini
review_text:
We had dinner at Malam, a fusion restaurant with Japanese influences, and it was a fantastic experience.
The dishes are full of flavor, beautifully balanced, and never too heavy.
I started with a salad because I was craving something fresh — simple, but extremely good, one of those dishes that show how well simplicity can be done. I then had the salmon clay pot, which was delicious.
Dessert was a highlight: I had the pistachio and raspberry dessert, and it was really, really good. As a nice extra, we were also offered a local frozen mandarin to cleanse the palate — refreshing and absolutely delicious — highly recommended.

author: Diamond Path
review_text:
Gorgeous food and an overall wonderful experience! The lamb kebabs tasted amazing and so did the grilled fish! The ube drink was gorgeous and my mom liked her prosecco… the interiors are warm and clean everything was good. Only point I would improve would be to try and ask guests what they think of the dishes after service. It tends to get intrusive when you are chewing or chatting with someone over dinner and someone in service interrupts to ask how everything is. Perhaps allow for a survey at the end of the meal and only ask once (I was asked three times by different people and we only ordered two meals!) also use metal straws or something durable because the paper straws dissolve and become mushy which is not a pleasurable experience…
Overall though we had a fabulous time and will be back! The food was amazing we had to restrain ourselves from licking the plate! ;o)

Ate here a second time I had the steak and mum had the ramen both tasted really good! Happy we chose this for our last dinner in Ubud (for this trip anyway!)

author: Marinda N
review_text:
Highly recommend this place!
This was such a nice place with a super friendly staff. And the food! The food was amazing. The starters bone marrow, tuna and feta dip were rich in flavour and tasted amazing. The same for the main dishes rendang, salmon claypot and the steak. But don’t leave without a dessert! The raspberry pistachio tart was delicious but the cheesecake was the best cheesecake we ever had! A real experience. Plus we even got an extra lemon dessert and had a delicious chocolate ball.   Thank you!

author: Андрей Жуков
review_text: Really good food, everything I tried tasted great. The raspberry and pistachio dessert was the highlight for me and it was so good. I loved the atmosphere, very cozy, and you can tell a lot of thought went into every little detail. I would definitely come back

author: Boo Hock Khoo
review_text:
ENAK SEKALI!!!
The restaurant to go to in Ubud if you want superb food and a great dinner experience.  We ate 7 dishes in 22 mins - every one yummy.  Cocktails are great too.  Congrats Chef Pavel! Thanks for coming over to chat.

author: Anna Lutaeva
review_text:
We stumbled upon Malam and instantly fell in love! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff make you feel not just like a guest, but like a long-awaited friend.

The food was absolutely outstanding. We tried the bone marrow, octopus, vitello tonnato, and kebab every dish was a true revelation. The balance of flavors, presentation, and attention to detail were simply perfect. The cocktails were also a delightful surprise stylish, refreshing, and very well crafted.

But what impressed us most was the service. The team really listens, cares, and makes sure your evening is unforgettable. We didn’t want to leave, and we’re already dreaming of coming back!

author: Claire Wells
review_text:
We stumbled upon Malam while wandering around last night looking for somewhere special for dinner, and it turned out to be such a gem. The venue itself is stunning, with an atmosphere that feels both elegant and welcoming. The menu offered so many fantastic choices, truly fine dining with the most incredible flavour profiles.

Our standout dish of the night was the tempura prawns, wow!  Perfectly crisp, and the sauce had such a deep umami flavour that made it unforgettable.

The cocktails were another highlight. Each one was so creative and unique, yet absolutely delicious and paired beautifully with the dishes.

Service was exceptional from start to finish. Attentive, warm, and genuinely friendly. The staff clearly love what they do, and it shines through.

We can’t recommend Malam enough. It’s absolutely one of our new favourite restaurants, and it’s already on our list for the next time we’re in Ubud.

author: Andrew Hudson
review_text:
Worst Rendang we ever had in Bali!

My wife had the Barramundi which was good.
I had the Beef Rendang which was by far the worst we ever tasted anywhere in Bali! See photo - doesn't even look like Rendang. Just a small bowl of very fatty meat cooked in coconut cream (completely different to the 1 they show on the menu)! Doesn't have any spice / Rendang flavor. I think they desperately need a chef that understands the local dishes / flavors.
We had a could of other dishes which were very average.
Restaurant is extremely overpriced and then there is an additional 17% added (tax & service charge).
We came here because of the reviews. However, after eating here, I have serious concerns about how many of these are actually real reviews!
With so many other great restaurants nearby with far better quality food and at a fraction of the price, I would highly recommend avoiding this place!

author: Alexander Herrschfeld
review_text: If you are looking for a spot in Uluwatu to enjoy a drink while watching the sun dip below the horizon, Malini Uluwatu is a solid choice. The absolute highlight of this location is the view. Perched on the cliffs, it offers a breathtaking, unobstructed panorama of the Ocean that is hard to beat, especially during the golden hour. Regarding the food, it was okay but nothing particularly special. The food didn't quite stand out compared to other dining options in the area. It’s perfectly fine for a casual meal, but don't expect a high end culinary experience. The service, however, was a bright spot. The staff members are incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help with a smile, which adds a nice touch to the atmosphere. One thing to note is that the facilities feel a bit dated. The venue is showing its age and could definitely benefit from some maintenance.

author: Fitri Nasaruddin
review_text:
Came here for lunch and while the place itself could use some improvement in terms of condition, the view and food completely stole the show.

The view is absolutely spectacular, breathtaking, mind blowing and honestly beyond words. It’s one of those views that instantly elevates the entire experience and makes you forget everything else.

For food, I had the seafood spaghetti in white sauce, a mango smoothie, and finished with chocolate brownies. Everything was delicious, but the brownies truly stood out, soft, tender and served with vanilla ice cream, making it the perfect way to end the meal.

Despite the condition of the place, the view and food make it worth visiting, especially if you are looking for an unforgettable cliffside dining experience.

author: Darsshan Parmar
review_text:
Malini Seafood & Sunset is an excellent place for sunset views and seafood dining. The location is absolutely stunning (5/5), especially if you manage to get an ocean-view table—highly recommended to book in advance for that experience.

The food quality is good (4/5), with fresh seafood and well-prepared dishes. We walked in without a reservation and had a 15–20 minute wait, but were seated without an ocean view.

They accept cards, which is convenient, and parking is available, making the visit hassle-free.

Overall, a great spot for sunset lovers, couples, and anyone looking to enjoy a relaxed seafood meal with a beautiful Bali backdrop 🌅

author: Iniyazh
review_text:
The food is more pleasing for western and not very authentic. I celebrated my birthday here, and the staff were really, really friendly and nice Their hospitality truly stood out.

We went for dinner, so unfortunately we missed the sunset. Honestly, this place is not about the food. You're paying for the view and the overall experience.

The hospitality and the stunning cliffside view are what make it worth the price, not the food itself. If you're coming, come for the atmosphere and scenery.

author: Rai Akash Santosh
review_text: No wonder this is such a highly sought destination for tourists. Perched on the cliffside, this stunning restaurant offers breathtaking panoramic views that create the perfect romantic setting for couples, families and friends. The spacious outdoor seating allows you to enjoy the spectacular sunset while indulging in delicious seafood dishes. The friendly and attentive staff make the experience even more memorable, ensuring every detail is taken care of. Whether you're here for the view, the atmosphere, or the fresh seafood, Malini Uluwatu is an absolute must-visit for a truly unforgettable dining experience in Bali.

author: Robert Arzate
review_text:
The staff were very friendly and attentive to our requests. When I order a wine it turned (tasted like vinegar). When I informed the staff they didn’t understand but after talking they were caring and replaced my wine with a new glass of a new bottle.

The views from the deck are great! Best views for a nice sunset or just watching the waves crack against the rocks. Unfortunately the food is not as great as the views. I ordered the surf and turf which equated to three medium shrimps and a very chewy steak with brown gravy on the bottom. I asked for medium rare and some of the steak was but it was very very chewy and the texture was very off.

author: santosh kumar
review_text: Did visit this place during our visit to Bali. It’s very close to Uluwatu temple around 500mtrs. If you visit this temple you should visit this place for dinner or sunset time. It’s situated on the cliff with the sea 🌊 view. Open area seating facing the sea would be ideal for an early evening. Wonderful scenic location with the cliff and sea view. Prior booking is suggested to visit this place. Inside seating is there too apart from the seating with the sea view. Rest rooms are clean and tidy. Staff are courteous and helpful in    suggesting what to order. Had ordered calamari, chicken grill with rice, prawns , tuna fry with veggies, cocktails. Food is pricy and decent quantity. Roughly spent around Rp 550K per person for couple of starters, main course , few beers and cocktail. Must try especially for couple for a romantic dining during the sun set. Overall a nice dining experience.

author: Joan Ng
review_text:
We had an ocean-view table facing the sea and it was really relaxing! Loved the breeze and the whole vibe – very chill and great for sunset. Food was not bad too.

Because we were seated near the rock side, there were quite a lot of ants and flies around the table, so just take note if you’re sensitive to that.

Service during dinner was okay, but after we finished, it suddenly started to rain heavily. The staff did come out with umbrellas, but it didn’t feel very helpful or friendly when trying to guide customers out or get to the car. The umbrella is for themselves to use 🥲

Overall, still a beautiful spot with a lovely sea view and wind – but a little room to improve on the service especially during rain. ✨

author: Diana Anghelus
review_text: I had this restaurant on my list and without even knowing we got there after visiting the Uluwatu Temple. It's literally around the corner, however , it's a good kilometer going up, so better take a taxi. It was dark outside when we got there and we could not see much . We didn't have a reservation , however, they were so nice and able to get us in, as the place it's pretty big. We got sat by the cliff, luckily, as least we could hear the waves and see if at nigh . Food was a lot and it came pretty quick . Price was decent for the location, not very expensive. You can take pics by the famous heart but make a reservation for a premium table.

author: Sofia K
review_text: We had lunch here and it turned out to be such a lovely experience from start to finish. The location is absolutely breathtaking, sitting right on the edge of the cliff with a wide open ocean view that feels peaceful, dramatic, and incredibly beautiful. It’s the kind of scenery that immediately puts you in a relaxed mood and makes the meal feel extra special. We didn’t have a booking, but it wasn’t busy at the time, so we were able to walk straight in, choose a table with a nice view, and order right away without any waiting at all. We decided to have the grilled fish, and it was honestly delicious. The fish was grilled perfectly crispy and slightly smoky on the outside, yet soft, juicy, and tender inside. You can really taste the freshness. The Balinese sauces that came with it were full of flavor, aromatic, and added that authentic local touch that made the dish even more enjoyable. It was served with steamed rice and vegetables, creating a simple but very satisfying and balanced meal. The atmosphere was calm, breezy, and very open, making it a perfect spot to enjoy seafood while taking in the stunning coastal scenery. If you love beautiful views and tasty, freshly grilled food, this place is worth a visit.

author: Life’s a journey
review_text:
We were walk in customer, we didn’t reserve a table but luckily there was a table available. If you wish you have a nice table with good view, we recommend you to reserve in advance. After we finish our food we asked staff to move to nicer table for drink which they agree to move us.

Food was simple and fresh seafood. We ordered mixed seafood and fish steak. They both tasted good.

One thing wasn’t restaurant fault is lot of people nowadays  just love to take photos and selfies which disturb other customer sometimes. But the view is stunning.

author: Amelia Lam
review_text:
The hype for this place is average, it doesn’t fully look like the instagram videos or reels that you see but it’s still super nice and unique with a great sunset view. We made reservations in advance for a sunset view and had a table at the edge. There were two super romantic spots for couples which one was celebrating an anniversary and another was a proposal which was beautiful!

The staff are friendly, our server was so nice and the food was good. Certainly over priced for the location and seafood heavy so don’t come here if you don’t like seafood!

There are a lot of monkeys in the area so keep your items close to you. I would recommend a few other spots to check out for food like El Kabron or the cave.

author: Payman Parseyan
review_text:
Food was horrible. Service was horrible, views were incredible.

We tried the snapper, the grouper and the seafood platter. We’ve had some good food and bad food from many coastal places in the world. This was among the worst food we’ve ever had and that’s saying something.

The server we got was horrible. Stood by us as she handed the menu and asked what we’d like. I thought she was trying to be funny as obviously haven’t even seen the menu yet. We asked her to give us a minute to look it over. She came by 20 minutes later and we ordered. The food came out promptly but that was that. No follow up to refill drinks, i took the plates over to the counter after 60-70 minutes to clear up the table top and then got up and found to server to ask for a menu to order dessert. We sat there for 45 minutes and no one came to ask so I got up again, found the server, and asked for the bill. They brought it promptly and I paid.

The views are incredible. The further in you go, the nicer the cliff side seats get. We had “table 17” which was supposed to be best cliff side seat after the honeymoon table.

With that said, do with that, what you will.

author: Carlota Aguiar
review_text:
Food was insanely good, super fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. And the views? UNREAL. Watching the sunset from there is just magical, the whole sky turns golden and the place becomes even more stunning.

If you want a perfect table with those cliffside sunset views, reservations are a must. Like seriously, book ahead or you’ll miss the best spots.

Everything from the ambiance to the service to the food made this one of our favourite dining experiences in Bali. Absolutely worth it!

author: Nasira Aziz
review_text:
Malini Uluwatu is all about the view — and yes, the view is absolutely stunning. The restaurant sits right on the cliff, and the seaside scenery is truly beautiful and dramatic. Unfortunately, that’s where the positives mostly end.

We reserved a table in advance, which is the only reason we got a direct seaside view. If you don’t reserve, you’ll most likely be seated in the back with no real view at all. Even after mentioning that we were celebrating a special occasion, we were still seated at a regular counter-style table, right next to other guests, instead of a private or special spot.

The food was very disappointing.
The portion sizes are a joke. I received a tiny portion of pasta that didn’t taste good at all. My husband ordered the aglio e olio seafood pasta, and there were exactly three shrimp on the entire plate. For a seafood restaurant at this price point, that’s unacceptable.

On top of that, there are very few vegetarian options — basically none. If you don’t eat seafood or meat, your choices are extremely limited.

The seating is uncomfortable:
• Hard, uncomfortable chairs
• Very little space — your knees are literally against the wall
• Not a place to sit and enjoy a relaxed meal

Overall, Malini is only worth visiting for the view. The food is bland and uninspired, the portions are far too small, and the comfort level is low.

If you’re looking for a special table (anniversary, engagement, birthday, etc.), you need to very clearly and repeatedly communicate this in advance — and even then, there’s no guarantee you’ll get it.

Personally, I would not recommend this restaurant unless you’re only coming for the scenery and photos. For good food, comfort, and value, there are much better options in Uluwatu.

author: Mary Grace Cruz
review_text: We reserved atleast 3 days in advance & we were informed that only 2nd row seats were available. Me & my husband decided to stay longer to enjoy the place & when there’s available seats at the 1st row they gladly transferred us to nice seats with ocean view. Remember to place a reservation few weeks before so u can get best seats. We had good experience all in all at Malini Uluwatu, though the seafood platter are just average in terms of taste. Staff are very friendly & accommodating. Shoutout to Ella & to other staff  who patiently took our photos.

author: Muhammad Fakhrullah Nor Azmin
review_text:
Had our honeymoon dinner at Malini Uluwatu truly unforgettable.

Delicious food, sunset right in front of us, waves crashing below… super romantic. The place is clean and beautiful.

Special thanks to Ms. AISYAH, our waitress very friendly and helpful, took our photos and recommended great food. They even surprised us with a free “Happy Honeymoon” cake 🎂 such a sweet gesture.

If you’re coming to Bali, you MUST visit this place. Perfect dining experience. 🌅

author: Ankit Kapoor
review_text:
Friendly staff,  best view., the chicken grill balinese meal and vegetarian pasta options were also excellent. Our server made sure to add and amend non veg pasta to veg pasta. We were at Malini to celebrate my husband's birthday and thank you 'Wan' for making the moment special by arranging pastry..
Whether you visit for a romantic sunset dinner or a leisurely weekend lunch, the view is always mesmerizing. A must-visit coastal gem — come for the view, stay for the food. Perfect for special occasions, date nights, or simply to unwind with the ocean as your backdrop. for us.

author: trinity connor
review_text:
Beautiful atmosphere, amazing service, all the staff here are very lovely and attentive!!
So kind, all are very good at speaking english.
We got the seafood basket, it was succulent amazing asian seasoning on the seafood, the crab and lobster were very soft and yummy.
Drinks were good also

author: Gulcan Cetin
review_text: This place is crazy great atmosphere with lovely smiling servers. Yoga and Kristen were amazing. They did their best to make us happy. hey, I have to mention the food. It was the best non-local food in Bali. I had basil pasta and creamy spinach chicken it was same as New York style so you gotta come here for Food for service for the view. It’s five star.

author: Алиса Шульц
review_text: I finally got to eat on this island!! The food was fresh and delicious, the drinks were made with real fruit. I recommend the octopus dish!! 🙏

author: Nghĩa Nguyễn Tấn
review_text:
1 star – WORST DINING EXPERIENCE IN BALI
This place is a total disaster.

I ordered their signature pork ribs – the most basic and iconic dish in Bali – and guess what? “Sorry, we ran out.” They forced me to switch to beef.
The beef was disgusting – tough, dry, and had a weird smell. Honestly felt like chewing on an old shoe.

The place was dirty, with greasy tables and flies buzzing around. I ended up with a stomach ache right after eating. Totally ruined my day.

To make things worse, the prices are ridiculously high for such low-quality food.
This is the kind of restaurant that survives on tourists who don’t know better.

Avoid at all costs. Don’t waste your money, your time, or your stomach here.
Never again.

author: Sudarta Ketut
review_text: The best restaurant in Nusa Penida by far. They have amazing food, especially the pizza. We also enjoyed a beautiful sunset at Orenda Beach. There's a lively concert in the evening.

author: Lauren Stevens
review_text: A beautiful restaurant right next the sea with very friendly and welcoming staff, an amazing live singer every night as well. Food and service was amazing every single time. Definitely will be coming back!

author: chloe Keast
review_text: Such friendly service, amazing view, and delicious food and drinks :)

author: Tinaye M
review_text: The food was amazing! Highly recommended ordering the marry me chicken it was so good. live music aswell

author: aloha moon
review_text:
Very chill atmosphere and vibe with slow and chill acoustic music and lovely staff♡
The ocean is in front of the place and there's a nice photo spot as well!
They said that they have live music on every friday and saturday if it's not raining so I'll be sure to be here for that next time.

Suksma for your kind and lovely hospitality, Wayan🙏😊

Oh I really loved my banana milkshake! They make it with fresh bananas🍌

author: Ashley Dow
review_text: Awesome spot, lovely staff, great view, will be back for the music later, a definite must as your going past, beers nice & cold, well done guys 10 outa 10, ash Gold Coast Australia

author: Yan Ren Emmanuel Tan
review_text: Nice ambience. Great pics. Wide variety on menu. Portion slightly small but reasonable.

author: kaitilin moor
review_text: My husband and I came for lunch after a fabulous day snorkelling. He had a surprise birthday cake and flowers arranged for my 50th birthday !! The place is so beautiful. The views are spectacular. The food was fantastic and the staff were so professional and couldn’t do enough for us. Throughly recommend. ❤️👍🏼❤️👍🏼

author: Apeksha
review_text:
Amazing place with good food .. Ambience is perfect for your evening dining with Live music...
Very spacious & huge sitting...
Service is also fast & good.

author: Liam O'Flynn
review_text:
Lovely staff and food. We went for the Nasi Goreng and couldn't really go wrong.

Recommend catching the sunset here as well. Live singer/guitarist last night was great with a superb set list to boot.

Recommended.

author: Maria Ribeiro
review_text: Lovely place with a view, beautiful sunset, friendly staff and nice food.

author: FM Fortus
review_text: Awesome people, exhibiting the true Indonesian hospitality. Great food and ambiance. Kudos to all the friendly staff!

author: Bo Zoethout
review_text:
Great place to grab a bite to eat and have a drink.
Extensive menu, both food and drink.

With a nice terrace on the 1st floor and a place to sit at the beach. ( with bali swing!)
On some days they even have live music!

Very kind staff as well!

author: Giulia Morf
review_text:
amazing hidden gem in Nusa Penida.
great food, awesome staff and incredible life music. they even sing for my birthday and made candles for birthday on the dessert. :) thank you ☺️🙏🏼

author: 奚琦
review_text: very good experience here with my friends, the sea view is very beautiful and the singer can sing and interact with us.

author: Tessa van de Pas
review_text: I had dinner tonight with my friend here. The atmosphere was amazing! There was live music and it was just the right sound. The food was also delicious and it had a broad range of choices of food. The people who work here are very kind. Overall an amazing night out for dinner in Nusa Penida! I would highly recommend

author: Hayley T
review_text: Beautiful fresh salad. Team were so friendly and food delicious. Even got a takeaway milkshake for dessert

author: Aleix Donnachie
review_text:
Came for dinner and such a shame as staff here are really lovely, I really wanted to enjoy it.
We ordered the seafood platter and we received 3 dehydrated prawns, and what seemed like the last bit of fish they had for the day served with old rice.
We unfortunately did not enjoy our meal and would not recommend :(

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Yushaz farahani
review_text:
Touchdown Indonesia and straight away feeling the hype lah! First meal had to be Pagi Sore — and it did not disappoint. The food was genuinely good and super sedap. The ayam pop was really enak, and the tunjang totally satisfied my craving. Udang Tofu must tried for spicy lover. Even tried my first air jeruk — refreshing gila!

Overall, a solid spot for that authentic Indonesian comfort food fix. Will definitely come again!

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Tan TM
review_text:
Pagi Sore
Fabulous food. Would return without doubt as the price is reasonable while the food is tasty. Fantastic variety.
My favourites are
- beef rendang
- Green sambal
- Fish Head Curry
- Scar daun keladi
- Fried chicken.
My only gripe is the Q mgmt or rather the lack of it. The place is crazy packed and there is a lady who takes down your request for a table and completely ignores you afterwards. No smile, no reassurance that the table is coming, and tptal poker face. But despite the chaos at the front desk, our name is called and we got our table. Best to sit in an air conditioned area.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: lee on miin
review_text:
My first Padang dining experience in Jakarta and it didn’t go as expected.
Many wrapped dishes were placed on the table even without ordering, and while you only pay for what you open, the food we tried was too salty and completely cold.
There were no price displays, so we only found out the cost at the counter, and the bill felt expensive for the small portions. We also learned only at payment that rice is free refill.
Overall, it felt more like a tourist-oriented place with high pricing that didn’t match the quality.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: dq
review_text:
Came by upon landing, first impressions - wow very grand & definitely gonna be an above average meal in terms of cost. They have a holding area for luggage bags too so I believe theyre used to taking in tourists.

We were greeted at the door and led to a table where they started piling dishes upon dishes all cling wrapped. You can pick out what you want and return what you don't want. Once you open then you will be charged for it.

Dishes I would go back for: ayam pop, rendang dating & ayam penyet. There was also a minced beef (?) with chilli on top which was good. Overall I enjoyed the meal!

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Mohd Afiq Abdul Ghafar
review_text: The restaurant is very convenient for travelers, offering easy access and a comfortable atmosphere. The food is really good, with an authentic taste that truly represents Indonesian cuisine. The staff are very friendly and helpful, making the overall dining experience even better.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Djeus Wong
review_text:
Recommended by our spa owner, we managed to get a quick dinner here at 9.20pm and it turned out a very satisfying one.
The staff are attentive, the food very tasty and burst with flavour, the place spacious and clean.
Definitely will return.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Banana Gus
review_text: Awesome Padang restaurant. They are located in numerous locations and I went to the one in PIK. It was a Sunday for lunch, place was packed. Had to wait for 10-15 minutes for our table. Food were fresh and tasted so good. Service was excellent. One of my go-to place for nasi Padang.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Tongz NP
review_text: Beautifully designed Padang-style restaurant with delicious food—especially the rendang and crispy chicken. The service is great and attentive. There’s also a separate PS Coffee area, perfect for a relaxing coffee after your meal. Cozy vibes and Instagram-worthy interiors. Definitely worth a visit!…

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Steve Isaac
review_text:
Just had business lunch here, gotta say with all the hype going around, it's pretty good.

Staffs were very courteous and knowledgeable on the products offered here.
Fast service too.

One of my fave dish for Padang is the Dendeng Belado, unfortunately the one sherw is the soft kind, and not the hard crispy type.
Nonetheless, still good.

Overall it was a good 1st experience fer me, but not enough to make me need to go back for more in the long run.

Great job by the management though 👌🏻

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Mohammad Azri Yaacob
review_text: Abit overcrowded for me. But I’m unable to adjust my liking of placing multiple dishes on the table even though I didn’t ordered it. The table looks crowded. Probably that’s Padang food is all about but not for me who prefers it differently. Maybe not now, it’s getting used to it.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Harwati Hashim
review_text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. However, the service could be improved. When we visited, it wasn’t crowded, but we still weren’t served efficiently. I asked for a menu from one of the staff, but she never returned. Fortunately, a male staff member later attended to us and fulfilled our request. With better service, the dining experience here would be much more enjoyable.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Aishah Latif
review_text:
We came early to Pagi Sore and were actually the first ones in – no queue, no wait, and plenty of tables to choose from. Of course, we picked the best seat by the pool! The staff were so attentive, bringing out the spread of dishes and the drinks menu right away.

It’s proper Nasi Padang style – all the small plates arrive covered, and you’re only charged for what you eat. From the variety, we tucked into Gulai Tunjang, Ayam Pop, Udang Tofu, Sambal Terong, Tempe, Sambal Hijo, and the star of the show – Pegedil. The Pegedil was so good I had to pack some to bring back home to Malaysia! And to top it all off, nothing beats a glass of Es Kelapa Jeruk.

The whole experience was warm and welcoming – friendly staff, a lovely poolside setting, and food that really hit the spot. Even our Grab driver shared that locals often label Pagi Sore as “Mantol” (mantap betul) – and I couldn’t agree more!

Can’t wait to come back for more Pegedil!

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Yvonne Lim
review_text: i find the food average but it’s a popular restaurant for tourist n locals. the food is quite pricey for me. i must say prefer my food serve hot then to be presented in wraps. my review is just a personal preference.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Iza Ishak
review_text:
Food was cold although the spices more than make up for the lack of heat.

20 minutes drive from Soekarno Hatta Intl Airport.  There’s space to place your luggage and convenient ramps.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Fakhira Mukhtar
review_text:
Very efficient and fast. Waiting time even with alot of crowd only around 5-10 mins.

Food has more selection than the other branches cause here they have cafe as well.
Even the coffee is really good.
My favourite is the Ayam Pop. the best ayam pop you can get is from Pagi Sore (at least for me).

Came here before we go to PIK & airport. They have a place to store your bag, and will give you a tag number for your bags.

Also have mussolla for those who want to pray first.

It’s also not so far away to PIK around 5 mins and airport takes another 15-20 mins. A good place to stop by before going back or when you just arrive Jakarta.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Sazali M Salleh
review_text:
This Padang styled restaurant is a must try for all visitors to Jakarta. In fact, there are a few outlets carrying the Pagi Sore brand, but we specially decided to choose this particular one, on our way to the airport, before we fly back to KL.

Najwa had been mentioning the name ever since day 1, but our itinerary had been quite packed throughout our soujourn in Jakarta. Hence, it was such a great opportunity to be able to try it on our very last day. We have tried plenty of Nasi Padang restaurants before, the Simpang Tiga restaurants in Medan and Ipoh, as well as the various Rumah Sederhana outlets in Malaysia. But Pagi Sore is distinctly unique.

Upon our arrival, we were quickly ushered to our Table for 4, and as we were sitting down, some foods were also being continuously piled up on our table. I know that we would be charged only for those we actually ate, but the delectable spread being presented in front of our eyes were very hard to resist!! So, some ground rules needed to be established to ensure we didnt encourage any wastages. This was a major challenge for Daniel, ad he was so used to finishing all the leftovers!!

I just couldnt resist the huge Fresh Water Prawn which was staring directly at my face, and decided to do justice to it. My wife and Najwa loved the Ayam Bumbu Putih, the Chicken with White Gravy, and I also found that dish to be marvelously delicious too. Daniel and I ended up finishing a plate of what looked like some crackers, which actually turned out to be Keropok Kulit Sapi, or Cow's Hide crackers...go figure..

All in all, it was such a fullfilling lunch, and Najwa settled  the bills with a big smile, as the cost was very agreable to her. Obviously, I would happily recommend this restaurant to others..

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Mohsein Sani
review_text: Very popular with Malaysian tourists, this restaurant serves a variety of local dishes in a plethora of small plates covered in plastic that the servers bring to your table along with a tub of white rice. Choose whatever dish you fancy and the servers will calculate your meal cost at the end by counting the plates that have been uncovered. Go there for this experience, but the food isn't all that great, to be honest, and it's kind of pricey too.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Henry Hsu
review_text:
Top choice if you are looking for nasi padang.

I loved that they cover all plates of food with plastic.

U open, u pay. The taste is authentic especially the ayam pok. Top of choice for diners.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Suzalinna Sulaiman
review_text: I finally had the chance to try Pagi Sore after hearing so much about it. The place definitely has a lot of buzz, but personally, I found the food to be just average. While the menu offers a good variety and the presentation is neat, the flavors didn’t quite live up to the hype. Service otherwise fast, efficient and tip top. Overall, it’s worth a try if you’re curious, but don’t go in expecting a culinary experience that matches the hype.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Razali
review_text:
An OVERRATED place. Mediocre foods.

A had a way better tunjang at a cheaper place.
Rempah is not there. Almost all are overpowered by santan. Really disappointed with it.

The a/c seems unavailable to cater large crowd. It is hot inside the restaurant.
Crowded & noisy.

Many staffs but most are not attentive.

The only standout dish is sayur ubi tumbuk. A nice combination of ingredients.

author: TAN ANDREAS
review_text: Came here few Times , for Indonesian cuisine lovers are recommended, most of the food tasted great , and suitable for our flavor , sop buntut👍ayam bakar👍sate ayam👍..food are worth of price, good environment for Lunch as well dinner , huge place for meeting or gathering 👍😊be back soon Pondok kemangi.

author: Moses P
review_text: Perfect place for big group who like to enjoy typical Indonesian foods! The place is classic modern and plenty of spaces. Staffs are friendly and polite. I like this place, i will be back!

author: TenTen 1010 (TenTen1010)
review_text: The food were ok ish but the service kind of not responsive. The decorations were nice, but the sink are quite far.

author: J. Lepianda
review_text: Seafood was fresh and tasty, especially the grilled fish and sambal. Place is spacious and comfortable, good for group meals. Service was friendly, but they seemed short on staff so things were a bit slow. A nice spot for casual dining.

author: Angelina Kurniawan
review_text:
Pondok Kemangi in Pluit offers a cozy and welcoming ambiance, perfect for family gatherings or dining with friends. The food, while not particularly extraordinary, is still enjoyable and satisfying. The service is commendable, with friendly staff ensuring a smooth dining experience.

Even when dining in a group, the food arrived promptly without much waiting time. Parking is also convenient, which adds to the overall ease of visiting the restaurant.

In summary, it’s a great spot for a casual meal with loved ones, and I would definitely recommend it for its pleasant atmosphere and reliable service

author: Irvan Irawan Jie
review_text: The place is gorgeous and the service was excellent. We went there as a big group of 30 people. The food came quickly, the waiters are all nice and helpful. The food was good. The only hassle is the limited parking space when there is a big crowd, need to park on the side of the road.

author: Novita Wu
review_text: Great Indonesian Food, few options for vegetarians. Great for big groups as they offer many tables and chairs. Food quality is good too. Service for prepping the food takes sometimes as they are serving large groups of people. Atmosphere is pretty noisy as many people gathered around. The restaurant is pretty aesthetics. I went on Sunday, so that’s when family gatherings are held.

author: Lily
review_text: Nice and spacious place. We had a family dinner with 25 people here. Didn't manage to get a private room upstairs due to holiday season. We ate downstairs in the main dining hall. Food was delicious, especially enjoyed the seafood. A minus point for the environment is because of the mosquitoes. A minus point for the service. The staff is friendly but very slow on collecting used plates, even though we have asked them to do so. They just seemed busy and wonder around the dining hall. But overall it's a nice restaurant with good food. I'll come back when I come to Jakarta again.

author: Carol NS
review_text:
The food is delicious.
The place is spacious.
The service is friendly.

author: Hardy Wi
review_text:
Excellent Indonesian seafood restaurant. Almost all dishes were done well. Not overly salty like most restaurants in Jakarta. Service was great too.
4* for atmosphere since the AC couldn't catch up with the heat - note that this is quite common in Jakarta. It's not too hot but cooling can be improved.

author: LifeOnEarth
review_text: Dine in during weekday. Food is good, place is clean but too warm to eat comfortably as the food we eat is hot and spicy. Should have keep the temperature in the restaurant bit colder.

author: Wina Huang
review_text: Very spacious restaurant! Easily fit 100people. they have a private hall at 2nd floor too. food is okay with reasonable price.

author: Shubham Gupta
review_text:
Great place to have local food. They have crab which is recommended.
Very limited vegetarian food options

author: Nana Setiawan
review_text: Food taste is good, price is reasonable. They have private rooms and a big room and area to rent if you want to have a small party like engagement or birthday party like more than 20 people.

author: CooZooRoo
review_text:
Overall taste is great.

The restaurant is beautiful, but weekends are almost full and parking is limited.

Number of servers are not compatible with the crowds so lacking of services for tables are happening.

author: Sai Arathi
review_text: Came here for our sister's Sangjit. Nice place. They dont have much of Veg options.

author: Henni Lin
review_text:
Love the atmosphere .
Well designed

Food ? Overall 5 points from 5.
Their sayur genjer tauso is delicious

They have nice Sambal Mangga
And their Sambal Cobek is real spicy

author: Tedy Wijaya
review_text: First time came here.. It was a Complete dining experience. From the food, hospitality, and the ambience was excellent.. Perfect for family dining moment or business lunch.

author: Ghivan Christine
review_text: Celebrating my cousin's birthday here. The staff is very friendly. The food is quite tasty. I enjoy the fried prawn with oat. The ambience is also cozy.

author: Warren Teh
review_text:
If you like authentic Indonesia food with flavourful spices, must have it here.
Nice and atmospheric ambience.
Try the mango sambal, crunchy mango adds a sour punch to the sambal.

author: kirana tiara
review_text:
I had an excellent dining experience at Osteria Gia PIK.. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere felt elegant yet comfortable, making it a great place to enjoy a relaxed meal. The food was beautifully presented and full of flavor—everything we ordered was clearly prepared with great attention to quality and detail.
What truly made our visit special was the outstanding service, especially from “Kahfi”. He was extremely helpful, knowledgeable, and attentive throughout the entire meal. Kahfi took the time to explain the menu, gave great recommendations based on our preferences, and always checked on us at the right moments without being intrusive. His friendly attitude and professionalism made us feel genuinely welcomed and well taken care of.
Thanks to the delicious food and Kahfi’s exceptional service, our experience at Osteria Gia was memorable. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great Italian food paired with excellent service, and I will definitely be returning in the future.

author: Juliana Alhattab
review_text: I had a great experience here! The pizza was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was calm and relaxing, which made the whole visit even more enjoyable. The place itself is beautiful and has a peaceful vibe. After the meal, you can take a lovely walk by the river — the riverbank is perfect for a stroll, especially at sunset. Such a perfect spot for a cozy and relaxing evening!

author: Phillippe Jesse
review_text:
The food was wonderful. It was beautifully prepared, the flavor was authentically Italian while being palatable for the indonesian tongue, and the portion was plentiful.

They do suffer a similar problem to what alot of restaurants in indonesia have, a lack of staff issue. The service was very friendly, knowledgeable, and polite. But that only when they are not busy running around.

As always the vibe was immaculate. Very classy, very elegant. The table spacing is pretty loose and the decoration is thematically centered. Overall very comfortable with the background noise still being able to chat

Spent 3mil++ for 9 people but honestly its worth it. I will say that the price only work because of the harmony that the food, atmosphere, and service bring.

author: Savira Sandra Priscilla
review_text:
Definitely will come back here!
The best Osteria Gia branch I’ve ever visited.
I had a wonderful dining experience here. The staff were friendly and attentive especially Suci, the dishes were beautifully cooked, and the portion sizes were generous. The restaurant has a warm ambiance that makes it perfect for both casual meals and special occasions.
Highly recommended!

author: gev
review_text:
love the elegant ambience at Osteria Gia PIK
warm, chic, and cozy at the same time. interior nya classy dan inviting, pas banget buat casual dining maupun special moments. the pizza feels so authentic with a light crisp crust and flavorful toppings, dan tiramisu nya rich but perfectly balanced. definitely a must visit in PIK 2.

author: Arief Ramon
review_text: The popular Italian eatery brings its retro-vintage charm to PIK. It’s always buzzing, so book ahead! The Spaghettoni al Burro e Pepe and wood-fired pizzas are crowd favorites. Lively atmosphere, great cocktails, and authentic flavors make it a hit.

author: Syifa Fajriani
review_text: Had a very pleasant dinner experience here. The service with Mr.Rama and his team was great, they're very helpful. And the food all superb! No wonder the rating's high, keep up the good work!

author: Dolly Harriet
review_text:
Hands down one of the best Italian restaurants in Jakarta.
Everything we ordered was delicious and pleasing.
Yes, the price is quite pricey, it's pretty good for special occasions as well.

We enjoyed the pretty interior and atmosphere too, it was a bit too hot because we went for lunch, but overall was nice.

author: Verren Yaputri
review_text: Loved the food! everything was well-presented and tasted amazing. The ambience is beautiful and relaxing, perfect for a nice Christmas dinner. The staff, especially kak Kahfi, were polite, helpful, and quick to assist. Highly recommended.

author: Richca Davine
review_text: Dinner at Osteria Gia Orange Groves was so good! Service was on point, and Kak Suci was really great. For sure coming back to try more stuff!

author: Andre Bastary
review_text:
We were helped by the supervisor on the day of our visit. She was very helpful and understand the menu quite well. The restaurant provides a vibrant atmosphere that combines nostalgic Italian charm with contemporary design, creating a comfortable and relaxing dining environment. The interior is a magical vibe of classical mahogany piece.
The food quality is consistently high, with generous portions for Italian cuisine . Diners can indulge in top-tier food and beverages, including authentic Italian dishes like their pizzas and pastas. Notable dishes include the Maialona pizza, Spaghetti Aglio Olio.

author: Helen Colie
review_text: Lovely Italian restaurant with great food and nice atmosphere. Special mention to Mr. Bali, the bartender, who was warm and attentive and even offered complimentary drinks. Would happily come back.

author: Ketut Artha
review_text:
I had a good overall experience here. The vibe is relaxed yet still feels like a proper sit-down Italian restaurant—comfortable enough for friends or family, and nice enough for a casual date night.

Pizza: Pretty solid. The crust was decent and the toppings balanced; not mind-blowing, but enjoyable and worth ordering if you’re craving pizza.

Pasta Carbonara: Tasty, but not an authentic Roman carbonara. If you’re expecting the traditional guanciale-pecorino-egg emulsion style, adjust expectations—this version leans more “creamy comfort pasta.” Still enjoyable if you’re not a purist.

Service: The standout. Staff were warm, patient, and genuinely helpful with menu questions. That hospitality carried the meal and is a big reason I’d come back.

Bottom Line: A 4-star experience. Come for friendly service and a relaxed meal; order pizza, try other pastas if you’re picky about classic recipes, and enjoy the atmosphere.

author: Yani Vanesa
review_text: Such a pleasant experience! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the food was delicious. Special shoutout to Suci, she was super friendly, attentive, and made us feel right at home. Thank you for the great service!

author: William Tan
review_text: Shoutout for Mas Ardi who serve us very well. Food also never fail. Will come back to this outlet every now and then. Thank you.

author: William Go
review_text:
The steak menu is for sharing, so practically the main course option is only pasta if you want individual meal. Not much to choose from.
Taste is so so, and generally is a bit too salty.
Nice decoration and good service.

author: theo
review_text:
I had the pleasure of dining at Osteria, a cozy Italian restaurant known for its authentic flavors and warm ambiance. I decided to try their Lasagna, Grilled Chicken with Mushroom Sauce, and of course, their famous Tiramisu for dessert.

The Lasagna arrived bubbling hot with perfectly melted cheese on top. The layers of pasta were tender, and the rich meat sauce was well-seasoned, bursting with tomato and herb flavors. Each bite was a comforting blend of creamy béchamel and savory beef, making it easily one of the best I’ve had.

Next, the Grilled Chicken with Mushroom Sauce was equally impressive. The chicken was tender and juicy, grilled to perfection with a slightly crisp exterior.
