The mushroom sauce was velvety smooth, with a deep, earthy flavor that complemented the chicken beautifully. It was served with a side of roasted vegetables that were cooked just right—soft yet still vibrant.

To finish off the meal, I couldn’t resist their Tiramisu. It was light and fluffy, with layers of mascarpone cream that melted in my mouth. The dusting of cocoa on top added just the right amount of bitterness to balance the sweetness. It was the perfect end to a delightful meal.

Overall, Osteria delivered on all fronts—delicious food, cozy atmosphere, and attentive service. If you’re craving authentic Italian flavors, I highly recommend giving it a try.

author: Nelly “Prudential” IG:fininsuranceplanner
review_text: Nice restaurant and bar to chill with family and friends. The seafood dishes are quite tasty/ umami. We ordered: Steamed Garlic Scallop with vermicelli, Rolled Wagyu with Enoki, Abalone Soup, Sea Cucumber Soup, Chong Qing Chicken and Sapo Eggplant. The portion is quite big and can be shared with more than 5 people. Overall I enjoyed the food and the atmosphere. Will come back for the live music on other days.

author: Evan Tan
review_text:
An absolute hidden gem! This chinese restaurant (with a chef from Hong Kong) is located in such a secluded road in the Pluit area, which makes it quite hard for random passerbys to see and notice. But when you do notice and do decide to give it a try, they truly do not disappoint.

To start of, they have a plethora of options for any Chinese food connoiseur to be blown away. They have plenty of variety from their appetizers to the mains and soups and desserts.

To put it simply, every dish (as pictured in my uploads) were amazing. But to highlight my two favorites, I would say the Suan Cai Yu and the Bubur Udang Galah are some of the best dishes in town! I would go even further to say that the Suan Cai Yu (ikan sayur asin) they have is the best compared to their peers.

All that to say, what a wonderful delight of a restaurant. Most of the older locals already know and frequent Seven Kingdoms, but it's about time this restaurant gets recognition not only from the Pluit locals but also from the younger hipper foodies of Jakarta.

author: viona sumartio
review_text: The food is delicious overall, the staff and their service is great so far the vibes were rlly good as we can karaoke while eating

review_text: Nice live music, good service and nice food. Good place to hang out with family and friends. ☺️

review_text: Exceptional food, didn’t even take the time to capture some photos. All you gotta do is just go and try, you won’t regret it.

author: SHERLY RAHAYU
review_text: Chinese dinning with chinese live music n crowd . Tasty food and good service

author: E Gohres
review_text: Kaum is an absolute gem, the food is sublime, the service is impeccable, the attention is warm and hospitable. We had a fabulous dinner, served to us at the Kitchen Counter, overviewing the open kitchen, interacting with Chef Digo and his team. Chef Digo suggested us dishes, made them and presented tthem to us, whilst having conversations. What makes it so special, is that their menu covers authentic dishes from all over the vast Indonesia archipelago. We had the ‘Gohu Ikan Tuna’ (a tuna tartare in coconut and spiced oil) from Moluku, the ‘Bebek Timus’ (Indonesia spices marinated and smoked duck with a delicious salad of chaya leaves, cassave leaves and Naniura spices, with an explosive sambal at the side) from Medan, and the ‘Ikan Baramundi Bakar’ (grilled Baramundi in Indonesian spiced chili and its own broth). For drinks I highly recommend the Kura Kura IPA (local craft beer from Bali) and a Indo-Groni cocktail as an aperatif. Absolutely unique offering with heartfelt hospitality. Service with a smile came from Diah!

author: Dennise Ardi
review_text:
We were in Jakarta for a short break and were pleasantly surprised by the clean, balanced flavours of the food, especially since a lot of food  in the city tend to be MSG-heavy. The menu offers an interesting selection of dishes from different regions of Indonesia, complemented by very good service.

That said, we felt some of the dishes had untapped potential. For example, the garang asam soup could have been elevated further to better showcase the richness of its many ingredients. It tasted a little flat, lacking the punch we were hoping for. Perhaps using beef bones as the base could help develop a deeper, more robust flavour and add the beefiness the dish seemed to be missing.

author: Nik Halmey
review_text:
Very nice ambience and very nice food. The place is in a large landed bungalow with adjacent high-roofed hall.

Their menu is unique with dishes from all over the Indonesian archipelago. Taste is excellent. We had the sate maranggi, tumis buncis and kalio beef.
The service is fantastic. Booked through google maps and was seamless…not always the case.
Waiter was friendly, attentive and helpful..explained all the dishes..his name was Ferdy.
Last of all we had some unique desserts and the bongko was really tasty.
Would recommend especially for tourists

author: Bella Utami
review_text:
KAUM Restaurant has a beautiful interior that’s great for group dinners—spacious, warm, and comfortable.

A solid choice for tourists who want to experience authentic Indonesian food in a well-curated setting.

Special shoutout to our waiter Ferdy for his solid recommendations.

My favorite was the dessert: bongko kopyor, steamed in banana leaves with rich santan and red delima

author: Wafi
review_text: Delicious food and gorgeous interior. We ordered a range of dishes and every single one was amazing. Very spacious, so it’s nice for big groups. The service was great and food came out really quick. Perfect for those who want to eat Indonesian food with a slight upscale atmosphere.

author: Chelsea Paige
review_text: Really great restaurant! Ambiance was amazing, service was excellent and the food was delicious. We got the tumis keciwis tauco, lumpia tahu udang, mai goreng jawa, and garang asam iga and all were really flavorful! None were from the “shareable” side of the menu but all had enough food to share for 2 people. Would definitely recommend!

author: ADRIAN
review_text:
The food at Kaum was nothing short of heavenly with authentic Indonesian flavours elevated with a refined touch.

The ambiance is perfect for both special occasions or simply indulging in great food. Service was attentive making the whole experience even better.

If you’re in Jakarta and want to taste Indonesian cuisine at its finest, Kaum is a must-visit.

author: xiao xinpeng
review_text: It's rare to eat such a beautiful and delicious Indonesian creative dish. I especially recommend beef tongue, coconut flavor, and then the cooking degree is just right, and the skin also has a thin layer of crispness. I've ever eaten the best cowhouse. The service is also very professional and the environment is very good. I have been here many times.

author: Alia K
review_text:
This place is not easy to find for first timer. It's a fusion Indonesian food. I think it's acceptable for me. And i understand the charm of this restaurant.
Food is good. Desset and drink are good too. Service is great.
Es doger is the winner that night.

Had a great time there

author: Lizzy Rose
review_text: Top tier service from Mr.Yyoga! amazing food and service. Live band was great as well. My first time eating Indonesian food, great experience tbh!

author: Pramesti
review_text:
First timer here, and truly impressed from A to Z!
We ordered sate wagyu maranggi, nasi goreng sayur-mayur and se'i sapi sambal lu'at. All the menu we ordered was top notch, perfectly cooked and beautifully served. The meat was tender, juicy and delicious, well balanced on the spice too. Esp. the sate maranggi, hooked our memory that much definitely will comeback for this dish.

Their service was also impeccable, with strong focus on warm and attentiveness from the staff.
When we seated, the lady staff asked whether we have food allergy. Never found this kind of attentiveness in other place, thumbs up!
When we asked about the jamu/remedy drink, we've been explained in details and the lady staff gave us small portion to try first.

Last but not least, the whole concept of the ambience. Most places only think about the ornaments, interior and everything that catches eyes, rarely pay attention on the background music. When I was there, I heard songs from Koes Plus, Vina Panduwinata, Chrisye, even the legendary Bengawan Solo. Suitable for bringing elderly family members. Outstanding for anyone who brings the concept.

Will surely be back to Kaum, cause I'm eyeing their other irresistible menu.

author: emma mascandola
review_text: We had an amazing time here at Kaum Jakarta.The staff is very friendly and happy to help you choose from the menu. The food is outstanding – we highly recommend sitting at the kitchen bar to fully enjoy the experience and watch the chefs in action!

author: Roger Yuen
review_text:
After a seven-year hiatus, we finally made a nostalgic date-nite return to Kaum in Menteng, Jakarta—and it felt like coming home to a more refined, stylish version of an old friend. Part of the Potato Head Group, Kaum remains a love letter to Indonesia’s culinary diversity, artfully fusing traditional recipes from across the archipelago with modern sophistication—beautifully composed, yet brimming with authentic flavours.

The Gohu Ikan Tuna from Maluku was a bright, briny revelation: fresh tuna lightly cured in coconut oil, calamansi juice, and tart belimbi, crowned with crunchy kenari nuts, peppery ginseng leaves, and crisp rice crackers. The Ikan Bakar Pesisir from West Sumatra followed—succulent barramundi grilled to smoky perfection, bathed in tamarind and turmeric, and given a fiery lift with sambal merah.

To round it all off, the Kookaburra cocktail sang in harmony—lemongrass-infused Three Peaks gin shaken with fresh mint, citrus, passion fruit, and a cloud of curcuma foam. A tropical symphony in a glass.

author: 游程閎

review_text: Love the ambience and great service! The barramundi is delicious, but the kangkung is overcooked. I’d expect it to be near perfection at this price tag.

author: M Hoque

author: Afaq Umair Khan
review_text: The food taste was good, nothing extraordinary. The ambience was quite relaxing and nice and the service was very good. Overall a good experience to go once. Give the ambience and everything, it was expected to be pricy but the charged 20% on top of the bill as a tax. Ideally the food prices should have tax already included. Good to visit only once

author: Penang Local
review_text: This restaurant offers regional Indonesian dishes in a beautiful relaxing space. We really enjoyed having dinner here .

author: Anova Fatimah
review_text: There’s usually a long queue in front of this place, which says a lot about its popularity, both for the food and the interior atmosphere. We visited right after our morning run around 10 a.m., so there was no line and we were able to get in immediately. The interior truly lives up to the hype, and the food is classic Indonesian cuisine with rich spices, many dishes leaning toward the spicy side. The staff were friendly and helpful, taking the time to inform us about ongoing promotions. Overall, it was a pleasant and satisfying dining experience worth coming early for.

author: Maizura Shahril
review_text:
We visited this place during our short trip to Jakarta, and with all the buzz around it, it became our very first stop for a meal after landing.

We managed to beat the crowd by arriving around 3pm and only had to wait about 5 minutes before getting in.

The atmosphere, the staff, and especially the food were all amazing. The food was seriously delicious, the portions were generous, and the prices were very affordable.

Definitely a place I’d come back to if I ever visit Jakarta again!

author: Zunairah Janis
review_text: Honest Indonesian flavours, well executed. Comforting dishes with rich spices that taste authentic and satisfying. A great spot for a relaxed local meal. Please come early if you do want to be disappointed by the long queue.

author: Suzalinna Sulaiman
review_text: Came around 6pm. No wait. Service was excellent. Plenty of choices. All look good and delicious on the menu. Finally settled with wrapped rice, ketupat tahu & grilled ribs. Tastes delicious and full of flavour. Worth every rupiah. Definitely recommended to those who wanna try Indonesian food.

author: C L
review_text: Came here first thing in the morning as we only have a couple of hours in this mall, food is amazing, service staff speaks fluent English. Deco is quite nice. Our fav was their satay and toufu, the fried chicken was great but too bad they ran out of chicken drum stick so the meat was rather tough, otherwise it would have been a great brunch.

author: Sarah Soong
review_text: Nice setup, good place to try local food, though probably not the best in taste but good enough given its location and comfortable environment. Efficient and polite service.

author: Muhammad Izzwan
review_text: Service is good and food was prepared fast. Except for our dessert. Had to wait for awhile now while writing this review. The bakwan sayur is the man of the match. Rest of the food was okay. And the dessert just came. It is very nice. Worth the wait lol

author: andi yani
review_text:
Remboelan Restaurant is a wonderful place to experience the soul of Indonesian cuisine presented in an elegant and refined way. The restaurant brings together rich flavors from across the archipelago—classic traditional dishes that are full of taste, well-balanced spices, and beautifully prepared.
The atmosphere is comfortable and classy, making it ideal for both formal business meetings and casual gatherings with friends or family. Despite the elegant setting, the food remains authentic and comforting, reminding you of the richness of Indonesian culinary heritage.
If you’re looking for a place that celebrates Indonesian food with quality, tradition, and style, Remboelan is definitely worth visiting.

author: Qamarul Fadhli
review_text:
Went here for lunch during weekdays. Had few dishes such as Nasi Bakul Daun Jeruk Ayam Pandan (non-spicy), Nasi goreng seafood (chose normal spicy option), Cumi lada garam (spicy default), Bakwan sayur udang, Perkedel jagung, Ayam goreng sambal bajak.

They were awesome and delicious. Portion was good. Service crew was friendly and attentive. Food served hot and promptly too.

Restaurant was clean and packed throughout our time there. Good place to have good meal for any occasions. Will not hesitate to return here or any other branches.

author: Ummu Pertiwi
review_text: They serve comfort Indonesian food. Love the fast service, despite our visit during lunch time, most food came around in 10-15 mins. flavor was not the best but pretty decent and comforting. my favorite was their pecel pincuk, lidah sambal ijo and asinan betawi. the fish couldve been a little less sweeter (it came out too sweet).

author: M Sabr
review_text: Amazing local flavors at Remboelan! The food is authentic and delightfully spicy—absolutely worth it. Huge shoutout to the staff for their hospitality; we did a walk-in at 9:15 PM (close to their 10 PM closing time) and they treated us perfectly. Great food, great vibes, and even better service. 10/10!

author: Elson Tang
review_text: The food at Remboelan is authentic and full of rich Indonesian flavors that truly comfort the soul. The warm ambience and beautifully presented dishes make dining here a delightful and memorable experience.

author: Nolianto Ananda
review_text: Indonesian cuisine, tons of menus, mostly delicious. Nice and cozy place, helpful and friendly staff. Worth it.

author: Ridho Petracivo
review_text: The food is realy delicious, the staff is realy nice. Price ? Worth it 😁. Oh i almost forget, we (me & my wife) met Dude Herlino (Indonesian Actor) here haha

author: Yi Jing
review_text: Loved the meal — there are many vegetarian options (see photo), service was wonderful, and ambience was great. Suitable for casual meals or more formal gatherings, note that it’s very lively even during a weekday lunch.

author: Wong Teck Jung
review_text: My five-star rating is exclusively attributed to the nasi bakul, which I found to be exceptionally aromatic and flavourful. I also thoroughly enjoyed the sate. The extensive selection of dishes and desserts is highly commendable.

author: Genta
review_text:
The go to restaurant brand for amazing Pan-Indonesian food!! Always love Remboelan and this branch specifically don’t get too crowded like the other brances (GI, Lotte) which usually has queues! We got in at 6PM with no wait!!!

Service was nice, we had bakulan asap, bakwan jagung with good roa, sate sapi matah (was a bit hard tho sadd), cumi wonosobo, and es pisang hijau makassar.

Really good! All came out around 450K IDR

author: Eric Tang
review_text:
Remboelan @ Plaza Senayan, Jakarta

Atmosphere: Located inside Plaza Senayan. Premium Indonesian cuisine . The decor is captivating and opulent. The interior is rainforest themed . This location has no waiting list as compared to other branches located in more popular shopping districts.

Service: Staff were friendly and able to provide tailored recommendations .

Food: Ordered their tumid bunga pepaya kecombrang & ikan asap (Stir fried papaya flower and papaya leaf with Kecombrang flower, shredded smoked fish, and stink bean), sapi sambal mbe nusa dua (Marinated beef topped with sambal Mbe), cumi betutu Tabanan ( fried squid and cassava caves in house special betutu sauce).

The local salad was complex, textured and flavorful with local ingredients. The beef was tender with a touch of spiciness. The fried squid was tender. Finishing with Es Teler Abang a local iced dessert which was refreshing.

Price: IDR 230k or MYR 60 per person

Google: 4.8

author: Alia S
review_text: Great food. Great service. Great atmosphere. A bit pricey but worth it. Would definitely recommend for anyone who wants authentic Indonesian food in a safe, clean, and secure place.

author: Hakimi Solutions
review_text: Very delicious food and good quality and almost double quantity they provide. Love the restaurant view and vibes.

author: Natasha
review_text: If you’re looking for really good Indonesian food, this is the place to be. The food was really good with very rich flavours. A must try when you are in Jakarta.

author: Abbott Hsu
review_text: Well decorated and designated surroundings inside restaurant. You can enjoy the traditional Indonesian cuisines with friends or families on weekends and holidays. Foods are yummy and tasty with authentic flavor. Good place for you to enjoy your time here. Enjoy.

author: Arif Syazwan
review_text: Came all the way from Malaysia to try this viral restaurant. Turns out it was good overall. Worth to try their delicious foods and desserts. Their service was superb as well.

author: Annastasya (Kei)
review_text:
We stopped by in the afternoon for some dessert, and it was wonderful!

First of all, the ambiance was perfect. You can experience an old Indonesian vibe inside the restaurant.

As for the food, I ordered the pandan latte, which was delicious! The bailey's cheesecake was also pretty good.

The service was good too.

author: Habib
review_text: Beautiful café with very good black coffee. Delicious cakes and pastries. I am grateful for finding a prayer room and ablution just behind the stage. What I really didn't like is that the pictures of naked men and women in the toilets.

author: Don Nguyen
review_text:
**NOTE: We should have read the lowest ratings reviews on Google here before we went in. Those low ratings are Spot-on!

Went here with my friend who was showing me around Fatahillah, aka Old Town Batavia in Jakarta. We were craving Italian and this little cafe eatery was near and right in the center square of attractions. Greeted by 2 front desk hosts who seated us at our table with 10 minutes. Our server name was "Ryan", whom I had tipped 50k IDR/$3 because I used to work as a waiter throughout College. After Ryan had taken our order, I had requested from one of the waitresses there named "Yulia" that I would like to order a bottle of water, so I could take my medication. After watching Yulia walk past us at least 3 times in a span of 20 minutes, and reminding her within 10 minutes after my initial request, she still did not bring us a bottle of sparkling water which I had ordered/requested. After I had realized she did not want to get me the water in a timely manner, I went up to the other waitress at the counter who didn't do anything but just stand there and told her I had ordered a water 20 minutes ago and have not received it and stated to her that if they don't want to serve us, we can leave. She then stated we would have to pay for our dishes (which we did not eat yet) and I said if I don't have my water I can't enjoy my meal. After she gave me an attitude I said this is not going to work out for us and just go ahead and charge us for the 2 smoothies we had, and forget the 2 entrees. She then said that I would have to pay for the entrees since they were in the kitchen being prepared. Fair enough, please get me my water I said. After me requesting to speak to their Manager "Neni", my water was promptly delivered to my table. Needless to say, our meal together with my friend felt very unhospitable and uncomfortable. Not a single time did any of these 3 servers come by to ask us if we needed anything else. Not to mention, we were charged before our dishes even came out. Our dishes were decent, not the best Italian I've ever had, but not bad. But for 2 dishes, my total came out to 854,000 IDRupiah, or about $54 USD for two people. I don't know if Yulia charged us correctly because she never delivered to us an itemized receipt of all the charges. I only have the receipt given from the credit card transaction, which is attached here. I will not recommend any Apple or Google colleagues of mine from California to come to this lackluster restaurant when coming to Jakarta to tour and sightsee this beautiful city. The service here at this restaurant is seriously lacking, and with much attitude. They are all about Money, and not the Customer experience. AVOID. BTW, this Batavia Cafe restaurant had just 2 tables the whole time we were there eating including us, so there is no excuse for poor service we experienced. We normally tip everyone, but this experience didn't even warrant our business.

author: Tiramisooo Tiramisooo
review_text:
Café Batavia is a must-visit when exploring Jakarta Old Town.
Once colonised by the Dutch, Jakarta Old Town has preserved its charming 17th century architecture and Café Batavia carries that same timeless vibe. ❤️

We stepped into a beautifully decorated space with floor-to-ceiling windows that let in the perfect dose of natural sunlight.

The menu is extensive and the food is so good. “This is the best Mie Goreng that I’ve tasted,” says me. The springy egg noodle is fried to perfection and not oily at all.

I’m still thinking of the Mie Goreng now. 🥹

#tiramisoooo #tramisoooojiaks #jiakjiakjiak #cafebatavia #jakarta #indonesiafood #miegoreng #jakartaoldtown

author: Evi Yuliati
review_text: "It's a must to stopped by" if you're in kota tua. The place is beautiful. Food is amazing. I had the best ox tongue and lychee tea there. Oxtail soup and latte is good as was. Very busy. Better make reservation beforehand to make

author: Grace Natalia
review_text: Loved my visit to Café Batavia! The ambiance is timeless — a beautiful colonial-style building filled with character and history. The food and drinks were excellent, with great presentation and rich flavors. Service was warm and professional, making the whole experience feel special. It’s the perfect place to enjoy a relaxed meal while soaking in the old-town charm of Kota Tua. Definitely a must-visit when in Jakarta.

author: Safyana Younas
review_text: Love it currently sat here after having finished our meal and waiting for the drinks! Everything was great and atmosphere was superb! My best meal so far in Indonesia. Service was absolutely fantastic, Apprillia was brilliant! Would definitely recommend for people to visit this place. Prices are reasonable and the music is lovely

author: Bobie
review_text: Great experience overall! The historic ambiance is charming, and the staff are friendly and speak English well. Loved every single dish we ordered—delicious and well-presented. Only downside: the ice cream portion was huge for just two people. Still, highly recommended!

author: Amy Lim
review_text: We were staying in Glodok area. So it's a must to visit this cafe. The building were constructed in 1830s. We went there for breakfast. It was a hot day so we were greeted by friendly staff that show us the way to up stair & another staff join in to bring us to our seat by the window. Wow! This place brings me back to the 60s with soft oldies being played as background. Very little thing of this place is so vintage. Let's talk about the food. At first the menu were brough to us with all wording. The waiter realise that I need aomething with picture, he qiuckly brough an tab or ipad to me to show the dishes in picture. From there we ordered our meals & drinks. For us, meal were good but the drinks so so only. I remember seeing other order dessrt. So we go for Ogy Ice cream small with 7 scoop 😍 & also poffertjes. We really love this dessert. We sitted there nearly over 2 hours, just enjoying the surrounding & chill out & unwind. I would said this is the best place so far for my trip in Jakarta, just relaxing & enjoying my breakfast💕 Price is on the high side but you paid for the environment. Food is good, drinks - okay, desset - yes please.

author: Vina Amira
review_text:
The place is beautiful and iconic it really captures the classic old Jakarta atmosphere with vintage decor, high ceilings, and warm lighting. It’s cozy yet elegant, perfect for relaxing or hanging out with family or friends.

I ordered Nasi Goreng Komplit, Mie Goreng Komplit, and Tuna Salad. The Nasi Goreng Komplit was flavorful and perfectly cooked, with generous toppings like chicken, egg, and satay. in addition Mie Goreng Komplit had that slightly smoky flavor and a nice mix of noodles, vegetables, and spices. i also ordered tuna salad, it was really fresh, and its dressing complemented the salad nicely.

The staff were friendly, and the service was good once we were seated. However, the waiting list was quite long, so it took a while to get a table. i think this is the only drawback.

Overall, Batavia Café is definitely worth visiting great food, a lovely ambiance, and an iconic place that truly represents Jakarta’s charm. i recommend this restaurant, especially for international tourists

author: Fitri Rachmadini
review_text:
Café Batavia is such a unique restaurant with its authentic Dutch colonial building — it really feels like stepping back in time! The whole atmosphere gives you that nostalgic charm you can’t find anywhere else.

Their cakes are delicious and properly made — definitely not disappointing. The price is a bit on the higher side, but totally worth it for the food and the one-of-a-kind vibes. ☕🍰🇮🇩

author: Оля Любарская
review_text: The food was really good, and for someone visiting from Europe, it felt very cheap. You can smoke on the first floor, but it didn’t smell smoky at all. We waited about 10 minutes for the food, though it was Monday and there weren’t many people. The desserts were also delicious and made right there. The staff were super friendly and spoke good English. We came back about an hour later after a walk, they called us a taxi and even walked us to the car.

author: Selvano Eduard
review_text: Exceptional! No other words. Atmosphere was nice with a view on the square, the food was also amazing but the service was the best in my trip Indonesia so far. Especially Novriyan, who handled the service like a true gentleman. Thanks for the experience!

author: Ianhung Lee
review_text: Instantly transport you back in time with dark wooden interior with colonial era touch on every corner. The establishment itself is elegant with a very attentive services. Food prices are on the higher side. There are plenty of seatings indoor but can be very occupied with tourists. Some area of seating can be loud with all the patrons chatting away while sipping tea.

author: Leo Khan
review_text: Amazing experience. Tasty food. Excellent service. My server spoke great English and gave really good recommendations of food and drink selection. I went there Saturday night and had almost no one in the restaurant. Everyone was nice and polite. Great live music with free one song request for the band. I will definitely come back again next time I'm in Jakarta. Highly recommend!

author: Yuhui LIN
review_text: I have been to the Cafe Batavia for twice. It is the most beautiful cafe in North Jakarta!! It has 2 floors and there are tons of photos and paintings inside, making the space very cozy. I recommend you stay here for a lunch or dinner. The price is also affordable for foreigners

author: Anna Safa
review_text:
beautiful historical restaurant, a true fine brunch. it doesn’t taste authentic because the taste might caters more towards foreigners, it lacks seasoning and strong flavor that indonesia food holds. i got nasi goreng, ribs, and satay and others, it was okay, not the best. i also got strawberry juice, white wine and bintang beer.

for the price, a fine brunch price, i wouldn’t say this is worth it. but it’s a nice one time visit.

beautiful restaurant nevertheless, architecture and decor pieces is such a masterpiece. aircon is nice since kota tua is very hot. service is nice and helpful.

author: Sam W
review_text: Historical colonial style architecture. A must if you’re visiting Old Town Jakarta. Service was rather slow (we ordered one chicken and it took 30 minutes!) good cosy areas, well air-conditioned.

author: Vishhal K Bhusari
review_text:
Appear polite in face but very rude ad core the staff at the entrance. Felt a cultural bias in treatment too.

The staff at Bar super nice, polite and humble (welcoming)

Came in with high expectations and disappointed

First experience in Jakarta of the cultural bias

author: Lyda Hak
review_text: This place is a bit a high-end café where they expect you to spend. The more you spend, the better location you will be offered for seating. However, all staff are friendly, speak good English n good to enjoy the atmosphere where you can learn the colonial history of this building. The coffee itself was just fine, not as wow as I'd expected for.

author: Albert Yeo
review_text: Plataran Menteng is a delightful discovery despite my over 3 decades of transversing Jakarta. The deco, the atmosphere, the food and the service makes revisits for me a must. Very deserving of mention is the reasonably priced great tasting menu and the immaculately attentive service. Mr Kahman was of great help with our choice of food including some gluten free and other dietary challenges. Enjoyed a simply great lunch on a day when many parts of Jakarta was experiencing floods. 😄

author: Xinyun Huang
review_text:
Top solo dining experience at a historic gem!
The colonial architecture is stunning, and the atmosphere was made even more magical by the beautiful live Christmas piano music playing throughout the evening.
I ordered the Iga Rawon (Black Ribs) with Green Rice and Salad Putri Dewi. The beef was incredibly tender, and the rich sauce paired perfectly with the aromatic rice. The guava salad was a refreshing surprise!
The service from Kahman was exceptional! He was very helpful with the menu and gave some really good recommendations.
He also recommended a look at the rooftop view - a breathtaking skyline night view in Jakarta.

Honestly, the value for money here is incredible, especially compared to similar high-end restaurants in other major cities.

True Indonesian hospitality at its best.

author: Joey “Joey123” Y
review_text:
What a gem of a restaurant in Jakarta. We had a big table of 10. The service was on point, the decor was very tastefully done and immaculately restored building, inside and out. The rooftop bar was a big surprise and just divine.
But most importantly, delicious local and authentic food, at a reasonable price.
What a delightful experience and will definitely come again.

author: Yunsa
review_text: For the price, it’s definitely on the premium side—pretty typical for Indonesian cuisine in a restaurant setting. What’s really worth noting, though, is how perfectly balanced the flavors are, truly indulging anyone who loves authentic Indonesian dishes. From the photos uploaded, I’m sure you can already tell how delicious everything looks.

author: Mara Tayag
review_text:
From the moment we stepped into Plataran Menteng, we were captivated by its exquisite yet cozy ambiance. The interiors strike a perfect balance between elegance and warmth, making it an inviting space for both intimate dinners and celebratory gatherings.

The food was outstanding. We especially loved the Plataran signature telur asin platter, which was rich and indulgent. The Dendeng Batotok offered a delightful crunch and depth of flavor, while the Ayam Dwarmawangsa was a refreshing mix of savory and tangy. The Gado-gado was a comforting classic, beautifully presented and well-balanced.

Service was superb. Sam, our server, was incredibly attentive and helpful—he patiently explained the menu and even gave us a tour of the restaurant, adding a personal touch that made the experience even more memorable.

Overall, Platara Menteng delivers on all fronts: delicious food, impeccable service, and a stunning setting. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy refined Indonesian cuisine in a beautiful space.

author: Dom Vito Briones
review_text:
Delicious Indonesian food. The crispy fried beef and the short-rib were amazing, and all the salted egg treats had that lovely, punchy bite of salted egg flavor (which a lot of other places skimp out on).

Atmosphere was wonderful. A wonderful home with a sophisticated but cozy ambience. If anything, I wanted to have seen more of the house.

Service was fantastic. Staff was kind and friendly, and we were given a ride back to our hotel.

Would recommend for anyone visiting Jakarta.

author: Lisa
review_text:
I had a wonderful experience celebrating my birthday at Plataran Menteng. The service was exceptional, the food was fantastic, and the ambiance was absolutely lovely.
My sincere appreciation goes to all the staff who made me feel so welcome and comfortable—it definitely makes me want to return! I was also pleasantly surprised with a delicious klepon cake accompanied by a thoughtful, personal note.

author: Tommy Chin
review_text: The place is absolutely gorgeous. I had the ox tongue satay, perfectly cooked, curry sauce was perfectly seasoned and packed with flavor. I sat on the ground floor at first, but my host, Sam, was incredibly kind to give me a tour around the establishment. I then had my dessert on the rooftop, which was the perfect way to end my stay in Jakarta.

author: Kyanna Soekardjo
review_text:
Celebrated my birthday here for the sole purpose of “napak tilas j-hope” and was not disappointed!

I was greeted very warmly from the very first start even with the valet service. The waiters and waitresses are all so nice and served us well.

Special shout out to mas Sam who have catered my friends and I’s requests, must’ve took hundreds of pictures until we’re satisfied. And mas Kahman who have been so kind to j-hope when he visited and telling us beautiful stories about j-hope that we can’t help but shed a little tear!

p.s. the rujak juhi is to die for! no wonder j-hope ordered more servings.

All in all, the experience is immaculate. A birthday well spent <3

author: Didi huang
review_text: Elegant environment, nice food and good service. And the floor captain Mr Kahman is especially patient. Thank him that we had a wonderful night.

author: Tan TM
review_text: Beautiful colonial bungalow converted into a restaurant. Unfortunately the food was disappointing. Food was served cold and in tiny portions. I suspect the guys were hungry after dinner.

author: Yani Rafioedin
review_text: Having a private event for the third times  at this restaurants, always happy to have their services , thanks to mas arifin and team for the excellence hospitality 🙏🏻🙏🏻

author: M Hoque
review_text: Terrible meal. The food was below average and the service was not attentive. We had a much better meal at Kaum Jakarta for excellent Indonesian food. Plataran Menteng is not recommended.

author: Susanna Lim
review_text:
We had an unforgettable evening at Plataran Menteng, where every detail—from the thoughtfully curated dishes (We ordered the beef and pomelo salad, beef rawon, chicken satay and  the grilled squid which tasted very good.) to the elegant colonial ambience—was executed with excellence. The setting itself is stunning, with beautifully preserved interiors and tastefully adorned dining spaces that tell a story of timeless charm.

The serving staff were warm, attentive, and proactive throughout our visit, offering helpful recommendations and ensuring every aspect of our dining experience was seamless and enjoyable.

We ordered the beef and pomelo salad, beef rawon, chicken satay and  the grilled squid which tasted very good.

A heartfelt thank you to Kahman for his gracious hospitality—his passion truly shone through as he shared the rich history of the restaurant and gave us a tour of the various floors, each uniquely decorated and steeped in character. It was a privilege to explore the space through his storytelling.

We’re also incredibly grateful for the thoughtful gesture of arranging a car to take us back to our hotel. That extra mile made the entire evening feel even more special.

A truly memorable experience—we look forward to returning on our next visit to Jakarta.

author: Lilyana Tan
review_text: Best restaurant in area Menteng. Nice place for meeting, family day, wedding, sangjit, birthday, etc. First coming in sangjit day. Slot parking is limited but can valet or park in cross road

author: Mariusz Skrzynski
review_text:
Zuko was our host and tour guide after we explored Indonesian cuisine of Java . Thank you very much for this remarkable experience . We highly recommend it and definitely will be back
Terimakasih baniak

author: Pat Benito
review_text: j-hope lead us to discovering & eating at this place and we were not disappointed. Such a wonderful ambience. The staff are very helpful, even when they realized we came because of j-hope’s influence. Lia was our server and she was really nice and attentive. The service was great, the food was so good. Personal fave is the lumpia bebek! Nasi Goreng Rendang is a good choice too~

author: Dada Linda
review_text: Very comfortable environment with very high standard delicious food！Definitely recommend trying！Dishes are all super flavorful and portion size is quite decent as well，love the mango salad fried chicken and house special panna cotta：）

author: Ritchie Sebastian
review_text:
Specially crafted Indonesian cuisine.
Using fresh & traditionally peculiar ingredients
Loved by locals & foreigners.
Very good venue for business meeting.

author: Man a
review_text: Top Place in Jakarta. Food Is great and not pretend tò be a moderno remake of traditiin. Servisse Is perfect and the colonial atmosphere make you dream a classic dinner of the 60'

author: Paul Britton
review_text: They have done a fantastic job with the renovations and keeping the bar area and patio open with minimalsit furniture and clean lines. There are lots of cozy corners and areas to sit as individuals or groups outside on the bar patio. The views are amazing and they have a flat area near the pool for people to take pictures for the INSTA! We ordered a few apps which all were delicious and came quickly. The cocktails are one area that could do with a bit of improvement but as it's only been open about 2 plus months I am sure it will get more consistent. Definitely  a great place to have a romantic date or bring someone from out of town and enjoy the views or even after work drinks. We had a small incident and the manager was on it immediately and handled it professionally, thank you again for that. Would recommend it to anyone who is staying in Jakarta.

author: Jason Masong
review_text:
Missed the views of Jakarta's skyline when they renovated early in 2025, so was thrilled to see what was done to the space when reopened!

One word to describe it all: cozy!!! The new space seems to provide something for everyone, not only those who seek the Skyline View whilst bobbing their head to some beats.

For wine afficionados, there is the new Wine Cellar wirh an expansive range of Bubbles

For foodies and families, one of the many indoor dining spaces, one of which is blessed by the backdrop of a open faced kitchen

For cocktail cats, revel in the new open bar inside the restaurant or revamped semi outdoor lounge area to soak in the sunset with a martini in hand

etc...

Skye has also significantly stepped up its food offerings with a well curated menu anchored around contemporary, western-leaning grilled fare.

Favorites are:
- Tomato salad with garlic panacotta
- Any cut of steak and a side of trippled cooked fries
- Brown Butter fish: this is seasonal so ask what the catch of the day is

The new Cocktail menu is fun and flavor forward with different cocktails for the indoor restaurant and lounge areas, to ensure that there is always something new to try!

author: Mohammad Mahmoud
review_text:
We had an amazing overall dining experience. The food flavors were incredible, the view was breathtaking, and the staff created such a warm and positive atmosphere — shoutout to our wonderful waitress Yori for his professional service.

A couple of small suggestions: the AC was extremely cold in our first spot, and we did need to change tables to get comfortable. Also, the portions seemed a bit small for the cost.

Still, thanks to your friendly and welcoming team, it was a truly memorable visit, and we would happily return.

author: Ciwi Paino
review_text:
It is located on the 56th floor of BCA office building, achievable from mall on thr lift behind Gramedia at the 3A floor, East Mall.

Renovated recently...particularly significant changing on the restaurant, more private rooms and nicer...

On the bar, more seatings and open...
There is entry fee 350K which you can use the vouchers to pay your bills

Very nice views to the city...

author: Hermosa
review_text:
We really enjoyed our time here. The rooftop view is amazing! Being up on the rooftop gives such a nice feeling, especially in the evening. The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable.

The food was really good. The chicken piri piri brochette is definitely a favorite,very tasty, juicy, and well seasoned. Everything came out fresh and nicely done.

The staff was great as well. Tivany, Julio, and Rio were friendly and attentive without overdoing it, which we really appreciated.

Overall, a very nice place for a chill evening with good food and a beautiful view. Would definitely come back!

Olla & Imane

author: Fikria Nur Abidah
review_text: Had a wonderful time at SKYE Bar & Lounge. The sunset view was absolutely stunning, and the ambience felt warm and homy, making it easy to relax and enjoy the moment. The drinks were great, the food was delicious, and the service was attentive and friendly. A perfect place to unwind, enjoy sunset drinks, and spend quality time!

author: Rina Suryanah
review_text: Food is amazing… the ambience really nice.. warmfull staff.. 😘  got birthday suprise song from the staff haha didnt expect! Keep going ya …

author: Yohanes Gunawan
review_text: Their signature appetizers and main courses were outstanding. Paired with a sweet red wine, the dinner atmosphere was even more special. And to our guest assistant, Mr. Diaz, thank you for your assistance.

author: Michael Trenggono
review_text:
Excellent pasta, very cozy and cool place.

We had the vodka rigatoni and grilled chicken, both excellent.

I also had Lychee tea it was great, the strawberry juice is just OK though.

I was served by Arsen, he was really friendly and nice to us.

Excellent ambient cozy music, played with perfect loudness, works very well with the decor.

Beautiful outdoor area with view out to the city at night.

Also if you don't like heat, this is probably the coolest restaurant i've been to in Jakarta, the AC is really strong.

author: Bima Darussalam
review_text: We’re had an amazing dinner experience at Skye, the service from waiter is very nice specially from Gibran, he is a good waiter. And thank you for help me to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday

author: backup iyan
review_text: Had a fascinating time here, great bar at 56 floor. Great cocktail n other liquor with interesting stories each of the drinks,  wonderful views n vibes also,  for they experimenting the drinks so it surely have wonderful tasty drinks. Big appreciation for billy and inggih they were such a great guy totally friendly and really helpful explaining everything totally insightful, surely had an amazing time here at skye

author: Wa'El Ali
review_text: Nice place with good vibes and friendly staff. Special thanks to Mr Yoga, he made our 1st year anniversary with my wife a special one.

author: Roy Prawira
review_text: The food is delicious, the service is fast and detailed, especially by Rara and Agung, who are very helpful.

author: Juan Xariskara
review_text: Really good place and the ambiance wa so nice, the staff also so good and attentive kk Raissa was sooooo perfect and she must be more than a server

author: Hanson Tjung
review_text:
One of my fav fine dining place. The ambience is very nice! Can enjoy the city from above.

Great hospitality, all the staffs are helpful and informative.

Two thumbs up for the food, esp the spaghetti and the steak. Love the cheese cake and chocolate for the dessert.

From Wed to Sat, there is live dj performance at the bar. Party will be fun.

author: Nadya Malik
review_text: We had a wonderful dining experience. The food was delicious and beautifully presented, but what really made our visit special was the service. Rara, Andre, and Tivany were incredibly attentive, friendly, and professional. They made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. Truly great hospitality

author: Cham Nizam
review_text:
From the moment we stepped onto the 56th-floor terrace, we were greet with a jaw-dropping smile of Kia, Tasya charming personality and Glow brought us to visit the dining area before we heading to the lounge.
Both area atmosphere struck the perfect balance between chic and relaxed. Great vibes!
Ringgo comes in with his awesome asean hospitality. Riassa, Bunga, Ian and Catarina represent the team synergy. Tasirwan played  role well too!
Price is equal with it's offerings. Toilet well clean everytime.
Moga sukses semuanya!
Cheers from Malaysia!

author: Dolly Harriet
review_text:
It is known as one of the best rooftop restaurant/bar in Jakarta. We went there for a nice meal and I think the food are okay.
We had to sent back our steak cause it was rare and we asked for medium rare. The pasta we ordered was delicious! Drinks were nice too. Desserts was quite sweet for my taste.

Overall, it's an experience to have. The service and ambiance were good!

author: Gloria F
review_text: Been here couple times, and always live how they treat us! The new place quite homey and aesthetic since they added wine chamber in dining area. The lounge had DJ and the city view was amazing 🤩 🌃

author: Felix Aje
review_text: Great experience at Skye Bar. The atmosphere was amazing and the service was excellent. Special thanks to Tivany, Julio, and Diaz for being very friendly, attentive, and professional. Definitely made the night more enjoyable. Will come back again.

author: Ali J
review_text:
Great experience here before our flight. The staff were very understanding when we said we were in a rush and did their best to help us.

We had Beef Rendang, Tauco Tahu Udang, Nasi Putih, and Nasi Lemak with Beef Rendang, all tasty and well prepared.

Friendly service and good food, would love to come back with more time.

author: Anna Safa
review_text:
I think I’ve almost tried every single dish they offer here at Seribu Rasa Gunawarman, and overall it was a spectacular dinner. The interior design and architecture are absolutely beautiful—elegant yet cozy, making the whole experience feel special.

The dishes themselves were perfectly cooked and full of flavor, with that comforting touch of home-cooked meals that I really appreciate. I especially have to mention the es teler—so refreshing and absolutely delicious, definitely a must-try!

There was a small mishap where I found a spider on my plate, but the staff immediately replaced the entire dish with professionalism and care. I do hope more attention is given in the future to avoid such incidents. Still, the way it was handled left a positive impression. Good service 👏🏼

All in all, flavorful food, wonderful atmosphere, and memorable dining—I would gladly come back.

author: wan r
review_text: Had an amazing dinner date with my mum here! The service, from the moment I made the reservation, entering the restaurant and until we left, was impeccable. The staff were very attentive and friendly, and they even had great camera skills. Plus, the food tasted delicious.

author: Guillaume Bourcy
review_text:
Not ideal for  vegetarian, although they can accommodate a few dishes on demand. However their seafood and fishes preparation are excellent on top of being well presented and beautiful.

The location and space make it also a great spot both for professional and casual or family diner.

A great address in Jakarta should you want to experiment local upscale seafood and fishes.

author: Ghufran Musta'an
review_text:
Seribu Rasa in Gunawarman, Jakarta, offers a comforting oasis amidst the city buzz, perfect for business meals or relaxed dining. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, matched by impeccable service that enhances the dining experience. Hygiene is top-notch, contributing to the overall appeal.

The menu is a delightful journey through authentic local cuisine, capturing the true essence of traditional flavors. Every dish, from the aromatic curries to the succulent meat and vibrant vegetables, is crafted to perfection, making it a standout in near the SCBD area. The taste resonates with the authenticity of home-cooked meals, a rare find in the restaurant scene.

While prices are on the higher side, the quality and portion sizes make it well worth the expense. Seribu Rasa has earned its place as my favorite dining destination in Jakarta, offering a memorable experience that justifies every rupiah spent. Thank you for the exceptional food and service!

author: Junia Anindya
review_text: I ordered the pad thai and honey chamomile tea — the pad thai was a bit dry and missing that smoky kick, and the tea was just warm, not hot. Probably should’ve picked something else off the menu!

author: Novi Beerens
review_text: I ordered black pepper crab, and Kangkung Belacan. Both were ok. The ambiance was noisy but we can still talking. Good place to eat seafood while shop at Plaza Indonesia.

author: Anggie Puji
review_text:
Always a great experience at Seribu Rasa!
The food is consistently delicious and full of flavor — always on point. The restaurant has a high-end ambiance, and all the dishes are made with quality ingredients. Highly recommended for dinner meetings or if you’re looking to enjoy authentic Indonesian cuisine in a refined setting.

author: Handoko Lie
review_text: One of the best indonesian food in town. Idk how many times I’ve been here and it always amazed me, my family and my friends. Staffs are very friendly, cozy place. After so many times , we had one bad experience, by the time we had our dinner, a cockroach step on my wife’s foot, a bit disappointed but it got all solved out. The manager came to us , apologized and gave us free dessert, which I appreciated it. But actually i really don’t need the free dessert, sir , i just need you guys to make sure, the place is clean. I will definitely come back again for the food and the hospitality.

author: Ian O Toole
review_text:
The pineapple chicken was delicious.
The empal2rasa was not great. Es durian should state its durian icecream not actual durian.

author: Adrick Loh
review_text: Our first lunch in Jakarta trip. Saw the popularity and good ratings on google map. Must say the deco n environment is a good place to be in having your food. Service wise, it’s also above average just that English is not well understood. Food wise we only loved the mee goreng and the rest is just normal. The pea drink is nice, price wise the cost is still affordable by tourist standards. By the way noticed the name of the dishes all seems to reflect the regional tourist attraction but the taste is lacking attraction.

author: Wana Azmy
review_text: Everything was fine. But they used chipped cup and the cup got stained too. I asked for change, second time the water got some dirts inside. What a shame. Unsafe to use chipped crockery ya, basic food safety guys!

author: Ester R
review_text:
Im sorry to say this, but the food served here really needs emergency improvement.

Also, the menu on the book are not ready to order, I got cancel twice! So when you make reservation, make sure what menu is ready, even better book in advance also for the menu. They might change it. So unreliable menu.

The drinks here pretty acceptable, their liqour (baileys) taste really good! We loved it!

This place is very suitable for photo, the decoration is so beautiful🥰

author: Arif Budi
review_text:
Phoenix Gastrobar – PIK ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Been a long time since my last visit, and I’m glad I returned for the festive season. The space is now a full Christmas wonderland — glowing garlands, red ribbons, gold bells, cascading lights, and a stunning carousel centerpiece that turns the whole atrium into a magical holiday scene.

Tried their festive menu and wow, the dishes have improved so much — confidently executed and genuinely delicious.

Golden Salmon Coulibiac
Silky Norwegian salmon, sushi rice, mushroom duxelle, and spinach wrapped in buttery puff pastry, finished with dashi beurre blanc. Comforting yet refined — rare to find a coulibiac this perfect in town.

Beef Parmentiere
Super-tender wagyu beef cheek with buttery mashed potatoes, red cheddar, garlic tuile, and rich beef jus. Deeply flavorful.

Crackling Roasted Pork Leg
My top favorite — fall-apart tender with lightly crisp skin, served with sautéed potatoes and onion–mustard sauce. A perfect Christmas dish.

Lapchiong Pork Hog Fried Rice
A smoky, tasty bestseller with a slight crust at the bottom and generous pork and lap cheong. So good.

Bowl of Festive Cocktail
Bold, punchy, refreshing, and beautifully glittering — great for sharing.

Overall, a highly pleasant visit. Beautiful festive atmosphere, improved dishes, and a grand venue worth recommending this holiday season.

author: Baggage Claim Philosopher
review_text:
Phoenix Rising (and Ordering Tequila)

A neurotic love letter to steak, staircases, and traffic gods in Jakarta.

You don’t go to Phoenix Gastrobar — you embark on a pilgrimage.

If the traffic gods smile upon you (which they rarely do, those vindictive bastards), it’s a one-hour drive from Jakarta proper. If they don’t, it’s a two-act opera about mortality set inside a Grab.

But when you finally arrive, sweaty, hopeful, and spiritually tested, the place hits you like a mirage designed by Hogwarts’ architect after a night out with Willy Wonka. There are stairwells that cross each other like a M.C. Escher drawing that gave up trying to be logical, secret passages that make you question reality, and lights so warm and moody you start narrating your own life like a noir film.

I half-expected Dumbledore to walk past with a martini.

The food? Exceptional. Capital E exceptional. The steak — divine. Charred outside, tender inside, like it had been serenaded by angels with tongs. The service is impeccable in that polite, silent way that says, “We know it’s expensive, but we also know you’ll forgive us.”

And you do.

Because the moment you taste that first bite, you realise this isn’t just dinner — it’s repentance for every bad meal you’ve ever endured.

Yes, it’s expensive by Indonesian standards. But so is happiness, and this place delivers both on a plate.

When you’re done, stroll (or stagger) next door to Tiger Club, the kind of place where the lighting is forgiving and the tequila is not. Order recklessly, stay irresponsibly late, and watch as night dissolves into day — because that’s what happens when you mix good steak, great music, and a small existential crisis over the bill.

Phoenix Gastrobar isn’t just a restaurant. It’s a fever dream with cutlery.

Go. Bring friends. Bring a map. Bring a sense of wonder.

And pray to the traffic gods on your way back — they might just grant you mercy.

author: Hannah Tohir
review_text: The atmosphere is comfortable with artistic decoration, but the food is mediocre for me compared to the price. The mocktails have no taste, too much water from melted ice cubes. The service is slow because there are no staff available to serve the overflowing customers who are looking for a beautiful Christmas atmosphere. We had to wait 1 hour for the food to arrive and they didn't prepare spoons and forks, because I was so hungry, imagine the steak pieces being taken by hand.

author: Ray Ray
review_text:
Went there with family. Luckily it's the period of time kids can come in.

I went in through the stairs entrance. But turns out there's a ground level entrance. The design of the place is really cool. As if being thrown back to the old times full of luxury vibes.

Ordered the food and drinks. Unfortunately kids do not enjoy the food. And there's no kids option. Well that makes sense, since the concept i guess supposed to be a lounge. Even the main centerpoint is actually this cool looking bar with the top shelf is like 4 or 5 meters high.

But aside from there's no kids food option, among all the food i ordered, only 1 of them i can say that i think is good and will order more.

The drink collection is impressive though. But since i was there with family, couldn't give them a try.

So next time when returning, will try the drinks.

author: Karel K. Himawan
review_text:
Loved the Christmas decoration and the overall place felt special.

The food was well-cooked, but portion wise it was too small. The food we ordered also took longer to arrive.

An overall good experience.

author: B Y
review_text: Very disappointing experience. The decorations and atmosphere is good. but after we sat at the bar and were constantly pestered to order cocktails. In about 10 minutes, the barista asked at least five times if I was going to order one. It felt pushy and annoying.. when I decide, I’ll order. I dont know if they get cut from if i order one. Didnt understand why rushing me? I came there to relax not annoy like this. The cocktails are extremely overpriced and low quality for what you get. Overall, this place is charging European prices for a very mediocre experience. I left feeling like I wasted my money. Would not recommend at all.

author: Nindita L
review_text:
A memorable evening at Phoenix Gastrobar by Holywings ✨
Crispy bites, sizzling skewers, comforting pasta and hearty mains paired with creative cocktails, all enjoyed in a breathtaking interior with stunning design details.
The live band and grand bar ambience made the night truly special. 🎶🍸

author: NG BB
review_text: Impresses with its elegant interior—classic European charm with a grand, cozy vibe. The cocktails are not only delicious but also come with a wow-worthy presentation that adds to the experience. It's a perfect spot to unwind and enjoy quality drinks with friends in a stylish setting. A great blend of atmosphere and creativity.

author: Vny Cia
review_text:
Come to there, walk in in saturday, and got booked at 21.00 with min MC 1 million
The decoration for Xmas too great, their service also good

author: REGINAwongXIAOyi
review_text: Spend 2.2 million cocktails are amazing, surprisingly food tastes amazing. Ambience and live band is totally 5 stars. Not a single miss from all our order. The server Husky is fantastic, takes amazing photos  🤩😍

author: arir
review_text:
To order: Trash Can Nachos, Cockburn Special Reserve (w ice!), Ribeye MB 6-7, Truffle Mashed Potato, Creamy Spinach, Salmon Coulibiac

Don’t order: Chili Crab Bun

author: Diva Navy S
review_text: amazing experience! The food was great, the vibe was beautiful, and the service was super nice!! perfect for special nights🥰

author: Putri Maharani
review_text: the place is pretty cool, lots of alcohol choices and the vibe is kinda fun. i’m not even sure how to review it properly, but overall it was a nice experience.

author: Gloria Zho
review_text:
We had a lovely lunch at Phoenix Restaurant and truly enjoyed every moment. The ambience is beautiful,elegant yet cozy and the food was absolutely savoury and satisfying.

A special appreciation goes to Mr. Bagas, who was so kind, enthusiastic, and willing to help us take photographs. His cheerful attitude and excellent service made our dining experience even more memorable.

All the staff are very polite, friendly, and welcoming, which made us feel right at home. We’re very satisfied with everything and would definitely love to visit again when we return to Jakarta. 💕

author: meta meidia
review_text:
Came here on a Sunday night with a reservation and paid a deposit. The place is very nice and aesthetic.

The service from the staff was amazing, starting from giving us a welcome drink, taking us to our table, and offering to help us take photos at good spots.

The food is delicious but I think the menu choices should be expanded

The last thing I like the most is the live music.

Overall I am satisfied and happy to come here 🩶

author: Dio Afiari
review_text: The food was great, and the ambience is amazing with the warmth vibrant on it. but the service is kinda slow, already ordered mathilda's chocolate at the first time ordering, but when im asking it to be showed after meal, i need to wait more than 40+ minutes, and theres a waiter using eyeglasses seems so rude due to not friendly on talking with customers. please be more polite, we're here not free, and with the price i've paid u guys should be more trained.

author: Ryan Kim
review_text: HW Phoenix Bar PIK offers an exceptional interior and atmosphere, standing out as one of the most impressive cocktail bars I've visited. The sophisticated design and ambiance truly elevate the experience. However, the cocktails didn’t quite live up to the same standard. While the drinks were enjoyable, they lacked the finesse and depth one might expect from such an upscale venue. It’s still worth visiting for the atmosphere, but there’s room for improvement in the drink quality.

author: Veamas Wahyu Saputra
review_text: Great atmosphere and service, thou the fnb is pricey, it's worth it

author: Novita Wu
review_text: Great place to hang out with friends here, foods are okay. The interior is great, it’s as if you are being in the set of the Great Gatsby. It’s super aesthetic. Slightly difficult for vegetarian goers, as they don’t have much options for vegetarians.

author: Catarina B
review_text:
The service was lovely as usual for ubud / Bali and the interior gives off the vibe of a cool european wine bar. The food was just ok, nothing special and quite expensive for this area/the portion size. The highlight was the flatbread.
Also maybe it was an oversight that I was sat downstairs alone but as a solo dinner I found it to have no vibe whatsoever and a bit overwhelming to have all the staff looking at me eat.
They did give me a free granita at the end which was a very nice gesture, but doesn’t detract from the fact that a grilled chicken breast, a flatbread and 2 glasses of wine was >600k

author: Sarah Marie
review_text: Japanese Thai Indonesian fusion at its best. A rare gem that just popped up a month ago. Delicious food, a solid variety of cocktails, coffee & teas, great ambiance (especially at the bar), super friendly and attentive staff, ideal also for solo travellers. Loved every bit of it and would come back anytime soon - be it only for the tuna sashimi 🤩! Very malam ( = nice) indeed!!

author: David Pinkstone
review_text:
The evening began across the road, waiting to cross in the busy traffic… when the bar man from Malam Gastro Bistro, saw us and ran out… literally stopped traffic and allowed us to safely enter this food heaven.

The service already was above and beyond! Very attentive. The food was amazing. So delicious and fresh. The waiter came out and explained everything of our menu as she placed it down. It was all just a great experience.

Unfortunately… we don’t have enough nights to experience the full menu, which all looked delicious!

Thank you team Malam Gastro Bistro.

author: Max St. John
review_text:
One of my new favourite restaurants in Ubud. For food we had the Japanese salad, eggplant, bone marrow, and lamb kebab. For desert we had a burnt cheesecake and they gave us a complimentary yuzu gratina sorbet.

Everything was great with standout dishes being the Japanese salad and bone marrow.

Staff was great and the restaurant is modern and nicely styled. Will be back again!

author: eleanor sedgwick
review_text:
We accidentally found ourselves here and it was the best impromptu date we’ve had in a long time! The vibe is what brought us in - super inviting, cool but warm, great tunes and all of the staff are just SO attentive and caring.
The menu has been skillfully curated and the chefs executed everything so beautifully.
Honestly couldn’t recommend this place enough. It’s perfect for a solo pop in, an afternoon drink with friends or a date. Love that there’s upstairs outdoor seating, restaurant seating or the option to sit at the bar downstairs. We’ll definitely be back.
DO NOT MISS THE MANGO SALAD 🧡

author: Yesle Hong
review_text:
The best dinner in Bali, Ubud!
The staff were kind and friendly as well as the food was just amazing! Grilled fish was just top and the lamb kebab was amazing too. Please make sure to visit here!

author: Kira Noire
review_text: My new favorite place in Ubud! The food is delicious, rich flavors, pleasant balance. Very nice atmosphere and great service. And they have good selection of vine by glass.

author: Ghobhi Rajah
review_text:
A few days ago we were just wandering around Ubud and stumbled upon this restaurant. The chef himself popped out to say they’d be opening on 26th Aug. So when the day came, we thought, “Why not? Let’s go check it out.” 0 expectations, just wanted to support a new spot.

The place itself was beautiful... downstairs had this vibey bar seating, while upstairs gave you the option of indoor coziness or breezy outdoor tables.

Food-wise, we went for baked bone marrow tartare, scallops, belly, and octopus. The bone marrow? Absolute flavour bomb... like butter got an MBA in richness. The scallops with unagi sauce were perfectly grilled, and that belly… usually by the third bite I’ll be, satiated to a point of aversion but here they balance it so well with fresh ulam that I kept going. Then the claypot octopus showed up with soft bread on the side.

But honestly, the real show-stealer was the cocktail menu. I’ve tried some of Asia’s Top 50 bars, and sometimes the drinks sound fancy but taste like a confused science experiment. Here though, every cocktail felt Michelin-level. Imagine sipping bourbon with a subtle peanut finish, or a lemongrass cocktail spiked with curry leaves... sounds odd, but it was magic.

We left really grateful for the whole experience. It felt extra special since it doubled as our little celebration after completing the Maybank Bali Full Marathon. This place is a gem... I’m pretty sure in a few months you’ll need to book weeks in advance.

author: Emily T
review_text: This was our favourite meal during our week in Ubud.  This was just the perfect meal with the perfect service that we felt we had no choice but to tell people to come to this newly opened restaurant!  The decor and mood was on point (I love an open kitchen where you can see their expertise), with incredible cocktails and beautifully balanced food.  Pls try the ginger flower cocktail (we loved that all the cocktails were made with local/native ingredients), crab noodles (I’m sad I can’t have it again soon), bone marrow and raspberry pistachio tart - all 10/10 and thoughtful dishes.  Our waiter was very kind and noticed that there were a few mozzies upstairs while we sat near the window (part of being in Bali at night), and he specifically went out of his way to go out to buy us insect repellant spray!  That was so thoughtful and deserves a special mention.  If this wasn’t our last night in Ubud we would’ve been back again!

author: Полина Николаева
review_text: An absolute gem! The cocktails were creative and perfectly balanced, the food was delicious and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was matched only by the impeccable, friendly service. A perfect evening. One of the best bistros in Bali

author: Sofya Krasulya
review_text: Super nice new spot in Ubud center: stylish interior, well-trained staff, and truly delicious food — all 5 dishes were fine dining level. Chef, bravo. As a typography designer, I couldn’t help but notice the chic signage and all logo details in interior, oh I was delighted by those handles too. Thanks guys, you’ve created a really cool place!

author: michele orian
review_text:
I didn’t have any word for describing this dinner, one of the best restaurant in Ubud 100%!
The taste of food was unbelievable!
I’ll recommend to everyone, i’m from Italy and i love eating in the place like this one, score:10/10 quality food:10/10 Service:9.5

author: Imran Haziq Bin Khairul Anuar
review_text: The ambience of the restaurant feels very Indonesian with plenty of mirrors and trees that create a maze-like atmosphere. There are also some steps inside so please be a little careful when moving around. One of the highlights is the seating arrangement as every table offers a good sense of privacy which makes dining here even more enjoyable. The food is absolutely delicious with bold flavors that truly capture the essence of Indonesian cuisine. I especially loved the sambal tempe. The only drawback was the service which was a bit slow.

author: Iqbal M Salleh
review_text: The food tasted great. The at atmosphere is very cozy and quite private. The decor is stunning. Traditional Indonesian dish. Overall, I like it.

author: Nizam Abdul Aziz
review_text:
Came here after reading all of the positive reviews from tourists visiting Indonesia - had a brief wait since the place was full even after the lunch rush, but was eventually seated.

The menu was akin to an encyclopaedia but it was certainly very helpful to have pictures of all of the dishes available to order together with a brief description of each dish - eventually decided on the Nasi Campur Medan Padang Bulan, Sate Sambal Mentah & Soto Kayo Lamogan, all of which was great! The soto was one of the best I’ve tasted. While there were certainly a lot of options for dessert, ended off with what I know which was Jus Aplukat and Es Teler.

Would come back to try the other items on the menu

author: Syakirah AJ
review_text:
A restaurant serving local Indonesian foods with variety of options. Quite popular among Malaysian tourists. This place can get crowded and a long queue during peak period. When I went there (around 5:30pm), I didn't have to wait too long.

They gave us maximum 2 hours per entry. The employees were very nice and polite. Price wise, a bit pricey but so worth it with quality of foods they are serving.

My mum's favourite dessert is Es Cendol Tapai. We ordered Cumi Sambal Matah Uluwatu and it was delicious. We ended up coming to Remboelan twice during our 4-day Jakarta trip at 2 different locations: Grand Indonesia and Kota Kasablanka.

author: Zainal Mubarak
review_text: Rembolan Restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with a strong focus on authentic flavors and warm hospitality. The menu presents a variety of traditional dishes that are both flavorful and satisfying, with portions generous enough to share. The standout for me was the grilled seafood—fresh, perfectly cooked, and seasoned just right. The ambience is cozy and inviting, with tasteful décor that makes you feel at home. Service is generally attentive and friendly, though during peak hours it can be a little slower. Prices are abit high for the top few malls in indonesia but; for the quality of food, making it value for money. While there’s still a bit of room for improvement in speed of service and drink variety, overall, Rembolan is a great choice for a casual yet memorable meal. I’ll definitely be coming back.

author: Nur Humaira
review_text: We went here during weekday, so the queue was quick. The portion was quite huge and what we ordered can be easily shared between three people. Highly recommended!

author: Shazrul Idhlan
review_text: Lovely place with very nice decor. They have a huge number of great Indonesian food and the taste is awesome. Highly recommended for your Indonesian food cravings. Do come before 1pm because when we left the line was very long and wait times could be hours.

author: SY Tan
review_text: Love the wide selection of indo food here! Food came very quickly too and I love their spicy nasi goreng as well as the side dishes (not the chicken satay which was too sweet for my liking)

author: Samantha L
review_text:
amazing food, best meal i had in jakarta. for sure it's a little more expensive than the other meals i've had, but this restaurant definitely has quality.

favourite dish was the sotong (CUMI)!

author: Sweetprincess Honey
review_text:
We visited this well-known restaurant two days ago, popular among both Malaysians and Indonesians. We arrived around 11 a.m., just before the lunch crowd, and there were only one or two groups ahead of us on the waiting list. The staff took our name and asked us to wait nearby. After about 5–6 minutes, we were called in.

Before entering, we were informed of a 2-hour dining time limit, which was understandable due to the restaurant’s popularity. A staff member guided us to our table, and we were provided with menu books (quite thick with many choices) and the option to scan a QR code for digital ordering.

We took about 10 minutes to decide and ended up ordering:
• Nasi Bakar Ayam Asap – wrapped in banana leaf, tasted good with generous filling, though the flavor was more subtle.
• Nasi Goreng Sapi (forgot the exact name)– delicious, slightly spicy, and served in a generous portion.

We only ordered small mineral water, as we weren’t too hungry and had already had a lot of sweet food and drinks earlier.

As for the environment, the place felt crowded and a bit cramped. The tables were quite close to each other, and it was noisy, especially with a nearby family talking loudly.

The walking space between aisles was narrow, and on our way out, it was a bit confusing to navigate due to partitions separating sections. I even ended up in the wrong aisle before finding the right way out.

author: Gilmanos 94
review_text: Celebrated Mother’s Day at Remboelan Grand Indonesia and had a great time. The ambience was comfortable and inviting, and the food featured flavors from different parts of Indonesia that were really enjoyable. Everything came together nicely, making it a relaxed yet special way to celebrate with family.

author: Cromex Makine ve Dis Ticaret Ltd. Sti.
review_text:
I recently visited Rambolean in Jakarta and had a truly enjoyable dining experience. The restaurant has gone through a renewal of their chain, and the improvements are clear—from the ambiance to the service and especially the food.

What stood out most was the authentic taste of Indonesian cuisine, prepared with care and a modern touch. Each dish was flavorful and well-balanced, allowing me to appreciate traditional ingredients in a refreshed way. I particularly appreciated the attention to presentation and the welcoming attitude of the staff.

The revamped setting is cozy yet stylish, making it a great place for both casual meals and more intimate dinners. If you’re looking to experience Indonesian food in a refined yet accessible environment, Rambolean is definitely worth a visit. I’ll be coming back for more.

author: Mathurin Lohvithee
review_text: This restaurant was recommended by my Indonesian friend. I came with high expectations and was not disappointed. Everything here tastes so good, delicious and flavorful. I will definitely go back to dine here if I have a chance.

author: I Made Judistira
review_text: I usually eat at this restaurant in Plaza Senayan or Gandaria City, and this is my first time at Senayan City. Don't know why.. I think the food here tastes better. No wonder this place is always full. Highly recommended for those of you who want to eat Indonesian food.. 👍

author: mamacelho mamacelho
review_text: Nice & cozy place to eat. Everything is good, except for the sofa. I have difficulty sitting in a comfortable position on the sofa at table F1. Always makes me slide down while eating. The rest is perfectly nice. There is a sink inside the restaurant and clean.

author: pramoch r
review_text: This is the second location we went to. Same good food quality. The place offers a wide variety of food and drinks. Would suggest to visit with a group of friends so you can try several dishes. Were informed that the taste was very local and cater to a spectrum of customers. I love the fried rice topped with chicken. The drinks were also very refreshing. I say this is a go to place for Indonesian food!

author: Frisca Aprillia
review_text: The food was sooo bursting with flavor, i've had a spicy slowly kicking my mouth with nasi bakar cabe ijo sei sapi & ayam taliwang asap mandalika. Don't forget to order mie rebus pesisiran because they have the broth sooo delish umami🤌🤌Service was excellent, they willing to replace our es cendol because we tell them that was too sweet for the normal palm sugar, but we are so full. Keep up the best service and food!🤟

author: Lin Rudy
review_text:
The best Indonesian local casual dining chain. Wide variety selection of dishes from various Indonesia’s region specialties.

Highly recommended if you are a tourist or expats wanting wide options of Indonesia’s dishes.
As locals we approved the authenticity of these dishes.
Food are usually consistent throughout all chains across Indonesia.

author: ADRIAN
review_text: Amazing Indonesian food at Remboelan Senayan City! 🍲✨ Highly recommended!

author: Edwar Kartio
review_text:
What I remembered the most from this dining experience was the shock that I got from the "encyclopedia" of a menu. It was big and each of the dishes had these big pictures, truly overwhelming with the choices especially some of them that are not your typical famous Indonesian dishes. The portions of most of the dishes are not too big, perfect for sharing between 2 to 3 people which allows you to order many different things.
