I wouldn't recommend the tahu Gejrot as it wasn't that good but the rest of the food is decent. Service is a little slow granted it was on the weekend lunch time.
Food - 7
Service - 7
Vibe - 7
Price - $$

author: Mṻni Mash
review_text: Great interiors. Delicious Indonesian food. Ordered Gado gado, Cumi Sambal and some Kue to break fast during Ramadhan. Friendly staffs with great energy.

author: Wan Ling
review_text:
MUST EAT: Nasi Bakar (Beef)! The smokey flavour perfumes your mouth from the very first bite. The beef is super tender.

The second top dish is deep-fried fish with shredded mango, radish pickles & house sweet and sour sauce. The young mango is fragrant, refreshing and balances the fried fish so well!

Corn fritters with sambal roa is also very delicious. I can eat the sambal by itself!

Tahu telor was nice but forgettable. Save your stomach space for the above 3 dishes instead!

author: Handy Perdana
review_text: Food is okay, cleanliness needs to improve just a tad bit. Service is top notch. My favorites are the Gurame Parape Ujung Pandang and the Es Kopi Cengkeh

author: Pramuaji Pramono
review_text:
Written on Jan 22, 2024.

First time dining here, I thought it was one of those over-fancied and price-y restaurants with so-so savor. Turned out I was wrong. The price is relatively affordable, compared to other similar establishments, and the food tasted pretty great!

They place a button system on every table to call the waiters for ordering or requesting the check. They don't provide condiments and napkins on the tables, and the menu books (yes, plural, one for the main dish, and another for desserts and beverages) are ridiculously large!

I ordered the Bubur Candil for appetizer, Tahu Tek Telor Gunung Ijen for the main dish, and the usual sweet iced tea for beverage. All of them tasted great, and the serving time was satisfactory. Got all of my orders in less than 12 mins.

author: Kay
review_text: After the renovation, the restaurant’s atmosphere became much more upscale and bright, which I really liked. The food was excellent, and the service was also satisfying. I would definitely visit again!

author: Evan Tan
review_text:
This place looks real fancy from the outside, but it's much more affordable than most might think. Most of the food options are around 40-50k and though it could add up to a lot, most meals would cost about 100-150k per person (if you don't order whole fish dishes), which is an amazing deal considering how "snazzy" the place looks.

The food options overall were pretty good, and their dessert options actually impressed me.

I have no complaints simply because you truly are getting a bargain here and getting more than you would expect for the price that you're paying for it.

I would recommend and would most likely come back.

author: m. melody
review_text: Was worth starving myself the night before to get a table and eat early lunch the next day. The ambiance and location was impressive. Loads of dishes to choose from their menu. Excellent customer service. Will definitely come back.

author: Mohit Rohilla
review_text:
One should definitely visit this restaurant. New vibrant looks. Nice atmosphere. Team is super fast.

Food is really delicious.

author: Xinyang Long
review_text: 好吃，推荐。Local friend took me here, good atmosphere, authentic and delicious food, nice location and attitudes, will visit again if comes to Jakarta again.

author: Agil A. Fahrezy
review_text: The serving time is relatively quick, while maintaining the iconic taste of Indonesian cuisine. All of the food that we order are amazing, perfect combination of taste. The workers are humble and handle questions quite well. The atmosphere is also nice, calm and soothing, with no loud music or whatsoever.

author: Nadya Chandradewi (Nadya)
review_text: We did enjoy all the meals. Delicious Karedok, Tahu isi, Cumi, Nasi Bakoel & Dendeng Balado. Prices are affordable, too. Really worth the 5-star taste. Nothing compares to what Remboelan is cooking in their kitchen. Enak deh pokoknya. Highly recommended

author: Meidi Anhar
review_text: Remboelan is a highly-recommended  the authentic Indonesian cuisine,Friendly ServiceStaff are consistently described as friendly, interiors for being comfortable. The best 👍

author: Ellen Brigitta
review_text: They serve so many local menu, both food and desserts. Very good selection of menu and reasonable price too! We ended up ordering a lot, because all looks mouth watering and interesting. My favorite : lidah cabe ijo, cumi goreng crispy, es podeng, tape uli, colenak. The place layout is a bit weird with the circle in the middle and the problem is the aircon. When we came one part has problem with the ac so it felt hot. The thing that they need to improve : the receptionist. The one that receiving the call that is very arrogant and talked like robot and wouldnt answer nicely.

author: NURUL AINA BINTI MAZLAN ANUAR
review_text: makanannya enak. the staff also very tentative. love it here definitely will come again whenever im visiting Jakarta

author: Kezia Vania
review_text:
Had lunch at Remboelan and it was such a pleasant experience 🌤️✨

We ordered the Cumi Saos Padang, Cumi Goreng Sambal Matah Kecombrang, Iga, and Bistik Selat Solo. Everything was super flavorful! the Padang sauce had that perfect spicy kick, the sambal matah was fresh and fragrant, and the iga was fall-off-the-bone tender. The Bistik Selat Solo felt homey and comforting. For drinks, we got Es Leci and Es Teh Tarik — both were light, refreshing, and hit the spot.

The place is really cozy and beautifully set up, perfect for a relaxed family lunch. It feels homey, clean, and peaceful. Service was fast and friendly, everyone was super warm and helpful 🫶

Totally recommend this spot for a chill lunch with family. Great food, lovely ambiance, and good service all around.

author: Sailalith Sarupuri
review_text: Visited this restaurant recently and I was blown away by the experience. With an extensive menu offering a variety of authentic Indonesian dishes, it's no wonder this place is always bustling. It's advisable to secure a reservation ahead of time. The food was an absolute delight, not only in taste but also in presentation. If you're in search of an unforgettable culinary adventure, this restaurant should be at the top of your list.

author: Monica Febriana
review_text: Seribu Rasa always be my favorite Indonesia restaurant. Their menu was delicious and the service was great. I usually ordered fish head curry, fried tofu vegetable, sapo tahu.

author: Nara Story
review_text:
Always like the food here
Beef dishes are great
I just wish they have some petite cake for dessert so we don't have to walk to nearby place for dessert

author: Agatha Sitepu
review_text: Went here with a few friends. There was a wedding event on the first floor, so service was a bit slower and the food took a little longer to come out. Despite that, the staff were friendly and the food was really good. Would love to come back on a regular day

author: Justin Koswara
review_text: Its so unfortunate a restaurant with such amazing food have staff with subpar attitudes. Slow service, unresponsive management teams who talk back. Such a shame that we wont be coming back after years of eating here with the family.

author: Gita Primasari
review_text:
I have team lunch with my colleagues in here. Their place is quite pretty and the serving time is fast. Most of the fish menus price tag is “market price”.  So it’s quite surprise for us when we found out in bill that the grouper fish is cost 500k. I think you need strategy when you visit here. pick your dish well, then you will be happy when you are eating your food.
Food 4/5
Ambience 5/5
Service 4/5

author: Fathima Azzahra
review_text:
Beautiful place to dine in, i prefer during the day but having dinner here would also be nice. Great for couples or big groups, I came here with a group of 11 people.

The food is amazing, everything was well made. Some are more uniqus and special than others, like the seafood cakwe, jumbo prawn golden egg yolk, and dendeng balado!

author: Gabriela Caballero
review_text: The menu does not have western friendly food. Service is great!

author: Ricky Shandy Setiawan
review_text:
A good experience for iftar here a perfect meals and relaxed iftar. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, matched by impeccable service that enhances the iftar experience. Hygiene is top-notch, contributing to the overall appeal. They provide a prayer room as well.
The menu is a delightful journey through authentic local cuisine, capturing the true essence of traditional flavors. awesome for the exceptional service and food!

author: Rendra Budi Hutama
review_text: Recommended to celebrate special moment of your family or colleagues here. One of upper end Indonesian restaurant. The food was tasty, the service was really good. Can't complain.

author: Ino Iljas
review_text: A very fancy Indonesian restaurant, the food was good, the vibe of the resto was also nice, for parking we have to use valet service because they have a very limited parking space.

author: JoJo
review_text: I always take my visiting foreigner friends here. Good quality traditional food, with staff dressed in traditional clothing, playing traditional music in a more modern setting that still somehow showcase Indonesian culture. The food is a bit pricey, but it’s good and presented well - some with banana leaves, adding to the overall Indonesian cuisine exprience.

author: R W
review_text: Good indonesian food..but service below average andnatmosphere sterile due too bright lightning in main cavernous dining room

author: Jane
review_text: Nice restaurant with indonesian-style and thai-style dishes. Love the prawn, meat, fish and dessert menu

author: Jean-Christophe Blachere
review_text:
Good place to enjoy Indonesian food, even if it is produced in a bit standard way.
Service isn't great, with staff usually turning their back to the dining room

author: C K
review_text:
The deco is lovely and ambience is lively. There is good mix of tourists and locals. We came without reservation at dinner time (Tuesday) and were able to find a table for 2pax.
As a whole the food taste good especially the fried beancurd. Wanted a fish and the waitress was kind to warn us that this is by weight (per 100g) which we obviously didn’t notice the fine prints. Ordered grilled squid instead and it was good.

author: CHARLES BOTTE
review_text: Seribu Rasa = thousand flavors, is one of our favorite restaurants to eat Indonesian foods with friends, we like this restaurants because they can customize their menu into the vegetarian foods, because very often we have an overseas guests that's required a vegetarian foods.

author: brysca rentcar
review_text:
The Calamary was so bad , the size  was too small ( doesn't like the picture in the menu),

The Mango Salad wa the worse ever & also  too pricely,
my guests was so disappointed.

author: Mohammad Ilham
review_text:
to someone who may get lost finding this place, this restaurant is placed on L4 near an escalator.

I ordered a labuan colada + mallacan nasi lemak
mallacan nasi leak: the taste is good, however in my case the nasi uduk is said by the waiter thay the quality is bad so she offered me whether I want to seal it with original rice or not, but I opted for original rice. beef rendang beef is very soft and easy to bite but still maintain the texture of the beef. the prawn also taste excellent, because the texture is kinda soft but bouncy means the prawn is fresh. overall the taste I perfect, but - the nasi uduk.
labuan colada: so this beverages consist of orange, coconut, and bananas. the combination is perfect, each of the component synergies each other and give an utterly new experience to me. however this drink is taste a little bit heavy, it's not thay fresh because of the bananas and coconut isn't designed for fresh taste at the first.

the atmosphere is great and the waiters is very hospital. I ask whether they provide a single place (as I come alone) and turns out he gives me the entire table consist of 4 seats to me. overall it's a great experience.

author: Hardiwanto Yongkong
review_text:
Fine dining with Indonesian flavor taste.

Food 4/5
Fresh seafood and high quality ingredients from veg to meat. Using a lot of indonesian spice combination. Pricey but you can get high quality dishes in here. Recommend menu : Ayam Goreng Serundeng and Sapo Tahu.

Ambience 5/5
Good ambience, a lot of seats for groups. They even have vip room for your special events.

Service 5/5
Excellent table service, waitress can explain their menu even when their dishes will be served.

author: leslie yeoh
review_text: Nice restaurant with variety of food selections. Foods portion is just nice for 2 pax and price is reasonable. The staffs are friendly too.

author: Bas
review_text:
Good food.
Need a little clean up on the window, kind of dirty, wherr we sit.

author: Shekharr Bhagat
review_text:
I struggled to get a meal here, staff nodded and took notes for dietary preferences but then what was served had to be taken back twice since both times they didn’t bother to factor the dietary preferences.

This is the first Indonesian restaurant that couldn’t get their classic Nasi Goreng right :)

author: Eldrie Abdul KADIR
review_text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Seribu Rasa, where traditional Indonesian flavors are presented in a beautifully premium and luxurious environment. The ambiance was calm, elegant, and perfect for both casual dining and special occasions.

Every dish we tried brought out the authentic taste of Indonesia, with rich spices and well-balanced flavors. The mango salad was a refreshing start – tangy, sweet, and light. We also enjoyed the kangkung goreng which was crispy and full of wok aroma, the golden prawn butter Siam style that was rich, creamy, and flavorful, and the ayam goreng kampung – crispy on the outside, tender and juicy inside. Everything tasted delicious and satisfying.

The presentation, service, and quality truly reflected a premium dining experience, while still staying true to traditional roots. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy genuine Indonesian cuisine with a refined touch.

author: winni weaver
review_text: I highly recommend this restaurant because the manager, Mr. Riki, provides outstanding service to his customers. He goes above and beyond to ensure that every guest has a pleasant dining experience. Additionally, he makes sure that the kitchen staff prepares meals to the highest standards. This establishment delivers food and service comparable to that of Michelin-star restaurants. Keep up the fantastic work, Mr. Riki!

author: Azis Muslim
review_text: a comfortable place to use as a place to gather, talk, or meetings and taste quality Indonesian cuisine

author: Budhy Heru
review_text: Then place for eating with your colleagues with the utmost atmosphere, so exclusive, and enough variety of menus.

author: Rifki Debi
review_text: The servers are very nice. They can also recommend food. The service was fast (maybe because we were the only customers that time). Out of the food we have ordered (we also ordered Kerapu with Padang sauce, but I didnt take a picture of it), what I like the most is Tahu Kinabalu! Haha. Very soft inside but crispy outside. But almost everything we had was yummy. And it comes with a price. For example, for a plate of tofu, it can cost you around 60k++.

author: Jerry Min
review_text: The menu doesn't show whether a dish is spicy or not... Staff didn't pay much attention to customers sitting in the corner...Definitely not worth the price.

author: Massimiliano Lombardo
review_text:
5 minutes walking from the very city centre (Grand Plaza and the 5 stars hotels) this is a high level journey through the main south east asian cuisines with a predominant Indonesian taste.
Wonderful location
Not so good the beverage, only few wine cellars are available despite they are in the list which has a good variety of.
Considering the location, the atmosphere and the quality of the dishes the price is a very good deal.
Recommended

author: Ryan Tanjung
review_text: I truly enjoyed having a meeting and dinner at this restaurant. The authentic Indonesian food was exceptionally tasteful, with rich flavors that really stood out. I also loved the ambience — warm, comfortable, and perfect for both casual dining and professional discussions. It was a pleasant place to unwind while still staying productive. No worries, I will definitely be back, especially with my academic colleagues on future occasions.

author: Fix Mobile Central
review_text: The environment was cozy and relaxing. Food overall was great. All the menu that we ordered was rich of taste which synchronize with the restaurant name “Seribu Rasa”. Highly recommended.

author: Sparkly Freeze
review_text:
✨ A Five-Star Indonesian Dining Experience!

Beautiful, elegant, and full of authentic Indonesian flavors — this restaurant delivers a top-notch culinary journey through the archipelago. No wonder it’s a favorite among expats and locals alike who are looking for refined, delicious Indonesian cuisine in a stylish setting.

📍The location is strategic and easily accessible from many parts of Jakarta.

🚗 Note: Parking is limited, so it’s best to come early or use ride-hailing apps.

A must-visit spot for entertaining guests or enjoying a special night out. Definitely one of the top Indonesian restaurants in town! 🍽️✨

author: Christine Ho
review_text: Nice place for good Indonesian food. If coming in big groups, best to make reservations. We were disappointed that the dishes that we wanted to eat were not available eg the coconut seafood andaman and giant squid. Normally, other restaurants' service staff will recommend other dishes in place of dishes that were not available but it was not done here. More could have been done for service wise compared to other Indonesian restaurants that we had visited. The other dishes that we ordered were well executed.

author: david Hurst
review_text: Great place for work, friends or family dinner. Well cooked food and nice atmosphere. I have been a few times before and it’s consistently good.

author: Jessica Tirza
review_text:
My partner and I were very well taken care of at Seribu Rasa. The team was wonderful and made us feel truly welcomed especially Kak Dea who gave us a very good impression.
Many Thanks and will definitely come back!

author: MAA 91
review_text:
All-in top notch experience!

Contacted the HQ reservation team, enquiring on private room and celebration decoration. All went smoothly and was given the 10-pax private room which was equipped with washing sync with towels and handfoam. There is a minimum spending of IDR 4mil for the 10-pax room, but with around 6 pax, you can easily reach that.

On the food and beverage, everything was good and was prepared exceptionally. Our favourite was the salted egg jumbo prawns. Finger licking good! Menu was extensive and you could easily come here many times to repeat and rotate your choices.

Yummeh!

author: Taksaorn Sirikantaramas
review_text: I came alone so had only few menus. Grilled chicken with lemongrass was so good, the sauce is like satay sauce which is flavorful and goes well with the grilled chicken. Dessert was also nice with tropical fruits. Restaurant decoration is great.

author: Sunli Zynski
review_text: a lux choice for dinnee with family and coworkers. they have so many dishes from all over indonesia. the staffs are so nice and friendly and QUICK. the minus is with the dessert. they should do R&D for it.

author: John
review_text: Excellent food, grest service.  But the perfume is very strong and smells synthetic.  Eating places should not be so heavily perfumed.

author: Chan MeowMeow
review_text:
We came early, so we got a table for walk in at 5.30pm. Excellent atmosphere with wonderful Indonesian food.
We tried the tofu starter which was amazing (not spicy). The curry dish for me was a bit spicy, but nice with the bread that it came with. Will certainly visit again.

author: Cahyo Rubiyanto
review_text: This is my very first time to visit Seribu Rasa and got recommend from my colleague in Singapore, He told me to try the foods in this restaurant. And Yes finally I come and get excited for every single dishes. My favorite one is Seafood Cakue, at least you have to try. Absolutely will come again!

author: David Tomsic
review_text: They should advertise prices that you actually pay.  Charging 25% on top of menu prices is not acceptable. And when you complain, all of a sudden no one speaks English.

author: Abb T.
review_text:
Stunningly delicious food, loved that they prepared the food in such a fresh and balanced flavour.

The grilled squid, sambal kangkong are some of the best that I’ve tried. If possible I would return again and again.

This restaurant is a must visit if you are craving to have Indonesian food. The price is reasonable too!

The atmosphere itself is beautiful and calming, it’s a villa by itself.

author: Jas Singh
review_text: Great food, authentic flavours, attentive staff in a relaxed environment

author: Nadya Larasati
review_text: Wonderful atmosphere and great selections of Indonesian food. Family friendly, seatings are spacious, and service is great.

author: Jeanne Herawati
review_text: Very good food indonesian fusion, fast service, very kind staff, homie environment 👍🏻

author: Ryan Kim
review_text:
My experience at Seribu Rasa was good. The restaurant captures the essence of Indonesian cuisine without losing a touch of modern flair. The food was delicious overall, providing a great opportunity to explore the diverse flavors of Indonesia.

However, the seasoning was a bit strong for my taste. While this can be understood given the bold spices and flavors characteristic of Indonesian cuisine, it might be slightly overwhelming for those with a more delicate palate. Nevertheless, Seribu Rasa is a fantastic place to enjoy Indonesian food. The variety on the menu and the richness of flavors allowed me to fully experience the vibrant culinary culture of Indonesia.

Overall, Seribu Rasa is a restaurant worth visiting. I look forward to tailoring my menu choices more to my personal taste on my next visit for an even more satisfying meal.

author: N Liang
review_text:
Booked for vvip last week and found that their private room really needs renovation where we can see the furniture is old. Dining table was too low, AC was too old although there were more than 1 unit, we were still sweating.
Soft shell crab and squid were awesome, noodle was tasty but a little spicy, tiger prawn was fresh and tasty. Overall, tasty and generous portion. Maybe the restaurant can add more toilets coz currently they only have 1 toilet for ladies and 1 for men at the dining area. And the other toilets were at the basement which makes it not convenient for vvip to go down.

author: Mesi Fransiska
review_text: The food was avarage, the staffs weren't that nice, they barely smile to us, the view was just bamboo tree.

author: B E V V Y J I L L
review_text:
The Best Babi Guling in Ubud! 🐷

One of the reasons I love Bali is because of its amazing food, and for me, Babi Guling Oka 3 serves the best babi guling in town!
When I first visited Bali in February 2024, my driver highly recommended it and I’m so glad he did! The flavors were unforgettable, making it a must-visit for me every time I return.When I returned to Bali in October, I knew I had to come back. However, due to a feast, they were closed for three days, and I had to patiently wait before I could satisfy my cravings. But when they finally reopened OMG, it was so worth it! I ended up buying a lot because I just couldn’t resist.

🔹 The Babi Guling – The crispy skin, tender and juicy meat, and perfectly blended spices make this dish absolutely irresistible!

🔹 Authenticity – This is the best and most authentic babi guling I’ve ever had in Bali, especially in Ubud.

🔹 Consistency – Even after months, the quality and taste remain top-notch, making it a must-visit every time I’m in Bali.

If you’re ever in Ubud, you CANNOT miss Babi Guling Oka 3.  It’s hands-down the best place for babi guling, and a place that keeps me coming back to Bali

author: Rain
review_text: The place is a little hard to find but the food was great! Probably one of our favorite food in Ubud

author: Soo Yeo
review_text:
So miserable and deflating to see all the cockatoos chained and stressed. Won't support this kind of business.

I left this place being stressed at the end.

Also got bitten by one cockatoo while I was speaking to a resident next to the restaurant.
When I reported this to a restaurant staff, he said
"It is okay. I got bitten too." showing his thumb with a permanent scar. It was the resident who helped putting a bandaid for me. No antibacterial ointment prepared.

Babi guling taste was average.

author: Omar
review_text: Very interesting food to taste. The spices and the texture of the different meats served. If you’re a foodie, you should visit. The atmosphere is really nice. It’s a hidden calm corner with w decent view of a forest for a relaxing meal.

author: Elisha Peterson S. K. Teo
review_text: Very good Babi Guling. This outlet number 3 is my favorite. It’s a little hard to find but is actually the home of Ibu Oka. Nestled in a very green area.

author: Andy Southern
review_text:
Really tasty, I had the Special, which comes with a bit of everything, however I especially recommend the battered and deep fried meat, sooo good.

Very reasonable as well.

Good juices also.

author: Leepin Won
review_text: Very delicious and authentic babi guling in Ubud. The meat is nicely marinated, the side vege is authentic Balinese taste, the blood sausage is also the traditional one. The crispy pork skin is a must to try. I specifically love the sitting area at the patio, the eating atmosphere is wonderful! If you look for authentic Balinese Babi guling, here is the best one. Will always come back here for nasi babi guling since many years!

author: Vivian Vivian
review_text:
The roasted pork should be the best part but not that really WOW us as we expected cuz if I have to compared with roasted pork skin we had, this is not really really the most amazing one lah. And the pork meat feel a bit try and the skin is not so crispy as we expected and less juicy.

But I give the credit to their juice which taste so good not so sweet.

author: Sukay Thwe
review_text: The taste is great. I would admit that this is the best Babi Guling around Bali. Crispy pork and curry paste are super delicious. But I don’t like the atmosphere that much. Location is hard to find.

author: April S
review_text: You can’t come to Ubud and not visit their notorious Ibu Oka chain! I had their roast pork special that came with extra crackling, rice and a vegetable broth soup on the side. This place is very clean!

author: Lincoln Martinez II
review_text: We got the full plate no soup with a side of fried pork. It was fantastic. The pork skin are fried pork were the pest parts.

author: Stanley C
review_text: We went at around 2pm so very few customers were there and staff was cleaning up. Food was exceptional and the view to the bamboo forest was nice. Must try if you come to Bali.

author: Helen Benson
review_text: It’s still the best babi guling around.  However the setting of the original place is so much nicer.  We went for the food.  The traffic was too bad and we couldn’t reach Ubud, so we settled for Ibu Oka 2.  The portions were generous, the food was good and fresh.  And proper fresh pressed orange juice.

author: Dimas Wijaya
review_text:
Recently, we visited this restaurant on the recommendation of our tour guide—just a day after trying Warung Babi Guling Pande Egi—which made it the perfect chance to compare the two.

This time, we ordered the Babi Guling (without the soup, since it’s not really our preference) along with a side of crispy pork skin. The flavors here were spot on: the roasted pork was savory and well-seasoned, and everything came together beautifully with the lawar. The pork skin added that extra crunch, making the meal even more satisfying.

Overall, I’d say the taste here edges out the other place we tried. If you’re in Gianyar, Bali, this spot is definitely worth a visit for an authentic and delicious Babi Guling experience.

author: Doug Nguyen
review_text:
Good Indonesian comfort food at a great value. The babi guling was very flavorful, along with the crispy skin. The fried pork dish was surprisingly nice as well.

Good stop on the way back to Seminyak from Ubud.

author: The Lost Forest Mum
review_text:
We visited Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka 2 during our trip to Ubud and it truly lived up to the hype. The roasted pig was incredibly crispy on the outside and tender inside, full of rich Balinese spices. The set meal came with rice, spicy sambal, blood sausage, and vegetables, flavorful and satisfying. It’s a casual, local-style eatery with quick service. Go early, as the best parts like the crackling skin sell out fast. A must-try spot for authentic Balinese food lovers!

2 🌟 - Below Average: Needs improvement in multiple areas, not meeting expectations.
3 🌟 - Standard, Average: Meets basic expectations, nothing exceptional but acceptable.
4 🌟 - Standard, Above Average: Exceeds expectations slightly, better than the norm.
5 🌟 - Special & Unique: Outstanding experience, highly memorable and exceptional.

author: polly
review_text: The babi guling was so moist and delicious with crunchy skin. Restaurant was spacious and clean. Generous portioned meal. We enjoyed it.

author: sanny phong
review_text: Nasi Guling special comes with complimentary soup. The meat is tender. However, dishes is not hot, maybe prepared for some times. It has served with spicy sauce and only sauce is hot though. Avocado juice is nice and it is recommended. Overall food is good

author: YZYZY Yeung
review_text: We had tried this BBQ Pork Rice for lunch, we ordered Soup, Spesial Pisah, Pork Skin, Young Coconut. Food is ok and a bit spicy but the rice little bit hard, the pork skin is crunchy, if you like the pork meat you can try this restaurant.

author: Janu Prado
review_text:
Filipino Review 🇵🇭🍽️

Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka 2 is a well-known spot for trying Bali’s famous roasted suckling pig. The crispy skin and tender, flavorful meat make it a must-try for pork lovers 🐷🔥. The spices are bold and aromatic, though they might be a bit strong for some Filipino tastes 🌶️.

Funny enough, we were brought here by our Muslim driver—who, of course, didn’t eat, but he mentioned that many tourists tell him they love this place! 😂 The restaurant has a casual, local vibe, but it can get crowded. Service is fast, and the prices are reasonable for the quality of food.

Overall, a great place to experience authentic Balinese babi guling, but be ready for bold flavors and a lively atmosphere!

author: Johnnie Victor Ferrer
review_text:
We came to this restaurant which is quite near the villa we were staying at while in Mas Village in Ubud, Bali. Babi guling is one of the iconic food in Bali which I wanted my family to try. Apparently this is the 2nd time for me to be in this particular restaurant. I was also there before the pandemic, when I first went to Bali.

Food was good. Although my family found the food quite spicy.

The place hasn't changed as far as I could remember. It has this oldish feel which I think needs upgrading.

Service is ok. We didn't wait that long before our orders were served.

author: Antony Lim
review_text:
Initially we asked our driver to bring us to a local warung where the locals will go, he brought us here. Well I am not sure if it is a place where locals will go, the food here is good!

We ordered Spesial Pisah, the portion is very generous. If you are not a big eater, I suggest sharing instead.

The staff was also very honest with us, their pork skin was fried. Overall it was a very good meal.

author: Bill Lin
review_text:
In my memory when I used to work in Indonesia, this BBQ Pork Rice tasted way better than this time I brought my family to.

This time the pork was served cold and less flavored, lack of the "Balinese taste" it used to carry.

author: Nat T.
review_text: Just like many tourists, we were bought here by our guide instead of original babi guling place we wanted to go to. However, it is ok because the food was good and came out quick, allowing us to quickly get to other sightseeing place. The restaurant was also quiet as we visited on a weekday lunch time allowing us to unwind a bit on a long day. Price was reasonable with food for 2 + 1 beer coming out to around $11.

author: David Zhang
review_text:
We showed up late after they ran out of pork skin, but despite that the food was still pretty good
I really enjoyed the fried green chili. They have if you want to add some spice to your food.

author: Lucas
review_text:
Bali’s best Babi Guling!
We were instantly intrigued by this famous dish as we arrived on the island but we were in search of something fresher and tastier. We found it here!
An abundance of fresh and delicious meat, salad and sauce! The price was exceptional and we left feeling supremely satisfied x

author: WorstDad
review_text:
Overall, had an acceptable dining experience at this branch. We reached at about 3.30pm and the restaurant was largely empty save for 2 tables. The waitress informed that the kulit guling has been sold out hence opted for kulit goreng instead. I think the goreng version is a lot better hence no complaints. Service was good with constant smiles from the waitress. A few issues that I see with this branch:-

1. Flies. There were quite a number of flies inside the restaurant despite it being air conditioned. I see that the front glass door to be constantly open hence could be where the flies penetrate in. This was a nuisance when we dined.
2. Cash only restaurant. No other form of payment is accepted.
3. Smokers. There was a table of gentlemen who were smoking inside the restaurant. I find this a bit shocking for an air conditioned establishment.

The saving grace was the food. It remained good thru the years hence weighing out the issues which I have highlighted above. This branch seems to be the better one of the chain hence I hope the proprietor would ensure it lives up to what is is suppose to be.

author: 林千尋
review_text:
Tasty babi guling, me personally feels tourists friendly spiciness. Soup is very mild with many vegetables.
This location is easier to access to avoid traffic jam compared as other branches.
Beer is not super cold and price setting is for tourists are reasons I didn't put 5stars.

author: Natasha Tjahjadi
review_text: Still really good, today the shop ran out of skin at around 2pm - offered to be replaced by gorengan (fried pork), was sooo good and they gave a lot more than expected. Really good!

author: Brian Beardon
review_text:
Still the best Babi guling in Bali. The meat, sausage, skin was enak
We came around 1pm and the place was packed. They found us a seat and we enjoyed a good meal.

author: Eileen Neo (Sgsohotleh)
review_text:
Popular among locals and tourists.

Basically Ibu Oka 1/2 or 3, are all owned by the same owner. So you see your convenience and travel to the nearest. Don’t really know how to appreciate Babi Guling maybe. Asked for chilli, but it’s not the kind of chilli you re expecting. Ended up enjoying the crackers and magnum ice cream more than Babi Guling! 😂

author: Duy Tung Vu
review_text: The food was a bit salty but overall it was ok. The babi guling was juicy and not dry.

author: Leelawadee Mangade
review_text: This was my first time trying Babi Guling. It was delicious. Unfortunately, the day we came, the crispy pig skin was already sold out, so we got pork floss instead. If you're Thai or anyone else who likes spicy and flavorful tastes, don't miss this place! It's delicious and deeply savory! (Pro-tip: Don't hesitate to add more chili for extra heat!)

author: Gilo
review_text:
Found this place through a social media review and really pleased we visited! A proper local plate of food — tender, slow-cooked suckling pig with a generous square of crackling, accompanied by a spicy sausage and a tasty local vegetable dish.

It’s a very simple, no-frills spot but centrally located with quick, friendly service. The flavours were spot on — not too spicy, just enough to give it a lift.

If I’m being picky, the pork was a touch on the dry side and the crackling could have done with that final blast of heat for extra crunch. But overall, definitely worth a visit — I probably just arrived with expectations set sky-high!

author: Maita Rosieann G.K
review_text: Its near to the palace few minutes walk. Good enough serving food was ok was good and sauce was not spicy which is really good for foreign people dont like really spicy food. Roasted pig skin was not available anymore unfortunately we ate around 3pm probably was already sold out so they substitute fried pig skin on the babi guling meal.

author: JaneYeow
review_text:
(1/5) Food
(0/5) Cleanliness
(0/5) Environment
(0/5) Services
(0/5) Ingredient

They do not open the lights and fan too for the guests. And the shop is dark. The air flow…. omg
No comments Disappointed.

author: Daniel L.
review_text:
Unsure what the hype is about this restaurant.
I dined here around 5pm, and the place was fairly empty. They had run out of the crispy pork skin so we were served some crackers in its place. The pork meat was dry and bland. Perhaps I went there on an off-day, but I would find it difficult to recommend this restaurant to anyone.

author: Hung Vo
review_text:
Not sure why this place got bad reviews but if you like eating grilled/bbq pork then this is a good choice.
Also the price is very affordable

author: Joanne J
review_text:
Balinese and tourist alike says they're amazing. I personally thinks it's okay/normal. I don't understand what'l the hype is about 😅 maybe I expect too much. I liked the pork crackling (usually there's this so I'm guessing it was that) and soup compared to another one I tried though.  Its pricey at 104k for one person with drink. Another babi gulung local I tried was only like 25/30k per person. But that was outside of town so...

The location was strategic right beside the palace. Can sit down while people watching.

author: Bellybanker
review_text:
We have been one of loyal fans of Ibu Oka. For me, this is the best Babi Guling in Bali. Our view was indeed shared by the legend Chef Anthony Bourdain in one of his videos. Our favorite menu item would be SBabi Guling Special with extra skins.
The food is here is 4.9/5.0 stars.
To avoid long queue (especially during holiday season), please try to be at there before 11:30 am.
They take cash only (no cards or QRIS).

author: James W
review_text:
We were really keen to try babu guling, and after some research we found out Ibu Oka is one of the well established place for the dish. There are a few Ibu Oka branches and we came to Ibu Oka 1.

At around 11.30am the place didn’t have many diners but you could it’s clearly popular with the locals as there were lots waiting for takeaways and Grab food orders.

We order a special set with extra skin/ kulit. We had no prior experience with babi guling but we liked what we had. Everything was flavoursome, crisp skin varied a bit in terms of crunchiness and wasn’t heavily seasoned.

Overall, we enjoyed the set meal here and would recommend others to try.

Just beware it’s cash-only place.

author: Lin Cheng
review_text: The pig skin is hard as a rock. The fried pork rind  is also hard as a rock and chewy. Perhaps that’s the way it is supposed to taste. Some people might like it.The pork though looks like chicken, is juicy and delicious. I didn’t eat the blood sausage . The fried minced pork is not great. Everything is cold. It’s a speciality restaurant( cafe ), like part of a chain. But we went there because it’s a must try. If I could just order the pork without the skin and the rest, I would come back.

author: Rathian
review_text: Few Balinese recommended us to try sucking pigs in Bali. It’s pig in various forms. The pork was delicious. When we want to order more grilled or fried pork skin, no extra plates left. I believe that the spicy level has been adjusted lower to suit the foreigner’s tongue.

author: Aaron
review_text: This is our 4th attempt at finding the best Babi Guling in Bali and we were not disappointed. The skin was crisp, although I wish there was enough to order an extra plate of skin. The portion of meat was the best I have seen. The pork was delicious and was not riddled with fat as at some other locations we tried. The sambal on the pork was excellent and the spicy sambal on the table was extra hot the way I like it. My girlfriend preferred the soup at this location, although it was not my favorite. Overall a 4 star rating because roasted pig in the Philippines is much better. As for Bali, this is the best to date.

author: Alvin Wong
review_text: We ordered takeout for dinner. It’s was nicely packed and delicious! The soup was excellent 👍🏼

author: 金Ck
review_text:
We've been here for more than 20yrs! We have seen them go thru many transformations.

My family simply loves it.  Its basically white rice with pork.  The taste is quite unique and it can 'get' on to you,  just like how it did to my family.

But for me, I'm ok with it. The taste is not too bad,  the soup is simple but nice,  the meat is pleasant with crackling pork skin.

The restaurant is by the main road so it's not diff to locate. Price wise, I'd say it has gone dearer with little improvement with quality or quantity.

Service was not the greatest but this is a rural joint, so I'm not complaining.

In any case, if you're in Ubud, give it a try.

author: Linda Chevalier
review_text: If you are into suckling pig, this is the place to eat it. A stand out meal for a good price.

author: Amanda Isberg
review_text: We visited on a rainy Sunday afternoon around 12:30. We were immediately seated and able to order. I got the special including soup and the waitress thoughtfully suggested a child special for my 7 year old. We both loved it! I only wish it were served hot as the only thing slightly warm was the soup. Everything was pretty good overall!

author: Shelow Ann Regacho
review_text: As a Filipino, i have to try this. I was curious with how different it is from the lechon we have in Ph and I would say it didn't disappoint.

author: Tracy Lee
review_text: The most delicious pork! It was so tasty in here, the food was cooked perfectly and the pork was so tender and juicy. I can see why Anthony Bourdain loved this dish! Highly recommend, the staff will help you order if you aren't sure too. Lovely smiley staff who just added to this brilliant find!

author: pianized
review_text: Here is the original outlet where it started. Building used to be tin roofed and it has since been transformed into a modern shop house. Place was clean and service was fast. We visited late at around 5pm and they had only lean pork meat left. Taste was okay and unremarkable, my experience was similar to 12 yrs ago when I tried this - never a fan and not worth the exorbitant price. There is cubed vegetable soup and sambal (which is really stir fry green chillies) is spicy for a strong chilli eater.

author: Keane Leow
review_text: Been disappointed with babi guling since last trip few years ago but giving it a second chance this time and I am glad I decided so. The fried and grilled pork are very very very delicious. The chilli paste is a must.

author: Gabrielle Marie Yap
review_text:
Walked-in at around 10 AM on a Sunday and was seated immediately. We secured a table near the ledge for 800k+ minimum spend. Take note that this spot can have direct sunshine.

Our food was:
• brunch - bagel, french toast, fruit platter, 2 hot drinks
• snacks - french fries & frozen strawberry margarita
• early dinner - tuna poke bowl, hummus dip & chips, white sangria

Food was good and service was nice. We stayed until 7:30 PM since the place is nicer at night. Wasn’t able to catch the sunset because of the rain and wind but it’s all good, we also switched tables because of the rain & wind. Once the rain stopped, we were watching the surfers ride the waves. It was nice.

We recommend this beach club if you’re looking for a place to chill and relax.

author: Ashley Pitchford
review_text:
We spent an amazing day here on the last day of our travels. We arrived at 3:30pm with the view of staying until sunset but due to the wonderful service and relaxed atmosphere we stayed for dinner and drinks after sunset. Speaking of - the sunset was absolutely beautiful, highly recommend visiting for this alone if that’s all your budget allows.
The staff were extremely attentive and customer focused, nothing was too much trouble. Dion and Andy were our servers and I cannot praise them enough. The food was fabulous, was had snacks when we arrived and then pizza for dinner (I was expecting to order the open flame cooked steak but they had already sold out by the time I ordered unfortunately, my own fault for not planning ahead).
We had been to a couple of the other beach clubs in Canggu previously and they all pale in comparison to La Brisa in our opinion. This is much more grown up and sophisticated than the other Ibiza style clubs.
The price was very reasonable for the experience. To book a table you have to meet a minimum spend limit but currently that amounts to around £50 GBP so if you’re planning on eating here then that’s easily achievable. We were quite lavish on this day so our spend per person is relatively high compared to the amount you would actually need to spend.
If you want to feel like royalty for the day without breaking the bank then this stylish, elegant and beautiful beach front day club is exactly the place to visit.

author: Joan Ng
review_text:
Probably my favourite beach club in Bali so far! 😍
La Brisa has the perfect balance — chill, beautiful ambience and not too crowded or “party” compared to many other beach clubs.

We came for sunset and it was absolutely stunning, with the waves right in front. The seating area is cosy, lots of bamboo and island vibes, and I love that the music isn’t too loud, so you can actually relax and talk.

Service was friendly and the food was surprisingly good too.

One thing to note — they will hold your credit card after you order. I understand the policy since people can walk out to the beach area, but it felt a little uncomfortable to hand over the card. Maybe a tap-to-open tab system in the future would be great 😊

Overall, still a beautiful place to chill without the heavy-party vibes. I’ll definitely come back! 🌙✨

author: 孤獨的美食家
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

La Brisa Bali is one of the most beautiful beach clubs in Canggu — effortlessly combining bohemian charm with a laid-back seaside vibe. The decor is stunning, built mostly from reclaimed wood and fishing boats, giving it an authentic, rustic character that perfectly fits the Bali spirit. The entire place glows warmly under the sunset, with fairy lights and ocean breeze setting the perfect tropical mood.

The atmosphere is easily the highlight. Whether you’re chilling by the pool, watching surfers ride the waves, or sipping cocktails while the sky turns golden, it’s impossible not to feel relaxed. The music is mellow and fits the mood — upbeat enough to energize, yet calm enough for good conversation.

The food is generally good. The grilled octopus was tender and flavorful, the truffle pasta rich and creamy, and the pizza surprisingly well-baked with a crispy crust. While the quality is solid, the prices are quite high for Bali standards — you’re clearly paying for the view and the setting.

The service was polite and attentive, though the staff seemed quite busy at peak hours. Still, they managed to keep things running smoothly with a smile.

Overall, La Brisa is not just a restaurant but an experience — a place to unwind, enjoy the ocean, and soak in Bali’s relaxed elegance. Perfect for sunset drinks or a romantic dinner by the sea.

author: Nandika Acharya
review_text:
La Brisa is an absolute dream of a place. The vibe is immaculate effortlessly bohemian, laid-back, and magical, especially with the ocean breeze, rustic décor, and sunset views. It feels like you’ve stepped into a perfectly curated Bali postcard.
The food was just as impressive as the ambience. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, with a great balance of local and international influences. the music, the energy, the warm and attentive staff, and the way everything comes together so seamlessly. It’s the kind of place where time slows down, and you just want to sit, eat, drink, and soak it all in.
Easily one of the best dining experiences I had a must-visit if you’re in Canggu. 🌊✨

author: Daniel Sgroi
review_text:
La Brisa Bali, is remarkable venue that has quickly become a favorite destination. As soon as you enter, the ambiance captivates you with rustic decor, including canoes adorning the walls, hanging lights, and numerous ocean-themed elements. The lush atmosphere is complemented by two expansive pools and swaying coconut trees, making it a picturesque spot to unwind.
During my visit, I had the pleasure of enjoying the slow-cooked lamb shoulder, which was absolutely delicious. The lively energy of the place attracts a diverse crowd of young people from around the world who gather to relax and watch the sunset. I highly encourage making a reservation in advance, as the popularity of La Brisa Bali often results in long waiting times based on seating preference.

author: Xiang Liu
review_text:
Exceptional service & unforgettable experience at La Brisa

La Brisa never disappoints, but this visit truly stood out because of the incredible service from Gilang. From the moment we arrived, he went above and beyond to make sure our experience was special. He was attentive without being intrusive, warm, professional, and genuinely cared that we were having a great time.

The food and drinks were excellent — beautifully presented, full of flavor, and perfectly timed. We enjoyed a bottle of wine, and Gilang’s recommendations and attention throughout the evening made it even better. He checked in on us thoughtfully and handled everything with such ease and kindness.

It’s rare to come across service that feels this sincere. Gilang is a real asset to La Brisa and absolutely deserves recognition. Because of him, this wasn’t just a meal — it was an experience we’ll remember and happily return for.

Highly recommend La Brisa, and if you’re lucky enough to be looked after by Gilang, you’re in great hands. 🌿🍷

author: Tukang
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Absolutely Superb Experience

La Brisa Canggu is easily one of the most beautiful and atmospheric spots in Bali. The vibe is absolutely superb — a perfect mix of tropical charm, bohemian detail, and relaxed seaside energy. Every corner of the venue feels carefully curated with unique rustic design and warm lighting that makes it feel both magical and cozy.

The food was delicious and beautifully presented — fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. The cocktails were outstanding as well, perfectly balanced and full of character. The service team was friendly and attentive without ever feeling intrusive.

Whether you come for sunset drinks, a laid-back dinner, or just to enjoy the view, La Brisa Canggu truly captures the soul of Bali’s coastal lifestyle. Highly recommended — an unforgettable experience from start to finish.

author: Pbpb Pbpb
review_text:
I had a wonderful experience at this beach club. The place is extremely beautiful, with a stunning view of the sunset that makes the whole atmosphere unforgettable. The food was decent, but the cocktails were incredibly good — perfectly prepared and full of flavor.

A special thanks to the manager, Mika, who guided me through the cocktail selection with excellent recommendations. His attention and hospitality truly made my day. I had an amazing time thanks to him. I’ll visit again very soon

author: Alanta
review_text:
La Brisa is one of those places that just captures you the moment you walk in. The whole venue has this dreamy jungle-ocean vibe — lush greenery, rustic timber, and the sound of waves right in front of you. It feels like a tropical escape inside the heart of Canggu.

The sunsets here are absolutely breathtaking. Watching the sky turn gold and pink while overlooking the ocean is pure magic — easily one of the best sunset spots in Bali.

The food is consistently delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented, and the whole place has an effortless, laid-back vibe that makes you want to stay for hours. Great music, great atmosphere, and a perfect blend of nature and beach luxury.

Highly recommend La Brisa if you’re looking for an unforgettable Bali experience.

author: Lim Yan Xuan
review_text: Food and service was fantastic! Our server Ayu Mas really took care of us and is very attentive to our needs. Our first experience at La Brisa was amazimg from the reception getting us the best seats to the waitress and then the food everything was a vibe. The atmosphere was fantastic as well.

author: Vani Patro
review_text: Ayu Mas, from the moment we stepped into La Brisa was an absolute sweetheart. Her service is impeccable. She’s amazing in every way, she took care of our family in the best way possible and explained everything calmly and with so much respect. We had such a lovely time watching the amazing sunset! An evening well spent all thanks to Ayu Mas’s hospitality ❤️❤️

author: Lesley Johnson
review_text:
Bit of a mixed bag here. Arrived around midday and what a palaver to get in. Firstly, bags were checked for what I presume must be hidden alcohol or weapons ...? Not sure exactly of the reason.
Then seating. So many different seats at different costs that we felt we were on an episode of 'Black Mirror'! Settled for the minimum spend of 800,000 IDR which was taken in advance and we were given rickety chairs and an unstable table that looked like they were throwbacks from a 1980s conservatory furniture sale. We didn't like our original seats, so asked if we could move. Again, another big palaver whilst the seats/cost was checked. So far, so disappointing but the view of the ocean was great.
Staff looked stressed and uptight. They seemed to be watching everyone and it was not a comfortable ambience.
I guess maybe this is more of a sunset/evening venue as I certainly didn't get the chilled, relaxed vibe I was expecting.
On a positive note, the chicken pizza was lovely; nearly didn't order as it stated on the menu it comes slightly charred. Fortunately, it wasn't!
Would I return? Not sure.

author: Livelovetravel
review_text:
🌴 La Brisa Beach Club – Bali Vibes! 🌅

We visited this beach club last week — 2 adults and 2 kids — and honestly, our first impression was just wow! The place is absolutely beautiful, with amazing lights, cozy vibes, and great music.

When we arrived, we were offered a table with a minimum spending requirement (starting from around 1,800,000 IDR+), but we decided to sit at a free table by the pool downstairs since we knew we wouldn’t spend that much. The drinks were tasty (though, as expected, prices are a bit higher — it’s a beach club after all).

We didn’t order food as the menu wasn’t really our style — not very Balinese — but the atmosphere totally made up for it. Great vibe, nice tunes, and perfect spot to chill by the sea and watch surfers.

Such a cool, Instagram-worthy place — highly recommend stopping by if you’re in Canggu! 🌊✨

author: Chasing Sunsets
review_text:
Its one of my fav beach club in Bali!

La Brisa Bali is one of those places that feels like stepping straight into a boho beach dream. The whole vibe is effortlessly stylish with rustic wood, hanging lights, and coconut trees swaying in the breeze. The ocean beds are the perfect spot to relax while watching the waves, but you do need to pay in advance to get one. It is always packed, so booking ahead is the smart move unless you want to wait in line.

There are two large pools that look like they belong in a tropical garden of Eden. They are surrounded by lush greenery and good music floating in the air. Sundays are extra special with their famous market full of local products, vintage pieces, and handmade treasures.

The food is surprisingly good for a beach club. Fresh seafood, tropical flavors, and well-made cocktails make the whole experience even better. The vibe is lively, full of energy, and people from all over the world come here to chill, swim, and enjoy the sunset. If you want the best spot, come early, order a cocktail, and let time slow down. It is the kind of place you do not forget.

author: Nicole Bell
review_text: Love it! This was our first time, and it definitely won’t be our last. We loved the atmosphere and truly appreciated how family-friendly it was. The food options were excellent, everything was delicious, and the service was outstanding - thank you - Ani. A wonderful experience all around.

author: rae wu
review_text: Honestly, this is more than just a meal; it's a full sensory experience. We're seated right at the water's edge, with the gentle sea breeze brushing against our skin and the rhythmic sound of waves providing the most natural soundtrack. Every now and then, you can even taste the faint, salty mist in the air. As the sun begins to dip below the horizon, painting the sky in shades of orange, pink, and purple, you truly understand what it means to dine in paradise. It’s pure magic.

author: Lulu Berger
review_text: amazing views and location. stayed here the whole day to watch sunset and the whole time was 10/10. Vera our waitress was also so lovely and couldn’t do enough for us during our time, thank you again, Vera! x

author: Hayqarl
review_text:
La Brisa Bali Beach Club Review 🌊
La Brisa Bali is a great spot for those who prefer a chill and aesthetic atmosphere. The overall vibe is beautiful and relaxing, making it perfect for unwinding by the beach. The food was decent not extraordinary, but it’s clear that most people come here more for the ambience than the taste.

The minimum spending for the pool table area is 2.9 million rupiah, which is quite reasonable considering the setting and experience. We only stayed for about two hours since it closes at 11 p.m., but it was still an amazing experience overall. Th view, music, and aesthetic setup truly make it worth a visit. 🌅✨

author: 곽우찬
review_text: Alex T Surya was incredibly kind and attentive during our visit. He responded to our requests quickly and made us feel genuinely cared for. Thanks to his warmth and hospitality, we were able to create a wonderful memory on our honeymoon. His exceptional service made such a difference — and because of him, we truly want to come back again.

author: Nirmal Bhai
review_text:
La Favela is truly one of the most vibrant and exciting places to visit! The seamless booking process already sets the tone for a great experience. From the moment you step inside, you’re transported into a lively and unique atmosphere filled with stunning décor, captivating photospots, and a fun, upbeat vibe. The environment is perfect for both casual nights out with friends and special celebrations.

The food and drinks are consistently amazing : tasty, well-presented, and definitely worth coming back for. The staff are friendly, helpful, and attentive, making the entire experience feel welcoming and enjoyable. It’s my second time here, and I’m already looking forward to many more visits!

A special shout-out to the DJ who always does a fantastic job! The music selection keeps the energy high all night and really brings the whole place together. Whether you’re dancing the night away or just soaking in the ambiance, the soundtrack of the night never disappoints.

Overall, La Favela is a must-visit spot for anyone looking for great food, delicious drinks, and a fun night out filled with great music and photo-worthy moments. Love this place, highly recommended!

author: Islam Alaa
review_text: I recently visited La Favela and really enjoyed the atmosphere. The place has amazing music, beautiful décor, and a great overall vibe. The only downside is that the portions for both food and drinks are quite small. The prices are average—not cheap, not expensive—just normal. Aside from the portion sizes, everything else was truly impressive and worth experiencing.

author: Poppy Anna
review_text: La Favela is definitely a place to visit when in Seminyak! It’s a restaurant that turns into a club later in the night! The cocktails and the food were superb! I had the Rosalina cocktail (defo recommend) and for food we had the chicken tenders (crispy & moist), the patatas bravas (nice & fluffy) and the chicken pasta from the specials menu (creamy and flavoursome)! Also to mention our waiter Eka was so friendly and super attentive, he took time to chat with us and never hesitated to ask if we needed anything! I would definitely recommend coming here if you want a great night!!

author: Zakaria ESSALMI
review_text: La Favela is a must visit in Bali! The food was amazing, from flavorful starters and perfectly ink sauce calamari to juicy steak and fresh fish. Cocktails were creative and refreshing, and the birthday surprise dessert was such a thoughtful touch. The ambience is unique, artistic, and vibrant, and after dinner the place transforms into a lively nightclub with great music and atmosphere. Perfect spot for a special night out highly recommended!

author: Stella
review_text:
I went there by myself and still had a great time :)
There are two stages - one on each floors (i think? maybe one more) and the songs on the first floor were quite random but still nice.

Fyi you get one free drink with your entrance fee.
One important note is that the entrance and the exit are different! The exit is on the first floor. I didn't know that so I had to climb up and go down again to leave 🤦🏻‍♀️

author: Vanessa Rosaria
review_text: Exciting night out at La Favela. Food and drinks are at the pricier side but if you're there for dancing and party, it's the spot to be. All the DJ's produced good music. Atmosphere is great party vibes. Place is also thematic and really nice. It's cozy earlier in the evening but wild past midnight. For women, it's free entrance. For men, it is advisable tk come in before 10pm so you don't have to pay the entrance fee.

author: Molly Byrne
review_text:
Great spot; good food, great service (although they hang around a bit), really cool venue. Pricey for the area I think.

Turns into a club in the evening time - which is cool - music is good.

author: J DLS
review_text: Super ecstatic that we didn’t skip on this restaurant. We missed our reservation the first day and our week got so busy, but so happy we made another reservation for our last night. The entire staff were so friendly and smiley and the atmosphere was very unique and cozy. The drinks, the food, the dessert, were beyond amazing. Like nothing we’ve ever had before. Would come all the way back to Bali just to eat here again. Thank you so much to the entire La Favela team for making our last night in Bali so super special.

author: lily kay
review_text:
BEST CLUB EXPERIENCE EVER.

i would whole heartedly recommend coming here. there is three level; first two is pop & highest is techno. it’s more happening on the first floor. i paid for entrance 180k with one free drinks. there is indoor and outdoor area. it’s so stunning with the statue & there is a sofa in the female toilet. i would say it’s relatively clean & the music was very good. i noticed they are very efficient in cleaning up when there are guest who broke their beers/cup.

there is a photo booth on level 2 which cost 50k. would recommend!

author: Marisol Sanz
review_text: First, we ate at the restaurant and the food and drinks were delicious. Then we headed down to the party, and it was one of the best in Bali. Nice venue, great music, plenty of security, and a lot of fun.

author: Brandon Akiaten
review_text: This restaurant was hands down the best place in Bali. My wife and I celebrated our honeymoon with dinner here. Denny was our server and he was the best. He made awesome suggestions, was very attentive, and we never had an empty glass. The drinks, the tapas, and the main dishes were amazing. The atmosphere was incredible. They made the favelas of Brazil cool to experience here in Bali. The music was also amazing. My wife and I don’t even want to leave. If you’re visiting Bali, this is a MUST visit…and ask for Denny.

author: Gw Ng
review_text: Came here first time as a tourist. Bought 3 drinks at sgd $60 consider cheap for a sgporean. Staff were friendly. Overall experience was fun.

author: Blue Zulu
review_text:
One of most iconic venue in Seminyak, maybe in all Bali…Different stages and parts, many bars and lovely corners to spend time. We had light dinner and after continued party. Party place quiet small but you not need to stuck there to hear music and enjoy dancing.

Location is in the heart of Seminyak and very easy to reach. Give a chance a night for this fun. Enjoy.

author: Đorđe Jovanović
review_text: Everything was absolutely delicious! The pasta portion could have been a bit larger, but the taste was simply delicious. Our waiter, Ode, was incredibly polite and friendly. Not only did he recommend some fantastic cocktails, but they were also well-made.

author: Jayson Roy
review_text:
Reviewing in January 2026..
I'm truly disappointed by the entrance staff!
I was just a single person to enter.. first they asked me about the reservation? I said no, then they asked me to buy whole bottle of 750ml of whiskey to enter.
I said I'm just one person, why should I buy the whole bottle, I can drink inside as much as I want.. but they refused entry for not buying the whole bottle..!!! This is INSANE!! Very BAD!

The WORST part is that, the play a bit RACISM game on entries... they keep changing the rules for different patrons! I talked to other person who were refused too... and the reason he told me was that the staff asked him to book the WHOLE TABLE WITH WHOLE BOTTLE OF WHISKEY!! WOW!!!!!!++

author: adam haber
review_text:
This is a must do when travelling to Bali.
The food is some of the best I've ever had! The cocktails 🍸 were superb.
At night this place transforms in to a night club and definitely doesn't disappoint. The interior is visually stunning.

author: Haimanti Gupta
review_text: La Favela is one of a kind..! It’s a must visit if you are in seminyak. Everything is breathtaking - food, drinks, vibe, and ambience. Denny was just awesome and made us feel so nice. His hospitality is something to experience for sure.

author: sarah aisya
review_text:
Such a fun and vibrant place to dance and enjoy the night! I had an amazing time dancing and soaking in the festive atmosphere. The music was great, the crowd was energetic, and the interior feels like you’re stepping into a hidden, jungle-themed world.

For ladies, entrance is free — a big plus! For guys, there’s a minimum drink purchase required if you come after 10 PM. Totally worth it for the experience.

La Favela is definitely one of the must-visit spots if you’re looking to party in Bali!

author: Norton Erick
review_text: The best club in Seminyak. A must visit if you go to Bali. Came here with my friends on Saturday night. The place is perfect for celebrating birthdays or other events. The music is very fun and the atmosphere inside is very lively. For just having dinner or a party is also fun. The menu is very diverse, the food and drinks are also delicious. Most of the guests here are foreigners, maybe because there are many rumors that say that here they prioritize foreigners over locals. But when I was there the treatment of me and my friends who were locals was all very good, maybe the security needs to be improved to be friendlier and not discriminate against guests. Because the first impression is very important because the security position is at the very front. I am sure La Favela can be more crowded and more successful if the front part can be friendlier, not rude and more polite. Some of the staff are friendly and some are not. Apart from that, I really enjoy the atmosphere here. The atmosphere is very unique and different from most other clubs. And I will definitely recommend this place to my friends who want to visit a club in Bali.

author: Fabio Lopes
review_text: The food was great. A bit on the pricey side but was worth it.  I was treated very professionally by Hendrick. Overall a very lovely experience. Can't wait to try the bar later
